text: TOO MUCH IS NEVER ENOUGH: History Makes A Debut- Presenting Villa Paradiso, a legendary gated compound set on nearly four flat acres, the largest residential lot in historic Old Las Palmas. The storied estate includes a significant pool house built for Cary Grant, who would later give Villa Paradiso its enduring name. Across the grounds, sprawling green lawns, approximately 200 mature palm trees, four separate residences, and unobstructed mountain views create a scale and sense of privacy almost impossible to replicate in such a prime Palm Springs location. Originally built in 1928 by developer and builder Alva H. Hicks, a member of Palm Springs' first City Council and an instrumental figure in the city's incorporation, Villa Paradiso is currently identified as a Class 3 Site. Its romantic Palm Beach-inspired main residence retains the architectural character of its era, while the estate's remarkable lineage of notable former owners and decades of stories tied to Hollywood and Palm Springs society have added to its mystique for nearly a century. Behind handcrafted stone walls, verdant pathways connect the residences through art-filled vistas, sculptural elements, and a classical fountain. The approximately 7,500-square-foot main residence features an expansive veranda connecting its two wings, highlighted by an Italian rotunda with hand-painted ceilings. A large formal motor court and climate-controlled four-car garage complement the estate's impressive scale.

text: In 1935, a then-unknown architect, Albert Frey, dropped three boxes in the California desert as a study in simplicity and minimalism. Nearly a century later, The Guthrie House was reimagined with Frey's vision in mind. Set behind a gated entrance with an expansive driveway, this private Palm Springs oasis blends architectural distinction with modern comfort. In 2019, the home was fully renovated with entirely new systems. The extensive renovation included structural upgrades, plumbing, electrical, pool, stucco, drywall, roof, energy-efficient doors and windows, HVAC, and more. Additional enhancements include a detached pool house, outdoor bar and barbecue, four in-ground gas fire pits, and a custom indoor doggie shower. The result: 'a chic zen-like retreat wreathed by staggering mountain views,' says the Los Angeles Times. With a legacy spanning media publications, fashion campaigns, and architectural photo shoots, The Guthrie House is more than a residence, it is a rare chance to own a piece of desert modernism.

Poured terrazzo floors reflect light beautifully, adding texture and authenticity while anchoring the space in timeless mid-century materiality. Outside, the backyard unfolds as a true private resort. A built-in BBQ and outdoor fireplace create an ideal setting for evenings under the desert sky, where the mountains slowly transform into dramatic silhouettes as day gives way to night. Modern efficiency is seamlessly integrated into the home's design. An owned solar system with 36 panels producing 11.8 kW is paired with three Tesla Powerwall-3 battery backup systems, offering energy independence, resilience, and long-term sustainability. Situated on FEE LAND (you own it), adds both tangible value and long-term security. Tucked within a serene, private enclave, this residence offers a rare balance of architectural integrity, privacy, and livability, just moments from the best of Palm Springs. This is where architecture becomes atmosphere, and light becomes a living element. Each space is designed not only to be seen, but to be felt, capturing the rhythm of the desert and the effortless elegance of Palm Springs living at its most refined.

This is a rare opportunity to own a piece of history in the 'Beverly Hills of Palm Springs.' text: This mid-century modern gem in the El Mirador neighborhood is quintessential desert living. This home offers a rare blend of historical flair and updated luxury, perfect as a private retreat or a proven investment property. This home boasts an open-concept design with high ceilings and a stacked-stone gas fireplace. Strategically placed windows and sliders provide seamless indoor-outdoor flow and prolific views of Mt. San Jacinto. A ''chef's/cook's kitchen'' features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances (gas range and oven), and dual sinks. Three divinely separated bedrooms, each with its own bathroom makes for easy living with multiple occupants. The Primary Suite Features generous closet space, dual vanities, a large walk-in shower, and an extra-large soaking tub. The larger of the Secondary bedrooms has its own private patio and private bathroom. While the slightly smaller Secondary bedroom is well separated from the rest of the living area and other bedrooms, it has it's own bathroom with shower and is located near the large laundry room with full-size W/D. The backyard is designed for the ultimate Palm Springs lifestyle: A Saltwater Pebble-Tec Pool & Spa features a cascading waterfall effect. Replete with a built-in natural gas BBQ and bar all the while boasting magnificent views of the surrounding mountains. A large linear fire table with marble benches under shade trees creates its own ambiance in a separate part of the yard. Located on fee land (you own it), this home includes a low-cost, leased solar system, and has a very successful history as a long-term (28+ day) vacation rental when not being used by the current owners. The home is tucked into a quiet cul-de-sac in the upscale El Mirador neighborhood just minutes from the Uptown Design District, Ruth Hardy Park (tennis and pickleball), and downtown dining. Nearby hiking trails and public golf courses along with convenient access to the CV Link provides significant opportunities for recreation.

text: Experience timeless Palm Springs luxury reimagined for modern living in this Spanish Hacienda, located in the prestigious Old Las Palmas neighborhood- one of the city's most iconic enclaves and home to legendary estates. This property neighbors Liberace's famed Palm Springs residence and also neighboring Clark Gable's historic desert retreat, placing it among some of the most storied homes of Hollywood's Golden Age. This estate had undergone decades of fragmented updates before being completely re-envisioned by acclaimed Laguna Beach designer Sheldon Harte of Harte Brownlee & Associates. Harte masterfully unified the home-once a disjointed ''Frankenterior''-into a cohesive, romantic, and luxuriously livable Spanish retreat designed for multigenerational enjoyment. Spanning nearly 5,822 sq. ft. on a single level, the residence features 6 ensuite bedrooms, including an opulent primary suite with a walk-through closet, rain shower, and a hand-carved marble soaking tub. Elegant formal rooms flow effortlessly into warm, inviting spaces, including a stunning chef's kitchen with a massive island, Thermador appliances, and an adjacent bonus/billiards room perfect for hosting gatherings of all sizes. Set on a gated corner lot of more than one-half acre, the landscaped grounds-designed by renowned landscape architect Marcello Villano-offer true resort living with mature gardens, a sparkling pool, outdoor fireplace, built-in BBQ, life-sized chess set, a 4-car garage, and a spacious gated motor court. All of this is just a short walk to the heart of Downtown Palm Springs, with its vibrant dining, shopping, and nightlife - including the brand-new Thompson Palm Springs hotel, its curated retail, and elevated restaurant offerings just minutes away. A rare Old Las Palmas masterpiece, this estate blends historical significance, modern luxury, and an unbeatable walkable location in the most coveted neighborhood in Palm Springs.

text: One of the rare newer custom residences completed in 2017 within one of Palm Springs' oldest and most storied neighborhoods, 740 N Prescott is an exuberant architectural statement balancing grandeur with warmth. Created through a deliberate collaboration between visionary clients and renowned architect Narendra Patel of Patel Architecture, Inc., this extraordinary estate showcases indigenous materials, natural light, and thoughtful modern design. The defining feature is its dramatic floating roof, a soaring canopy crafted from clear Douglas fir that appears to hover above the residence, framing breathtaking views of Mt. San Jacinto. Sculptural, tectonic-inspired forms conceal lighting and mechanical systems, preserving the home's clean architectural lines. Inside, refined materials and impeccable craftsmanship abound, including Jura fossilized limestone flooring, hardwood floors, Venetian plaster walls, 9-foot solid wood doors, and a sleek gas fireplace. The custom Italian Valcucine kitchen from Milan features recycled wood cabinetry, Miele appliances, dual dishwashers, dual wine refrigerators, a steam oven, built-in coffee system, walk-in pantry, and water softener. Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, automated windows and motorized blinds open to the pool deck and saltwater pool. The iconic sunken onyx Sinatra Bar, complete with a private powder room, adds a dramatic entertaining space. The primary suite offers dual vanities, a soaking tub, sunken shower, and limestone flooring. Three additional guest suites feature bespoke finishes, including onyx and Italian sinks, walk-in closets, automated blinds, and designer-tiled baths. A separate 383-square-foot casita provides exceptional flexibility with a full kitchenette, marble counters, dual-vanity bath, and tile shower. Additional features include three HVAC systems, a garage mini-split, fire sprinkler system, service entry, smart home integration, marble laundry room, six-camera security system, and spacious three-car garage.

text: Welcome to the exclusive Desert Palisades enclave in Palm Springs, where world-renowned architects collaborate to create sustainable, cutting-edge homes. Embrace 360-degree mountain views with this newly constructed, architectural gem, surrounded by boulders and nestled in the hills at the base of the San Jacinto Mountains. Nearly 3800 sq.ft. of luxurious living space offering seamless indoor-outdoor living, a spacious open floor plan including living room and dining area, an expansive deck, meticulous landscaping, and a luxurious pool. As you enter the residence, clad in Japanese Sugi Ban wood, you are greeted with phenomenal mountain, desert and city views through floor to ceiling Monumental sliding glass doors and windows. The clear wood oak floors accent the hot rolled steel two-sided fireplace that extends from the living room to the family room/den. The gourmet Chef's kitchen is outfitted with top-of-the-line Miele appliances, two dishwashers, wine refrigerator, Hans Grohe fixtures, Blanco farmhouse-style sink, designer lighting and European-style cabinetry. The primary bedroom suite is an opulent retreat, complete with sliding door access to the outdoor patio, pool & spa, a glass-enclosed shower, luxurious free-standing soaking tub, a hallway of expansive custom closets and its own stackable washer/dryer. There are two lovely, well-appointed guest bedrooms, each with uniquely designed en-suite bathrooms providing their own spectacular mountain and city views. Each bathroom includes beautiful walk-in showers, Robern lighted medicine cabinets, in-wall tank Toto toilets, and ample closet space. Other home features include Eastern European wood interior doors, seven skylights (2 being operable), Kohler bathroom sinks, under cabinet lighting, separate laundry/utility room, 6 state-of-the-art security cameras, owned solar for energy efficiency, 5 HVAC zones and a huge 4-car garage to accommodate both vehicle and storage needs. The expansive outdoor space is an entertainer's dream featuring a built-in firepit and gorgeous custom Pebble-Tec pool with tanning shelf and separate raised spa. The spectacular 360-degree views enhance the beauty and serenity of this home's outdoor living. Surrounded by mountains, this home's design blends seamlessly with the desert landscape, embodying the architectural ethos of the Desert Palisades. Every aspect of this home has been meticulously curated to fashion an exquisite masterpiece of artful living!

text: Designed by Charles Du Bois and built by the Alexander Construction Company, this Vista Las Palmas home sits on one of the neighborhood's larger lots, with Mt. San Jacinto rising behind it. Turquoise double doors open from a stone-walled entry breezeway to classic midcentury details: tongue-and-groove ceilings, dark exposed beams, and a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace. Across the back of the house, walls of sliding glass open to the yard and the mountains beyond. The oversized lot leaves room for a long pool, raised tiled spa, and broad lawn, with space left over for lounging. The kitchen is the contemporary note: dark wood cabinetry, quartz counters, a large island, professional range, stainless hood, open shelving and wine refrigerator. Even the sink faces the mountains. The primary suite has its own fireplace and a slider opening directly to the pool. Its bath has a freestanding soaking tub and glass-enclosed shower. A separate casita with kitchenette and private bath opens onto the pool deck, giving guests their own quarters. The main house also includes a family room, exercise room and a laundry room with dog shower. Downtown Palm Springs is minutes away. A Charles Du Bois design in Vista Las Palmas, with more land than most and the mountain views the neighborhood is known for.

text: Set on Rose Avenue in the iconic Vista Las Palmas neighborhood, surrounded by celebrated period mid-century homes and framed by dramatic mountain views, this residence offers a rare combination of scale, flow, and modern infrastructure. Built in 2001 and now extensively reimagined in a sophisticated Spanish-modern, mid-century vernacular, the home blends architectural presence with contemporary comfort. Expansive living spaces with 12-foot ceilings are unified by dramatic large-format terrazzo tile flooring and illuminated by new Monumental metal windows and sliding doors that flood the interior with natural light while connecting seamlessly to mature desert landscaping. The fully re-envisioned kitchen features custom hickory-pecan millwork, designer tile from Spain, honed Taj Mahal counters, and new high-end appliances from Monogram. The flow continues into the adjacent family room with a custom floating AV cabinet inspired by Broyhill's iconic Brasilia line, and designer wallpaper. The living and dining areas are anchored by a striking two-sided fireplace with a floating hearth, wood-paneled ceilings, and a refined wet bar with leathered Sandalus quartzite and a Brizo fixture. A spacious laundry room provides additional storage and convenience. The generous primary suite opens directly to the backyard and features a large custom walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bath with double shower, Japanese soaking tub, dual vanities, linen storage, and a private water closet with bidet. Guest bedrooms include custom wallpaper, large picture windows oriented toward the dramatic San Jacinto Mountains, and striking Elizabeth Sutton terrazzo mosaic tile in the baths. The chic powder room features a floating vanity and a mid-century-inspired tile wall. Outside, new stonework enhances the exterior and BBQ island, while the refreshed pool with new tile, lush landscaping, natural koi pond, new patio with fire pit, and a custom Trina Turk-designed breeze-block wall create a true desert retreat. Modern infrastructure includes new plumbing fixtures, designer lighting throughout, app-based systems including Pentair pool controls and a whole-house alarm with 8-camera security system, three car garage, plus owned solar panels, and two PowerWall backup batteries which supply continuous power in the event of an electrical outage, and provide for lower energy costs by powering the home during the evening hours. A rare opportunity in one of Palm Springs' most prized neighborhoods.

Additional features include a two-car garage with epoxy floors, enhanced insulation, side parking, southern exposure, and stunning mountain views.

text: Located in the historic Movie Colony of Palm Springs, this architecturally significant post-and-beam residence designed by Donald Wexler with Richard Harrison for developer Roy Fey presents a rare opportunity to own a true piece of desert modernism. Believed to have been the former home of Dinah Shore, the property offers both architectural and cultural provenance. Nestled across the street from the former Tony Curtis House and neighboring the Art Linkletter Estates, the setting places the home among some of Palm Springs' most storied and architecturally notable properties. The residence remains largely in its original condition, preserving authentic mid-century details including walls of glass, tongue-and-groove ceilings, original poured-in-place concrete floors throughout much of the home, and terrazzo flooring in the family room - timeless materials that reflect Wexler's signature modernist design. Set on a private walled corner lot with panoramic mountain views, the grounds create a serene desert retreat with mature hummingbird gardens and abundant yard-to-table citrus trees, enhancing the seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. A spacious family/media room offers flexible use and presents the opportunity to convert into a new primary suite with en-suite bath, allowing for a potential 5-bedroom, 4-bath configuration. An exceptional restoration, modernization, or long-term investment opportunity in one of Palm Springs' most desirable and historically significant neighborhoods - ideal for collectors, design enthusiasts, or investors seeking architectural pedigree and long-term upside. text: Designed in 1969 by Hugh Kaptur, AIA, and thoughtfully restored in 2025 with his blessing, this exceptional single-level post-and-beam residence reflects the architectural clarity and restraint that define Kaptur's most enduring work. Located on an ultra-private cul-de-sac in the heart of Movie Colony, the home honors its pedigree while presenting with renewed integrity. Clean lines, open-plan interiors, and rhythmic colonnades establish a strong architectural framework, while expansive walls of floor-to-ceiling glass and sliding doors dissolve the boundary between indoors and out. Mountain views unfold to the west, with nearly every room opening directly to the landscape. The light-filled living room is a signature moment defined by vaulted, exposed-beam ceilings, warm wood-paneled walls, integrated built-ins, and a substantial fireplace anchoring the space. Clerestory windows and a serene interior atrium further enhance this area's connection to light and nature. The adjacent kitchen is crowned by floating light panels and features Walnut cabinetry, stone countertops, Fisher & Paykel appliance suite, and a pass-through to the dining area reinforcing the home's original modernist flow. All primary living spaces extend to a covered patio overlooking the ultra-private south and west-facing backyard, where Mount San Jacinto views frame a pool and spa, open-air fireplace, and generous lawn creating an elegant extension of the architecture itself. text: PRICE IMPROVEMENT!! Welcome to Escena, where luxury meets contemporary elegance in this highly desired Anthony Poon designed home. This beautiful Alta Verde home showcases a front-loaded pool and spa with PHENOMENAL views of the San Jacinto mountains. The expansive primary bedroom suite has cornered Fleetwood sliding door access to a private back patio, a huge double-headed walk-in shower, dual vanities, and an extra amount of closet space. The two guest bedrooms share a Jack & Jill bathroom, with good separation from the primary bedroom. Enjoy Palm Springs indoor/outdoor living at its finest with a floor to ceiling wall of Fleetwood sliding doors opening from the great room to the outdoor patio and pool, perfect for entertaining or just relaxing in the sun as you revel in the amazing mountain views. text: Welcome to Casa Lantanas in highly desirable Movie Colony East, one of Palm Springs' most iconic neighborhoods where history, style, and desert living combine together in perfect harmony. Discover the perfect blend of vintage charm and modern comfort at this timeless Palm Springs Spanish Retreat. The charm begins at the covered front porch and continues as you pass through the custom iron front entry door. Featuring 4 Bedrooms (one currently used as an office has its own en-suite bathroom), a master bedroom with en-suite, and two additional guest rooms. Custom closet organization systems in the primary bedroom and two of the guest rooms. All Showers are beautifully tiled with custom glass doors/surrounds and the master bath has dual vanities. Granite counters, Viking appliances and a wine fridge complete the amazing kitchen. Inside laundry room with ample storage. Custom shutters throughout and interior and exterior were painted in 2020. The large Great room features tongue and groove ceiling and open beams with French doors leading to two distinct outdoor spaces. Each side has a large covered patio and distinct entertaining space offering endless opportunities to entertain or unwind. One side includes Mountain Views and the sparkling Salt water pool and Spa with new pebble tech and all new equipment. Recently upgraded with new Cool Decking with diamond grind surface. Heated pool and spa with additional roof mounted solar pool heater providing eco-friendly year-round enjoyment. The other side includes a treed garden and illuminating fire pit . A large side yard with desert plants, meandering flagstone walkway and drought tolerant landscaping with automated irrigation make for easy maintenance. The property is walled for privacy and includes a 1 car garage with built in storage cabinets and Granitex epoxy flooring surface. A new tankless water heater was added in 2024. Dual HVAC and ceiling fans throughout for energy efficient heating and cooling. Whether it's a lively gathering under the desert skies or a quiet morning coffee in your private oasis, this home was designed for the Palm Springs lifestyle. Living in Movie Colony East means being close to it all. You're just minutes from downtown Palm Springs, with world-class dining, boutique shopping, and vibrant nightlife. A short walk to Ruth Hardy Park for tennis, pickleball, or a picnic under the palms-or simply enjoy the peace and quiet of wide streets and a welcoming neighbor

text: PRICE ADJUSTMENT!! Welcome to Escena, where luxury meets contemporary elegance in this highly desired Anthony Poon designed home with AMAZING views of the San Jacinto mountains. This beautiful Alta Verde home features a wall of Fleetwood sliding doors that open to a front-loaded pool and spa, showcasing phenomenal views of the western and southern mountains. One of the larger homes in Escena, this home offers 2649 sq. ft. of luxurious living space with 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. A chef's kitchen is a culinary delight with quartz countertops and backsplash, Italian designed cabinetry, stainless-steel Bosch appliances and an oversized island. The spacious open floor plan consists of the kitchen, living and dining areas, 10'+ high ceilings, porcelain tile flooring, a fireplace, custom lighting, and spectacular views. The expansive primary bedroom suite, extending the entire width of the home, has cornered Fleetwood sliding door access to a private back patio, a huge double-headed walk-in shower tucked behind dual vanities, and an extra amount of closet space, all organized by California closets. The two guest bedrooms share a Jack and Jill bathroom, with good separation from the Primary bedroom. This home offers Palm Springs indoor/outdoor living at its finest with dual sets of Fleetwood sliding doors opening from the great room to the outdoor patio and pool, perfect for entertaining or just relaxing in the sun as you revel in the unbelievable mountain views. Another Fleetwood sliding door opens from the kitchen to a lovely side yard/patio of pavers and artificial turf, perfect for relaxing or cooking on the outdoor BBQ. A blocked retaining wall spreads across the back of the property boasting lush landscaping, including beautiful bougainvillea bushes and Meyer lemon and tangerine trees. Lighting and landscaping surround the property, adding to the privacy of the outdoor space and its alluring night-time beauty. Additional highlights include motorized blinds in the great room and primary bedroom, a powder room for guests, a separate laundry room with cabinetry, 2-car garage, upgraded recessed lighting and 26 solar panels for energy efficiency. Escena is a highly sought after guard-gated golf course community with low HOA dues and resides on fee simple land (you own it). Do not miss this beautiful Palm Springs contemporary home, offering luxury, unparalleled comfort, style, and some of the best views in Escena!

text: Experience the ultimate combination of Palm Springs' rich past and alluring present at this sprawling custom estate in the exclusive enclave of Old Las Palmas. The former home of legendary star Mary Martin, this exceptionally private and peaceful property is available for the first time in more than 35 years. Carefully upgraded while preserving its original style, the estate was created in 1936 and features a single-level main house and a detached guest house with rooftop view patio, encompassing a total of six bedrooms and five baths in approximately 4,078 square feet. Beyond a breezeway entrance, the residence opens to a formal fireplace-warmed living room with vaulted and beamed ceiling, a dining room with pool views and wet bar, and a casual family room. Large picture windows allow natural light to illuminate living spaces, while hardwood floors add warmth to every occasion. Highlighted by two garden windows, the kitchen presents custom cabinetry, solid-surface countertops, a nook with built-in banquette seating, a built-in pantry, and a large bar for dining and buffet-style serving, all with fabulous pool views. Each bedroom is unique, with some sharing upgraded baths, and the primary suite hosting two baths, a walk-in closet, cedar-lined sauna, and a retreat with outdoor access that has the potential to become another bedroom. A bonus room with bath, Murphy bed and direct patio access enhances versatility. Classic features include a cabinet hidden behind a painting, a built-in shoe-shine station and a walk-down basement, while new dual-zone AC and splits ensure year-round comfort. Grounds are beautiful and serene, with a street-to-street homesite of approximately .68 acres welcoming stunning mountain views, a private front yard with lawn and gardens, a private side yard with lifelike turf and towering palm trees, and a resort-caliber backyard with recently refreshed PebbleTec pool and spa, resurfaced decking and enviable privacy. Historic photos showcase Martin and fellow screen legends, including Janet Gaynor, enjoying the poolside setting. The terraced backyard's lower level is home to mature citrus trees, an open-air fireplace with ample room for seating, a newer covered patio with BBQ, a long gated driveway with ample room for guest parking, and a rotating solar array with new panels that follows the sun to maximize energy production. Additional parking is available on a paver-finished front driveway leading to an attached two-car garage.

text: Step inside this striking Fiore model-an architectural single-story masterpiece tucked within the gated enclave of the renowned Escena Golf Club in Palm Springs. Offered furnished, Move right in. Built in 2023 and custom-upgraded far beyond the builder's finish, this contemporary residence offers 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, and 2,593 sq ft of refined interior living space on a 6,970 sq ft lot. The open-concept great room welcomes you with soaring 17' ceilings, walls of glass, and panoramic views of two golf course fairways surrounded by the towering San Jacinto Mountains. Expansive sliders erase the boundary between indoors and out, filling the home with natural light and creating a seamless indoor-outdoor experience. Oversize porcelain tile pavers extend outward from the home interior, integrating both west and north facing outdoor entertainment areas, and creating a cohesive, spacious architectural flow that perfectly complements the exterior's extended desert landscape. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen blends beauty and performance with a 48" Fulgor Milano 7-burner induction range and double oven, JennAir Professional side-by-side built in refrigerator/freezer, microwave and 48" professional hood, SimPure reverse osmosis water filtration system, and oversized Calacatta quartz island. Every element was designed for entertaining and everyday luxury. The primary suite is a serene retreat featuring a spa-inspired bath with floating dual vanities, soaking tub and spacious walk-in shower offering accessibility from both sides. Two additional bedrooms with en-suite offer privacy and flexibility for guests, family, or a dedicated office. Step outside to your private sanctuary, where an in-floor system heated pool, electric pool cover, and mountain views invite relaxation at any hour. Owned-Solar, Tesla Powerwall, Hague WaterMax purification system, and LG mini-split air-conditioned garage further enhance the home's smart, sustainable design. The landscaping is a true work of art - professionally designed and upgraded with custom desert plantings, sculptural accents, and custom-designed entry gates that elevate the home's architecture and create a striking first impression. Every exterior element has been curated for low maintenance and maximum impact. Within Escena, residents enjoy resort-style amenities including a championship golf course, scenic walking paths, a restaurant and bar - all just minutes from downtown Palm Springs dining, shopping, and festivals. 4321 Lumina Way is a masterclass in modern desert living - where sophisticated design, smart technology, and thoughtful upgrades combine to create an effortlessly elegant retreat.

text: The Wexler Residence is one of Palm Springs' most significant architectural offerings - a deeply personal work of modernism designed in 1955 by Donald Wexler as his own family home. Privately set on approximately one-third of an acre in Movie Colony East, this Class 1 Historic Resource is listed on the National Register of Historic Places and offers the valuable benefit of Mills Act property tax savings. Distinct from the industrial language of Wexler's celebrated steel houses, the residence reveals a softer, more organic vision, shaped by his early work with Richard Neutra and William F. Cody. Its all-wood post-and-beam construction, open and flexible floor plan, floor-to-ceiling glass, and deep overhangs create a seamless relationship between architecture, landscape, and light. From 2007 to 2026, the home underwent a museum-quality restoration completed in three phases, preserving its architectural integrity while elevating it for contemporary living. In a rare full-circle collaboration, Donald Wexler himself, together with architect Lance O'Donnell and designer Darren Brown, helped shape a comprehensive restoration honored with the Palm Springs Modern Committee's Residential Restoration of the Year Award. Original vertical fir siding and spun metal lighting were meticulously preserved, while terrazzo floors, marble surfaces, refined European fixtures, a new roof, updated HVAC, and solar were thoughtfully integrated. Hidden behind gates and a mature perimeter hedge, the grounds unfold as a private desert retreat with native landscaping, ancient boulders, a striking black-bottom pool, detached spa, and sweeping San Jacinto Mountain views - an extraordinary union of historic significance, architectural purity, and beautifully restored modern living.

A rare opportunity to enjoy brand-new modern architecture in one of Palm Springs' most sought-after neighborhoods where design, privacy, and mountain views converge.

text: Set within the prestigious guard-gated community of Escena, this extraordinary residence offers Palm Springs resort-style living with 3 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, including an attached casita. This sprawling home resides on a nearly 14,000 square-foot corner lot, one of the largest in Escena, and overlooks the 7th hole of the Jack Nicklaus designed Escena golf course. Framed by sweeping San Jacinto Mountain vistas, panoramic fairway views, and dramatic desert skies, this 3,831-square-foot residence blends sophisticated interiors, including curved archways, crown moulding, 9'+ ceilings, with exceptional indoor-outdoor living. The great room features high ceilings and a gas fireplace - one side boasts french doors leading out to the oversized patio and backyard, while the other side has a picturesque window showcasing the golf course and mountain views. The gourmet kitchen is designed for both culinary pursuits and entertaining, with a substantial island, walk-in pantry, an 8-burner gas cooktop, new double ovens & dishwasher, and abundant cabinetry. A private guest bedroom with ensuite bath and a generously sized den complete the refined ground-floor living spaces. A dramatic staircase leads to the luxurious upper level primary retreat, featuring a fireplace, picturesque windows and a private balcony to revel in spectacular mountain & golf course views. Its spa-inspired ensuite offers a steam shower, jetted soaking tub, stone countertops, separated dual vanities, and two generous walk-in closets. The attached private casita with ensuite bathroom is an ideal guest retreat. An oversized two-car garage includes a third bay well suited for a large golf vehicle, fitness equipment or a workshop. Outside, an entertainer's dream awaits with a spectacular private oasis, centered around an impressive resort-style pool & spa with a waterfall feature, and multiple spaces for lounging, dining, and entertaining. A sculptural fountain, fire pit, outdoor barbeque, and private putting green further elevate the magnificent back yard living space. Lush professional landscaping enhances privacy while creating a stunning backdrop for mountain, fairway, sunset, and desert views. Owned solar and 2 Tesla solar converters add energy efficiency. Every element of this expansive residence captures the quintessential Palm Springs lifestyle--generous proportions, extraordinary views, seamless indoor-outdoor living, and resort-caliber amenities.

text: Sophisticated coastal charm meets Hugh Kaptur's desert modern design in this Desert Dorado home in the Oasis Del Sol neighborhood of Palm Springs. Tucked away at the end of a cul-de-sac with a majestic ocotillo in front, this home boasts a 3 bedroom main house and casita tucked behind its 2 car garage. The home was recently updated by its owners with alluring gold hardware details and luxe kitchen counter surfaces, and updated appliances. 566 Sunset features a living and dining room with a vaulted ceiling anchored by a gas fireplace. The updated kitchen opens to an atrium enclosed solarium that looks out to a spacious yard and turquoise classic kidney-shaped pool. Stunning views to the San Jacinto mountains take center stage, from any point in the yard, loungers by the pool or the conversational seating area that surrounds the fire pit. The house features two guest bedrooms and a primary suite with extra deep closets and a sliding door out to the yard and pool. The en-suite bathroom includes a long vanity with dual sinks and a shower tub combo. The hall /guest bath features a shower/tub combo as well. The Two car garage house the washer and drier and gas water heater. A fourth bedroom/casita with its own separate entrance and private courtyard that was added by the original owners has its own en-suite bathroom with shower that could be rented separately or used as a guest room or office. The room opens out to the back yard with a sliding door as well. The HVAC system has a gas heater and provides central air conditioning. Owned solar with two Tesla Power walls has been added on the roof (composite and clay tile.) Come see this wonderfully updated home and its big back yard with fantastic views. text: The iconic Big Boy Estate offers a rare opportunity to experience the quintessential Palm Springs lifestyle in one of the city's most celebrated architectural neighborhoods. Designed by renowned architect William Krisel and built in 1958 by the Alexander Company for Bob Wian, founder of the Bob's Big Boy burger chain, this historic Mid-Century property blends architectural pedigree, celebrity provenance, and effortless indoor-outdoor living. Located in the prestigious and historic Vista Las Palmas community, the home sits among some of Palm Springs' most famous examples of mid-century modern design. The neighborhood is known for its iconic architecture, stunning mountain backdrops, and storied celebrity past. With 3,076 sq ft of living space, the Big Boy Estate represents one of the larger Alexander floor plans. The property features 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 baths in the main house, along with 3 separate casitas--each with its own ensuite bath and private entrance. Furnished with wonderful art and period-correct pieces throughout, the home offers an authentic mid-century atmosphere. Upon entering the front door, the view opens straight through to the garden and pool, immediately announcing relaxation and fun. Set on a generous 16,988 sq ft lot, the estate's house and casitas create a magical setting that easily accommodates multi-generational living, large gatherings, or intimate stays. The Big Boy Estate has also been an award-winning, personally managed active short-term rental, helping offset family use, with the opportunity to continue this currently in place. The property is within easy biking distance of lively downtown Palm Springs. Behind the walled and beautifully landscaped grounds lies a sparkling saltwater pool, spa, putting green, and expansive gardens. Towering palms frame breathtaking panoramic mountain views while birdsong fills the quiet morning air. The open floor plan features terrazzo stone floors, glass sliders, and a central stone fireplace, while clerestory transom windows create beautiful light and sightlines throughout the home. Turnkey furnished in classic Mid-Century style, every detail of this property has been meticulously cared for. Since purchasing the home in 2017, the current owners have completed multiple upgrades to thoughtfully preserve the Krisel vision while adding modern comforts. The Big Boy Estate seamlessly combines the charm and character of classic modernist architecture with today's high-tech conveniences.

text: A stunning blend of modern sophistication and Palm Springs' architectural heritage, this estate is set in the coveted Movie Colony East, a neighborhood once home to Hollywood icons. Positioned on an expansive corner lot of nearly half an acre, it offers privacy and exclusivity, only attached to two neighboring properties. Located on the same street as Frank Sinatra's legendary Twin Palms Estate, it embodies a seamless fusion of history, luxury, and contemporary design. A dramatic sunken great room unfolds beneath soaring 15-foot coffered ceilings, anchored by a statement fireplace that enhances the grandeur of the space. Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, the layout features a formal dining area with lush poolside views, an open chef's kitchen outfitted with sleek Bertazzoni appliances, a natural gas range, a convection oven, and a breakfast nook perfect for morning rituals. The home offers three elegantly appointed en-suite bedrooms, along with an oversized attached casita that includes its own kitchenette and powder room, providing flexibility for guest accommodations or a private retreat. The primary suite is a true sanctuary, boasting a Finnish dry sauna, walk-in shower, soaking tub, and direct access to the pool, creating an experience of tranquility and indulgence. Step outside into a private oasis where native olive and palm trees, grape vines, and a citrus grove surround the pristine saltwater pool and spa, all set against breathtaking mountain views. Thoughtfully designed pergolas illuminated by bistro-style lighting create an inviting setting for alfresco dining, while a Weber char-broil 5-burner grill ensures effortless outdoor entertaining. Every detail is crafted for comfort and convenience, from the Ecobee smart system with dual-zone climate control to leased solar power for energy efficiency, an EV Level 2 plug for electric vehicle charging, and a spacious two-car garage with additional driveway parking. Ideally located just moments from downtown Palm Springs, golf courses, tennis clubs, museums, galleries, and fine dining, this estate offers both seclusion and accessibility. Beyond its architectural sophistication and luxurious amenities, the home is a study in effortless desert living, where mornings begin in sun-drenched tranquility and evenings unfold beneath a sky ablaze with stars. Whether hosting intimate gatherings by the pool, unwinding in the private sauna, or savoring alfresco meals framed by towering palms and majestic mountain vistas, every space is designed to evoke a sense of balance, beauty, and refinement. Exuding timeless desert luxury, this estate seamlessly blends architectural integrity with contemporary indulgence, offering a retreat that is unmistakably Palm Springs.

Low maintenance desert landscaping with lemon, lime, and grapefruit trees pairs beautifully with the setting. You'll enjoy close proximity to Uptown Palm Springs and coveted neighborhoods including Little Tuscany and Vista Las Palmas. Once home to Hollywood actor Tom Neal, best known for his role in Detour, this property captures the enduring spirit of Palm Springs golden era living.

text: Experience luxury desert living at its finest with this fully updated and stylish 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offering a resort-style backyard and beautiful mountain views. text: Distinctive industrial-modern 3BD/2BA Palm Springs residence blending bold architectural design with exceptional indoor-outdoor living. Offering approximately 1,222 sq ft, this thoughtfully updated home showcases a cohesive mix of steel, glass, stainless steel, exposed cinderblock, finished concrete floors, raised high ceilings, and exposed ductwork throughout. Enter through a modern steel gate into a private front entry patio with direct access to a mature aloe garden, creating a striking arrival experience that sets the tone for the home's unique architectural style. Inside, the open-concept living space features custom built-in shelving, recessed lighting, and whole-home surround sound, creating a stylish yet functional environment. The remodeled kitchen features a dramatic quartz island, custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, abundant storage, and modern finishes throughout. The flexible floorplan includes two guest bedrooms, one currently configured as a home office with built-in workspace, while the primary suite offers sliding glass doors to a private patio, walk-through closet, and spa-inspired walk-in shower. Designed for true Palm Springs living, the outdoor spaces offer multiple entertaining and relaxation areas including a saltwater pool and spa, natural gas fire pit, bocce court, outdoor shower, built-in BBQ, raised garden beds, mature fruit trees, and potential RV parking. Additional upgrades include owned solar with 16 panels, 200-amp electrical service, high-efficiency HVAC, dual-pane energy-efficient doors and windows, custom window coverings, ample storage, and a ventilated two-car garage. Four additional solar panels previously used for pool/water heating, along with a whole-house evaporative cooler, remain in place for future use if desired. A rare opportunity to own a highly design-driven, energy-efficient Palm Springs property with exceptional character, functionality, and entertaining appeal. Seller financing option negotiable.

EV charging station near the RV parking area HVAC and mechanical systems are approximately five years old. The 2-car garage features a tiled floor and a mini-split system, making it ideal as a gym, studio, or additional entertaining space. Behind gates on the north side, you'll find RV parking with power, offering flexibility rarely found in this neighborhood. The foam roof was redone in 2021 with a transferable warranty, and the entire exterior was freshly painted in 2024, completing the package. A rare blend of architectural pedigree, thoughtful upgrades, and modern luxury this iconic Mid-Century residence is ready to be enjoyed for years to come.

text: MOTOR UP to the cul-de-sac for a closer look at this iconic 1960 Alexander, quintessential Palm Springs and a darling of the Modernism Tour. A striking breeze block wall fronts the home, making a bold midcentury statement while providing privacy and architectural presence from the street. One of the most coveted rooflines follows with deep overhangs, extra tall ceilings, clerestory windows, and an effortless indoor outdoor flow designed for shade, breezes, and postcard worthy mountain views. Its Garden Road locale is a headline all its own, perfectly positioned within the architecturally significant Racquet Club Estates. The open concept layout spills seamlessly into a resort style backyard that delivers serious wow, ultra private and fully fenced with multiple outdoor entertaining zones anchored by a built in BBQ with bar sink and dry bar, a sparkling saltwater pool and spa with waterfall, a lighted pergola perfect for evening gatherings, gas fire pit, and citrus trees that complete the desert playground. The open kitchen, featuring an island bar with beverage fridge, was built for hosting, while the living room's gas fireplace adds warmth and style. Bedrooms are thoughtfully separated for privacy with the primary suite opening directly to the pool terrace, while guest bedrooms two and three enjoy access to a spacious private garden retreat. Notable upgrades include OWNED SOLAR by HPE, modernist custom cabinetry in the kitchen and expanded dining area, a newer HVAC system, tankless water heater, and custom window coverings throughout. Located moments from the best of Uptown and Downtown Palm Springs shopping, dining, and entertainment, this home shines as a full time residence, weekend escape, or vacation rental (30+ days). More than almost any other builder, Alexander Homes helped cement Palm Springs as the capital of midcentury modern living, and today these homes are highly collectible, endlessly photographed, and always in demand.

text: Welcome to 901 Alejo Vista, a home that has been updated so carefully, you might think it had a beauty makeover in a high-end salon. Nestled behind the gates of Alejo Vista, you'll find just seventeen private residences--like a secret society of homes that are an easy stroll away from all the fun downtown has to offer, as well as the ever-popular Ruth Hardy Park. Now, 901 is the belle of the ball, situated in the coveted southwest corner. With no obstructions in sight, your private yard offers breathtaking views of downtown and the San Jacinto Mountains--perfect for sipping your morning coffee or practicing your ''look how fancy I am'' pose by the wrap-around pool and spa. Step inside, and you'll be wowed by this home's impressive upgrades, including first and second-floor primary suites that could host an entire family reunion. The open-concept living area is designed for entertaining, featuring custom built-ins, surround sound (both inside and out for those patio parties!), custom lighting, a cozy fireplace, and large-scale tile floors. You'll flow effortlessly into the dining area, which has a custom bar with stunning waterfall quartz counters--because who doesn't need a little waterfall in their life? The chef's kitchen is nothing short of a culinary wonderland, equipped with high-end, integrated Dacor appliances, sleek matte black cabinets, and custom quartz counters. There's even a custom stainless sink with a fancy Brizo faucet and a built-in glass rinse area, because washing veggies just got way more exciting! Oh, and the Tom Dixon lighting and under-cabinet power outlets? Just consider them the cherry on top! The modern stainless steel cable staircase leads you to a cozy loft area perfect for TV lounging and more custom built-ins--who knew storage could be so stylish? Venturing further upstairs will lead you to the primary suite that would impress even the fussiest buyer. Holly Hunt wall coverings meet wood slat walls, while black caviar trim and custom black ceilings scream glamour. And let's talk about the primary spa bath--a space so liberating, it's like a mini-vacation every single day. Featuring a spacious custom spa tub and a marble/steam shower with double shower heads (because who wants to wait in line?), along with a 20-foot double vanity that practically gives you a runway to prep for the day. Plus, there's this impressive walk-in closet to ensure you never wear the same outfit twice--a much-needed feature for the fashion-forward!

text: Enormous beautifully renovated 3 bedroom home with separate 1 bed/1 bath GUEST HOUSE in Palm Springs. The Guest House features a separate private walkway, gate and entrance as well as a full kitchen and washer/dryer. Built in 2004, this home has been lovingly maintained and upgraded. The large terrazzo tile flooring extends throughout the entire home. The spacious open floor plan brings the kitchen, living room and dining room together for inclusion for all. This home is spacious and boasts an open kitchen that flows into the great room, which is anchored by a fireplace and tempting views of the private pool/spa area. The large gourmet cook's kitchen includes an large central island with counter seating, Butler's pantry/coffee station, dry goods pantry, Bosch appliances, gas cooktop and modern tile backsplash. The primary suite is EXPANSIVE with a full office/private living room/media room attached at the back. With a small change, this room could even be a 5th bedroom or 2nd casita as it has its own private entrance. The primary bath includes a stand alone tub, large shower, dual sink floating vanity, appropriately sized expansive mirror, separate water closet and walk-in closet with custom shelving. Two guest suites share the guest bath also with stunning dual sink vanity and matching impressive custom mirror. Views of the pool and spa can be seen from almost every room through dual pane windows and sliding doors. Energy efficiency was well considered with multiple AC zones, enhanced ceiling fans and 42 solar panels. Parking includes an oversized 2-car garage and a driveway with room for 3 cars. Other amenities include water conditioner system, outdoor shower, tankless water heater and a separate laundry room with upper and lower cabinets, sink, counter space and window with a mountain view. THE CASITA has a separate PRIVATE walkway and entrance. Inside, a bedroom, living room, stackable laundry, desk/dining table, kitchen with cabinets, counters, refrigerator, sink and disposal, gas range, oven and microwave. The owners have rented this casita out casually making about $20,000 per year income. Alternatively, live and use the casita while renting out the main house for even greater income. In the back yard, the pool and spa with waterfall takes the main focus. Don't miss the hardline gas grill, outdoor shower, pet friendly grass areas and entertainment area for outdoor table tennis and games. The versatility of the homes features will make you feel at home immediately upon arrival. On land that you own. No HOA. Solar system includes 42 panels w 13.73kW.

text: Experience the best of Palm Springs living in this beautifully remodeled desert retreat, ideally situated in the highly desirable Desert Park Estates neighborhood. Priced below market value for this highly desirable area, this property presents an incredible opportunity to own a beautifully updated Palm Springs home at an exceptional value. Step inside this beautifully remodeled modern home, where a bright, open floor plan, clean contemporary design, and an abundance of windows create an immediate sense of space and style. Natural light pours throughout the home, highlighting the crisp finishes and creating a fresh, airy, and welcoming atmosphere. The open-concept living areas flow seamlessly from one space to the next, with multiple windows and easy access to the backyard oasis, beautifully connecting indoor and outdoor living. Whether entertaining guests, relaxing at home, or stepping outside for a day by the pool and spa, the layout is perfectly suited to the Palm Springs lifestyle. Spend warm summer days cooling off in the pool and soaking up the Palm Springs sunshine, then slip into the spa for a relaxing evening dip beneath the desert sky. Whether entertaining friends, lounging poolside, or enjoying a quiet evening at home, this backyard was made for enjoying the best of desert living. Another standout feature is the two large, spacious driveways, providing plenty of room for an RV, trailers, additional vehicles, or all your desert toys. Double iron gates provide direct access to the backyard, making parking and storage exceptionally convenient and adding even more versatility to this expansive property. Located just minutes from downtown Palm Springs, world-class dining, shopping, golf, and entertainment are all within easy reach, while the peaceful residential setting provides a welcome retreat. Bright, modern, and spacious, this beautiful home offers an exceptional opportunity to embrace the Palm Springs lifestyle and make your own slice of desert paradise.

The home offers four generously sized bedrooms plus a versatile bonus room that can function as a fifth bedroom, office, or media space. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring direct backyard access with a view of the San Jacinto mountains, a dedicated workspace, and a luxurious en-suite bathroom with a soaking tub, separate walk-in shower, and ample closet space. A standout feature is the detached casita, offering its own private entrance, full en-suite bath, and adjacent to the outdoor pool. Step outside to your private resort-style backyard, where indoor-outdoor living truly comes to life. Enjoy a sparkling pool and spa, a fire pit conversation space, and a covered patio ideal for al fresco dining- all set against the stunning San Jacinto mountain views. Additional highlights include three full bathrooms plus a powder room, a dedicated laundry room, attached 2-car garage, and ample storage throughout. The home is turnkey and ready for immediate enjoyment as a primary residence or second home, while also offering exceptional potential to elevate it further with renovations to create a truly bespoke, luxury desert retreat tailored to your vision. Situated on a generous 0.24-acre lot just minutes from downtown Palm Springs, this property delivers the perfect balance of privacy, functionality, and desert luxury.

text: Experience the perfect blend of modern luxury and iconic design in this beautifully renovated and expanded 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom desert retreat originally crafted by acclaimed architect Hugh Kaptur. Step outside to your private backyard paradise an inviting, updated saltwater pool and spa surrounded by mature landscaping and multiple lounging areas complete with fire table. This home is fully equipped with smart home technology, automated pool controls, a solar energy system, and EV charging, delivering energy efficiency and modern convenience. text: This stunning, elegant modern home with panoramic mountain views is in the gated community of Escena. Built in 2020, the 2,561 sq. ft. residence offers luxurious living space on a corner lot situated on the 2nd fairway of the esteemed Escena golf course in Palm Springs. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, this highly upgraded home showcases an open-concept design with dramatic 12-foot ceilings and expansive living spaces filled with natural light. Elegant La Faenza Italian porcelain tile flooring flows throughout, creating a sleek, modern aesthetic. The chef's kitchen showcases premium KitchenAid commercial-grade stainless steel appliances, an oversized center island, quartz countertops, marble tile backsplash, upgraded fixtures and under-cabinet lighting. The heart of the home opens beautifully to the outdoors with a retractable wall of La Cantina bifold stacking doors creating a seamless transition to the patio and pool area - perfect for true indoor-outdoor living. The primary suite features a spa-inspired bath with an expansive walk-in rain shower, custom Carrara marble tile walls and heated floors. The suite is completed with dual vanities, a large walk-in closet designed by California Closets and automated blackout blinds. A second guest bedroom offers privacy and comfort with its own ensuite bath, dual vanity, custom shower, and blackout blinds. The third bedroom is versatile - ideal as an office or guest space - highlighted by a custom 9-foot solid double door entry. Step outside to your private resort-style backyard complete with a pool and spillover spa, enhanced by a Pentair pool and spa automation system for effortless control, a generous 720 sq ft of pet-friendly artificial turf, providing low-maintenance beauty and play space. Both the front and back yards have been newly landscaped, and the front door & custom front gate includes an internet-enabled lock for modern security and convenience. Additional features include Control 4 home automation system, water filtration & softening system, separate laundry room with built-in cabinetry and utility sink, and a 2-car garage with an insulated door & level 2 EV car charger. Set directly on the golf course within one of Palm Springs' most desirable gated communities, this home delivers contemporary elegance, smart technology, and true resort-style living.

text: Dramatic mountain views, an extra-private and spacious corner lot, and a coveted location on the border of Palm Springs' Little Tuscany and Chino Canyon neighborhoods are merely the beginning of the advantages you will enjoy at this move-in-ready Mid-Century home. Sequestered behind gates and manicured hedges, the residence maintains its original 1968 appeal while carefully layering contemporary enhancements. It easily accommodates full-time desert living and has been featured as a successful vacation rental. Two bathrooms display large-format polished-stone floor tile and shower surrounds, floating vanities and, in the primary suite, two sinks. The owners suite is further enhanced with a sitting area and a large window with impressive mountain views. Two secondary bedrooms are also featured, including one with patio access. Powered by a rooftop solar system, this welcoming home is appointed with an attached two-car garage, on-trend tile and carpet, Mid-Century-inspired lighting fixtures, recessed lighting and custom paint. Custom metal gates open to the driveway and main entrance, while the expansive yard hosts a classic kidney-style pool with tanning shelf, spa and spillway. The fashionable restaurants, shops and resorts located within Palm Springs' Uptown Design District are moments away, and downtown is enviably convenient.

text: WOW! Mount San Jacinto feels close enough to touch at this ultra private walled and gated 1940s era hacienda offering four bedrooms on Fee Land with owned SOLAR and currently eligible for the City's Short Term Rental permit. Covered porches frame dramatic mountain views while the resort style grounds feature a pool, spa, fountains and a Baja style sunning shelf. The living room features an amazing picture window taking in pool and mountain views, while interiors flow beautifully between living spaces with a wet bar, fireplace and a spacious light filled kitchen with a breakfast area designed for effortless indoor outdoor living. Just steps away, an outdoor kitchen with barbecue, pergola and tiled terrace creates an exceptional setting for entertaining. Bedrooms are thoughtfully separated across distinct wings, including an ensuite primary retreat with fireplace, sitting area, direct pool access and a beautifully tiled bath. Guest bedrooms two three and four occupy their own wing, with one currently configured as an office featuring handsome built in bookcases. A motorized gate opens to covered carport parking, while a second gated driveway leads to a two car garage with an attached bonus room ideal for a home gym or office. Low maintenance desert landscaping includes mature citrus trees, and the proximity to Uptown Palm Springs is exceptional, with Chino Canyon, Little Tuscany and Vista Las Palmas among the most sought after neighborhoods for secondary and vacation home buyers. Falling in love with these views comes easy.

Set on an oversized corner lot surrounded by lush landscaping, citrus trees, and a privacy hedge, this home captures the essence of Palm Springs living. Just moments from Downtown Palm Springs, acclaimed restaurants, boutiques, and Ruth Hardy Park, this is an amazing opportunity to own a piece of Palm Springs history, reimagined for modern living.

text: Perched west of Palm Canyon Drive in the Little Tuscany neighborhood-known for its eclectic mix of old Spanish bungalows and iconic midcentury modern masterpieces-lies this truly unique residence. 2555 E. Junipero features an original masonry bungalow circa 1947, masterfully blended with a modern glass-walled wing added in 2007. The two wings speak a language of texture and openness, beckoning visitors to enjoy classic Palm Springs indoor/outdoor living. Upon entering, soaring walls of glass create a living space that feels both inside and out. The room is anchored by a cozy fireplace with a formed, polished-concrete hearth, while clerestory windows frame stunning views of the San Jacinto Mountains. Moving deeper into the home, you are enveloped in the warmth of the original brick dining area, punctuated by a floor-to-ceiling sliding door that further blurs the boundary between indoors and out. A light, bright, well stocked kitchen offers stainless steel appliances and handsome dark granite countertops. A handsome dimensional paneled breakfast bar separates the kitchen from the dining area. A cozy study provides a perfect retreat for quieter moments, and a large, open-beamed bedroom occupies the southeast end of the home. Accessed from the pool, the west wing offers a spacious entertaining room flanked by a fireplace and wine fridge. This light-filled space is currently configured as a game and family room, with clerestory windows capturing southern mountain views. To the west lies a seductive primary suite with a soaring corner window, sliding doors to the pool, floor-to-ceiling built-in dressing cabinetry, and an ensuite bath with dual sinks, a large shower with floor-to-ceiling window, and a separate commode. A second ensuite bedroom on the opposite side of the game room provides excellent separation and privacy. All rooms open to the sparkling salt water pool, elevated spa, and seating area, creating multiple spaces for entertaining-each enjoying captivating mountain views. Thoughtful updates include solar. The home offers remarkable flexibility in how it can be lived and enjoyed. Come experience this truly special and one-of-a-kind residence.

text: Welcome to the Powell House, a Palm Springs sanctuary where a relaxed desert vibe meets a crisp, modern evolution. This home is designed for those who want to lean into the easygoing art of desert living. Start your mornings hand-picking fresh citrus for breakfast. Spend your afternoons floating in the pool or relaxing in the spa, both of which feature upgraded technology and a new heater for year-round comfort. After a dip, rinse off from the beautifully tiled outdoor shower before heading to the covered patio to lounge or dine al fresco. This backyard feels like your personal resort, featuring a redesigned landscape of desert-native plantings and cacti, all illuminated by custom lighting once the stars come out. The front of the house has been updated with a clean, smooth appearance featuring a re-stuccoed facade and a full exterior paint refresh. Step inside to a home that is light and effortless, featuring seamless micro-cement floors and a modern look where the walls meet the floor without traditional baseboards. The heart of the home is the open-concept kitchen, where a wall was removed to create a social hub with a large island and updated cabinetry. Every corner has been touched by thoughtful upgrades, from the bathrooms that were taken down to the studs for a full remodel to the primary bedroom, which is now a bright retreat thanks to a re-opened window and easy access to the large side yard. When desert nights turn chilly, curl up in front of the inviting fireplace and relax. Beyond the look of the home, the "bones" are just as solid, featuring a solar-compatible electrical panel, updated kitchen and bath electrical for total peace of mind. Close to downtown art galleries, restaurants, shopping and all things cool that Palm Springs has to offer. Whether you're hosting friends, hanging with family or enjoying a quiet sunset, the Powell House is ready for you to move in and enjoy.

The gourmet chef's kitchen features Bertazzoni appliances, upgraded DESIGNER CABINETS, counters and backsplash, a wine refrigerator and the signature huge center island. The upgraded cabinets are also found in all the bathrooms as well as upgraded tile on the bathroom floors and walls. The primary suite - which is located to the rear of the home away from the street, has extensive luxury built-ins in the closet. The low maintenance backyard has turf and GORGEOUS VIEWS OF MT SAN JACINTO. There's extra solar panels on the roof and a power wall back up on the exterior of the house. As a member of the HOA you have access to The Miralon Club which features two large pools and a spa, a well equipped gym with gorgeous views for working out plus a separate Yoga/Pilates studio. Put 845 Nugget Ln on your list to see because you will want to live here!

Sleek finishes & upgrades include Porcelanosa tile flooring, Hans Grohe fixtures, Viking appliances, newer Bosch dishwasher, Caesarstone countertops, and a modern gas fireplace - all adding to the allure of this home's contemporary architecture. The main living area boasts Fleetwood sliding glass doors, opening to an expansive front patio entertaining area featuring custom pavers and a beautiful pebble tec pool with raised spa and water feature. Other main level features include a guest bedroom with an adjacent full bathroom, and a stackable washer/dryer in laundry closet. The impressive, spacious upper-level primary bedroom suite showcases beautiful western and southern mountain views, a large walk-in closet, and a spa-like bathroom with dual vanities, and a large walk-in double shower with a soaking tub. Rounding out the top floor is another guest bedroom with ensuite bathroom and pretty mountain views. For your listening pleasure, speakers were installed in the great room, primary bedroom, and guest bedroom. For energy efficiency, this home has a 24-panel solar system that is owned. The interior and exterior of the home have been freshly painted. The 2-car garage has been insulated, has a tankless water heater and plenty of storage cabinets. The Morrison homes are on fee land (you own it) and have low HOA dues that include building property insurance and earthquake insurance! The community's premier location is close to downtown, and all that Palm Springs has to offer. Don't miss this beautifully appointed home in the gated community of The Morrison in heart of Palm Springs.

text: Modern Lines, Big Sky, and the Miralon Magic. Modernist inspired architecture and commanding San Jacinto Mountain views set the tone at gated Miralon where this newly built home delivers a south facing pool and spa plus a rare open view with no immediate neighbor to the south. The Miralon Club delivers a cafe, lounge, fitness center, yoga studio, lap pool, family pool + spa, cabanas, bocce ball, demonstration kitchen, fire pits, and a meeting room for residents who work from home. Uptown Palm Springs dining and shopping are just minutes away.

text: This stunning Toll Brothers "Aldea" floor plan home in Escena blends modern design with effortless indoor-outdoor living. Featuring 2 bedrooms plus a versatile den/office, 2.5 baths, and soaring ceilings with clerestory windows. The open layout showcases a chef's kitchen with quartz countertops, custom backsplash, a unique center island with breakfast bar, and built-in KitchenAid appliances that connect seamlessly to the expansive great room and dining area. Tall sliding doors flood the home with natural light and open to multiple outdoor spaces, including a South-facing patio with private Spa and barbecue area as well as a second covered patio with private gas fire pit. The spacious primary suite offers a walk-in closet, dual vanities, soaking tub, and oversized shower, while the junior ensuite provides privacy for guests. Additional highlights include a powder room, separate laundry with sink, an attached 2-car garage, custom window treatments on Low-E windows, an energy-efficient leased solar system, a whole house water softener, a reverse osmosis system for drinking water, and a tankless water heater. Best of all, this property is available turnkey furnished, per inventory list. Set within Escena's beautifully landscaped, gated community anchored by a Nicklaus-designed championship golf course, residents enjoy access to a lovely clubhouse and restaurant with a terrace that offers striking views, dog parks, and scenic walking paths all with low HOA dues.

Call today for more information and private showings.

text: Located in the serene Windy Cove neighborhood of unincorporated Palm Springs, this home blends retro charm with thoughtful modern upgrades that celebrate its mid-century inspired architecture. Step through custom architectural metal gates and vintage double doors into an inviting open floor plan filled with natural light and uninterrupted views of the majestic San Jacinto mountain ridge. The living and dining rooms feature new high-quality hardwood panel flooring and a dramatic natural stone fireplace, the perfect centerpiece for cozy desert evenings. The efficient galley-style kitchen offers a large bar for casual dining, freshly repainted cabinetry, and updated fixtures that add a modern touch. The primary suite, showcasing beautiful mountain views, includes an en-suite bath with a vintage countertop and ample closet space. Two additional bedrooms offer generous closets, and the hall bath also featuring a vintage countertop provides easy access from the main living area. Every window throughout the home has been replaced with energy-efficient dual-pane glass and custom made sun/security shades for year-round comfort. Outdoor living is effortless with a fully enclosed front and back yard, covered patio, low-maintenance desert landscaping, and irrigation. The front breeze block patio provides privacy and style, complete with a gas fire pit ideal for stargazing on cool desert nights. Out back, under the shaded patio enjoy sunrises and sunsets that paint the sky, with wildlife often visible in the open field beyond. The two-car garage is a dream for organization lovers, featuring custom shelving, overhead storage, and an insulated door. Additional upgrades include recent roof resealing, all new light fixtures throughout, fresh interior paint, twice-yearly HVAC maintenance, vintage wallpaper accent in the laundry room with storage, gas indoor fireplace and outdoor gas grill for easy entertaining. Just 6 minutes from downtown Palm Springs, you'll enjoy the best of both worlds, peaceful desert living with quick access to shopping, dining, nightlife, and endless outdoor recreation. Listen to coyotes under the stars, spot riders on nearby horse trails, and experience the authentic desert lifestyle from the comfort of this thoughtfully updated mid-century inspired gem.

text: The most exquisite Midcentury Modern home ever available in Vista Las Palmas has come to market for the most discerning buyer. Originally built by the famed Alexander Company and renovated by Christopher Kennedy for the Palm Springs Modernism Tour, this architectural gem blends timeless design with luxurious modernism. The home welcomes you with an expansive open floor plan featuring a dramatic floor-to-ceiling marble fireplace, exposed beam ceilings, and Cantina-style hideaway doors. These seamlessly connect the living and dining areas to a stunning poolside courtyard, showcasing views of the San Jacinto Mountains directly behind the home. The main living area is spacious with a gas fireplace. Adjacent is the dining space with a handcrafted wood table that comfortably seats eight and opens to a chef's kitchen. The striking marble center island doubles as prep space and includes bar seating for two. Large windows flood the kitchen with natural light and frame views of the Las Palmas neighborhood. Five bedrooms offer luxury accommodations, including four in the main house and one in the attached guest casita. The primary suite, located on the west side of the home, features sliding glass doors opening to the serene backyard. Its spa-inspired ensuite includes a dual-sink vanity, oversized walk-in shower, stand-alone soaking tub, and sliding doors leading to a private garden with a walk-in closet. On the opposite wing are three additional bedrooms and a second master suite with direct pool access through sliding doors. This suite features ample closet space luxurious marble bathroom with an oversized shower, dual rain heads. The additional two guest rooms share a well-appointed bathroom with a single vanity and glass-enclosed shower. The fifth bedroom, located in an attached guest casita, offers ultimate privacy. It includes a private entrance, mini-fridge, its own A/C unit, and an ensuite bath with a glass-panel shower and single vanity. The backyard is a true showstopper. Set against a mountain backdrop, the sparkling pool and spa are surrounded by lush landscaping and resort-style amenities including a 3-hole mini putting green, out door shower, six loungers, a bocce court, shaded dining area for eight, gas barbecue, and firepit. Furniture, accessories and artwork is available for purchase outside of escrow. When searching for the perfect property in beautiful Palm Springs, LOCATION is everything, and 190 W San Marco Way delivers on every level. This property represents one of the most affordable opportunities to own a home on one of Palm Springs' best streets, and it shows. After a night out with friends or family, pull through your private motorized gate into the spacious west-side parking area , which can accommodate several cars. With nearly 2,000 sq. ft. of living space, offered turnkey furnished, no HOA, excellent short-term rental potential, and you own the land, this home checks every box. And finally, San Marco Way itself deserves special mention, clean, stunning, beautifully maintained, and lined with houses that showcase exceptional curb appeal and classic desert landscaping.

text: Experience quintessential Palm Springs living in this iconic 1960 Wexler & Harrison designed home. Located in El Rancho Vista Estates, one of the city's most original and celebrated midcentury neighborhoods, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath 'Capri' model seamlessly blends timeless design with thoughtful modern touches. From the moment you arrive the home's architectural pedigree is unmistakable. Signature Wexler elements like clerestory windows, shadow block enclosed patio, and the distinctive downturned eave roofline define the classic facade. Inside, polished concrete floors, 9-foot ceilings, and an open living room layout create a spacious and sophisticated space. The stylish kitchen features quartz countertops, a waterfall edge eat-in bar, and a large dining area which opens to the private front patio with breathtaking views, perfect for morning coffee or evening entertaining! A wall of glass in the living room floods the space with natural light and highlights the lush backyard landscape. Just off of the living area, a versatile bonus room can serve as a speakeasy inspired bar, a cozy den, or a home office. Two guest bedrooms and a hall bath are situated on the east side of the home, while the generous primary suite offers direct access to the backyard through both the large slider and en-suite bath. Step outside into your own private desert oasis with a custom curved fire pit, an elevated spa spilling into the sparkling pool, mature landscaping, and postcard-worthy views of Mt. San Jacinto. This home has been featured in multiple design publications, and El Rancho Vista Estates has been called a 'must-see' neighborhood on Modernism Week tours. A rare opportunity to own a piece of architectural history in one of Palm Springs' most coveted communities.

text: Experience timeless Palm Springs elegance in this private 1936 mini-estate, set on over half an acre of fee simple land with sweeping western mountain views. Surrounded by lush, botanical garden-style grounds adorned with mature fruit trees, the property embodies both serenity and sophistication. The main residence offers three bedrooms (two ensuite) and three baths, with a vaulted great room anchored by a dramatic floor-to-ceiling native stone fireplace-a striking centerpiece reminiscent of the desert ranch homes from Hollywood's golden era. An attached casita provides a private retreat with its own private entrance, kitchen, bath, and dedicated parking. While already inviting, the property presents a unique opportunity for thoughtful renovation. With updates, its historic character and resort-style setting can be elevated even further, blending Palm Springs ranch charm with modern luxury. Outdoors, a saltwater pool, shaded dining area, large grassy area and vibrant mature landscaping create a secluded haven for relaxation and entertaining on a grand scale. An owned solar system with 24 panels ensures modern efficiency without compromise. An oasis of calm that's only minutes from downtown Palm Springs, this turnkey furnished estate offers effortless access to fine dining, boutique shopping, hiking, and cultural attractions. A rare opportunity to own a retreat where history, beauty, and future potential converge. The possibilities are endless.
