text: Welcome to 2280 N. Sunrise Way, an updated gated estate nestled on a half-acre in central Palm Springs. This custom single-level home boasts breathtaking mountain views and a separate guest house. The custom single-level home offers over 3,900 square feet of living space, featuring high ceilings, a dual side fireplace that connects the living room to the kitchen, and a culinary space that includes a large granite island, stainless appliances, and a dining area. The three en-suite bedrooms include a spacious primary suite with a spa-style bath, dual vanities, a soaking tub, a walk-in shower, and a custom closet. A separate media room with built-in sound and theater seating provides entertainment options for relaxation or hosting events. In 2021, an attached but separate guest house with a chef's kitchen, high-end finishes, in-unit laundry, and a private entrance was added. This guest house is ideal for accommodating guests, multi-generational living, or generating rental income. Outside, the resort-style backyard features a 52-foot saltwater pool, waterfall, spa, firepit, mountain views, and an expansive patio framed by mature desert landscaping and custom lighting. Additional features include Tesla-owned solar with battery backup, an EV charger, and a finished two-car garage. The property is private, polished, and move-in ready.

text: The Alexander Residence 1960 - William Krisel architect. Prolific Southern California developers and society patrons Robert Helene Alexander of the Alexander Construction Co. commissioned the spaceship-like dynamic winged home as there personal residence, a testament to engineering and daring avant-garde design that attracted Look Magazine in 1962 to declare it The House Of Tomorrow. 1967 the newlyweds Elvis and Priscilla Presley famously leased the house lending it the name The Elvis Honeymoon Hideaway Home. A provocative entry path ushers you into an interior sunken party pad flanked by angular stacked stoned walls, glass, and a low-slung curved upholstered banquet embracing a futuristic shaped fireplace hood and floating hearth. A raised dining platform connects to a custom circular kitchen and private den with fireplace, the grounds unfold seamlessly through a wall of glass to the expansive exterior terracing, pool, and breathtaking mountain views.A lavish primary suite is reached via a grand staircase to a private glassed perch featuring panoramic views. A generous dressing room/bathroom is concealed by built-in wardrobe closets centered around a circular tub, and an intimate balcony is accessible allowing for a discrete observation deck. All bedrooms, three lower and one upper, are en-suite, two sharing an exterior terrace. In 2021 the home went under a thoughtful renovation with restored original architectural details of stone and poured terrazzo floors, bringing the house back to it's original intent and receiving a Class-One historic designation. 2023 brought additional improvements of a higher level of luxury and sophistication. This iconic house is in the Vista Las Palmas neighborhood and is the largest Alexander-built home with the largest pool and best lot. This Special Home Is Being Sold with many of the pieces seen in the photos. text: Perched high above Palm Springs in the sought-after Little Tuscany neighborhood, this striking example of modernist architecture offers a rare blend of privacy, scale, and breathtaking top of the world views. Masterfully sited to capture sweeping 360 degree vistas of the valley floor, desert expanse, and Mount San Jacinto, the home reflects the natural drama of the landscape itself. The hillside ascent builds quiet anticipation, culminating in an entry that reveals a sweeping desert panorama in unforgettable fashion. Conceived at the height of desert modernism and retaining original interior elements by legendary Palm Springs designer Steve Chase, the residence channels a spirit of casual California elegance. Its nearly 5, 400 square feet of living space is thoughtfully balanced, offering both grand entertaining areas and tranquil retreats. The pool terrace invites both leisurely afternoons in the sun and elegant evenings under desert skies. Additional features include a dedicated wine room, sauna, gallery-style architectural details, and original vein-cut honed travertine floors that lend a timeless, desert-appropriate elegance throughout. Thoughtfully landscaped with mature palms, blooming bougainvillea, and sculptural cacti, the landscaping offers a vibrant counterpoint to the home's clean lines, layering texture and color into the hillside setting. Elevated in every sense, this residence redefines what it means to live above it all.

text: A truly special setting awaits at 4590 Esplanade, where lake, verdant golf course, and mountain views abound in almost 360 degrees. text: Framed by captivating San Jacinto Mountain views that enrich indoor/outdoor living, this exceptional Mid-Century Modern home embodies Palm Springs' world renowned architecture. One of only about 350 Jack Meiselman homes ever built, this rare 1956 post-and-beam residence was thoughtfully remodeled and improved with today's technology and modern conveniences while retaining its original MCM features. Floor-to-ceiling and clerestory windows bathe the single-level design with natural light and incredible views, classic tongue-and-groove ceilings are crowned by a new roof with extra insulation, polished concrete floors flow throughout, and the original floating fireplace adds undeniable cachet to the home. Approximately 1, 270SF with two bedrooms, two spa-style baths, and an open kitchen that showcases teak cabinetry, a vintage Western Holly oven, hidden appliances and quartz countertops, this nearly quarter acre lot also includes a semi-circular driveway with gorgeous desertscapes. The primary suite offers pool views, access to poolside patio, a large wardrobe and walk-in rain shower. Smart-home, central air-conditioning, custom lighting, security cameras, interior laundry and an attached two-car garage are featured. Enviably private with tall ficus hedges, the backyard displays a new pool with raised spa, outdoor dining fireplace and BBQ. This home has a highly successful rental history, making it a great fit if you are seeking an income property, a full-time residence, or both.

text: Experience elevated desert living in this gorgeous New Century Modern home located in the highly coveted gated community of The Morrison in Palm Springs. Situated on one of the largest lots in the community and boasting a fully-owned solar system, this 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom residence offers style, privacy, and a seamless connection to the outdoors, perfect for full-time living or a luxury getaway. Designed with clean lines and modern elegance, the open-concept layout is filled with natural light and showcases views of the San Jacinto Mountains and the beautifully landscaped grounds through walls of glass. At the heart of the home is a chef's kitchen, featuring quartz countertops, premium stainless-steel appliances, and a custom-expanded island that adds generous workspace and storageideal for entertaining. Of the four bedrooms, three are private suites, each with its own full bathroomincluding an attached casita with its own separate exterior entrance, perfect for guests, a home office, or multi-generational living. The primary suite, located on the upper level, offers beautiful mountain views, a spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. The fourth bedroom, located on the ground floor, sits adjacent to a full guest bathroom. Set on an expansive wraparound lot, the outdoor space is a true oasis, with multiple private yards designed for versatile and large-scale entertaining. Enjoy a sparkling saltwater pool and spa, built-in BBQ, fire pit, and several lounging and dining areas all surrounded by lush landscaping and framed by uninterrupted mountain vistas. Located just minutes from the energy of downtown Palm Springs, this home is a rare blend of sophisticated design, thoughtful layout, and resort-style living.

text: Experience the Essence of Palm Springs Living in the Historic Movie Colony. Situated in one of Palm Springs' most sought-after iconic neighborhoods, this exceptional residence presents a rare opportunity to own in the storied Movie Colony. Secluded and set behind mature hedges, the home offers a private retreat designed for both tranquil living and effortless entertaining. A cobalt-blue mosaic-tiled pool anchors the lush backyard, framed by towering palms and thoughtfully curated desert landscaping. French doors and clerestory windows fill the interiors with natural light, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces. The expansive open concept living and dining areas open onto the backyard pool, which features breathtaking views of the majestic San Jacinto Mountains. Whether you envision a full-time residence, an elegant weekend escape, or an investment with timeless appeal, this home captures the essence of the Palm Springs lifestyle. The Movie Colony, known for its glamorous past and celebrated midcentury modern architecture, offers tree-lined streets, lush gardens, and beautifully restored homesjust minutes from downtown's acclaimed dining, shopping, museums, and nightlife.

text: Nestled in the highly coveted Historic Tennis Club area, just a short walk from downtown Palm Springs, this private gated estate offers an exceptional living experience. Set on a gorgeous lot with a motorized gate and circular driveway, the home boasts complete privacy. Topping the list of upgrades is owned solar, resulting in little to no electric bills. Dual paned windows and sliders highlight the gorgeous views, and allow natural light to flood the interiors, creating a bright and airy feel. The beautifully renovated interior features a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor spaces, with ceramic tile wood floors throughout, which creates a cohesive modern look. The heart of the home is the chef's kitchen designed for entertaining, complete with a large island, ample storage, pull out shelves, and sleek quartz countertops. High end stainless steel appliances, including a Viking refrigerator and range, Marvel wine refrigerator, Miele dishwasher, built in microwave and chilling drawer, ensure both style and function. The spacious living room is anchored by a charming masonry block gas fireplace, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Each of the four bedrooms is an ensuite, offering privacy and comfort. The spa like bathrooms feature floating vanities, three of which have double sinks, under lighting, quartz countertops, modern faucets, and tile walk in showers. Outside, the backyard is a true oasis featuring a vibrant saltwater mosaic pool and spa, breathtaking west mountain views, a fire pit, dining area, and two day beds perfect for lounging in the sun. Low maintenance desert landscaping completes this serene outdoor retreat. With the option to obtain a short term rental permit (the neighborhood is currently well under the 20 percent vacation rental density cap at time of listing), this property presents an outstanding opportunity as a primary residence, second home, investment property, or vacation rental. No HOA and you own the land. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of Palm Springs history in this iconic neighborhood!

text: This one-of-a-kind elegant modern home with breathtaking views is in the gated community of Escena! Built in 2021, this 3-bedroom (+ office), 4-bathroom home offers 2, 598 sq. ft. of luxurious living space on an expanded premium lot with over 135 ft. of golf course frontage. Situated on the 16th fairway of the acclaimed Escena Golf Course, the property boasts phenomenal panoramic 180 degree western and northern mountain views. With over $500K in builder and owner upgrades, the home features 12 ft. ceilings, clerestory windows, upgraded interior doors, designer light fixtures, a chef's kitchen with a Quartz island, extended kitchen cabinetry & Jenn Air appliances. Additional highlights include motorized blinds, powder room, laundry room with a sink & cabinetry, 2-car garage & owned solar. Experience luxury, modern convenience, and spectacular views in this special Palm Springs home!

text: Are you looking for a STREAMLINED modern home where EVERYTHING is right? Where details matter and a passion for design is Dwell Magazine worthy? The approach to technology is just as exciting and includes OWNED SOLAR. Vaulted ceilings, amazing finishes, exceptional indoor-outdoor flow onto patios framing the home, and San Jacinto Mountain views! Clerestory windows work their magic overhead. Modern cabinets, professional grade appliances, and a STUNNING over-sized island are highlights in the spacious kitchen with walk-in pantry. There's a dedicated outdoor dining area with barbecue grill + bar, poolside firepit, and refreshing 55-foot saltwater lap pool + spa. The flow from one patio to the other works beautifully on the entertaining front. Back inside, bedrooms enjoy a nice separation with an Ensuite Primary enjoying easy access to the pool. The primary bath shines with separate vanities, separate tub + shower. The oversized walk-in closet is a delight and features direct access to the utility room. On the opposite end of the home, Guest Bedroom #2 and Guest Bedroom #3 share a full bath. Powder bath is located along the main hall as well. Take the Matterport VIRTUAL TOUR for a better sense of flow. Notable upgrades include designer curated outdoor lighting and desert-wise landscaping, water leak detection system (flume) for the home and dedicated leak detection in the laundry room (Notion), sensors on garage door & back door (Notion), Smart locks on outdoor gates and main door (Lockly) with camera, TV 5.1 Sound system (Denim), Kitchen sound system (Niim), security cameras with human detection (Onwote 4K poe system) and pool solar panels (SPH 600 sqft Swimjoy panels). Energy saving features include tankless water heater, artificial turf, low-E windows, and owned Solar. The best of Palm Springs is a short hop away and The Escena Golf Club + Grill are icing on the cake. Enjoy it all!

Come see! You'll be delighted... it truly is Smashing!

text: Step into a rare jewel of Palm Springs history the best value in Vista Las Palmas awaits! This isn't just a home; it's a legacy, one of the original model homes envisioned by architectural icons William Krisel and Dan Palmer for the Alexander Construction Company in 1957. Known as Model C-1, the Bermuda-Stepped-Roof with its striking Porte Cochere carport, this masterpiece reigns supreme on a coveted oversized corner lot the largest offering of the original model homes, featuring 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms radiating timeless mid-century swagger. Reimagined from the ground up by Desert Avant Gard Design, one of the premier mid-century design teams, every detail honors Krisel's visionary blueprint. The sellers even consulted the legend himself documentation in hand ensuring this home's soul remains as authentic as its style is breathtaking. Modern upgrades include all-new electrical systems, updated electric panels, and comprehensive copper plumbing throughout, ensuring both safety and reliability. Picture yourself commanding the spotlight at the jaw-dropping 15-foot quartzite center island, the heart of a true chef's dream kitchen. This culinary haven boasts top-tier Thermador professional appliances, double dishwashers and multiple ovens (convection, air-fry, steam, and microwave), all Wi-Fi-enabled for effortless control from your smartphone. Every inch sparkles with high-end fixtures and fittings, blending retro cool with modern luxury. Beyond the walls, the backyard unfolds as your private desert sanctuary anchored by a shimmering saltwater pool and spa, elevated by two flickering fire pits, and wrapped in fresh, low-maintenance landscaping with pet-friendly astroturf and owned solar for guilt-free, low-cost living. This is more than a home it's the ultimate Palm Springs lifestyle, an entertainer's paradise where rugged mountains meet swaying palms, and every sunset feels like a curated event. Your mid-century modern dream is calling.

text: Built in 1960, this sophisticated modern mid-century Wexler home is located in the heart of ''The Movie Colony''. text: This highly upgraded and dramatic customized Escena home is sited on hole #2, with beautiful mountain views, sunrises and sunsets across two lush fairways. This is a Smart Home with leased solar. Escena offers a beautifully landscaped, guard-gated community with access to the clubhouse, golf course, dog parks, and low HOAs.

Bedroom Four, which is currently enjoyed as a private media room, is adjacent to a hallway bathroom. Inside laundry room attached two car garage with gated driveway!

text: Perched high above Araby Cove, 2550 South Araby Road is a rare and storied treasure and one of Palm Springs iconic Rock Houses, originally built in 1929 by R. Lee Miller. This historic residence is a singular blend of architecture, history, and landscape, offering sweeping panoramic views across the desert floor and exceptional privacy. Access is provided via a private road with restricted entry. Designated a Class One Historic Landmark by the City of Palm Springs, the home showcases handcrafted artistry throughout. Stone walls rise organically from the mountainside, while original details remain beautifully intact, including hand carved doors and windows, custom shelving, exposed ceiling beams, ironwork door latches, handmade fireplace tools, and two original fireplaces, one of which includes a preserved stove pipe. A hidden room concealed behind a bookcase adds intrigue, and a deeply personal historical detail remains etched into the stone, as the original owner, Perle Martin Wheeler, carved her name into a nook in 1931. Respectfully honoring the home's architectural legacy, the current owners acquired the property in late 2024 and completed a thoughtful transformation, bringing the residence into the modern era while preserving its soul. Extensive upgrades include updated plumbing, electrical, and HVAC systems, new appliances, an EV charger, and infrastructure improvements throughout the property. The roof was fully replaced in August 2022, providing long term durability. The main residence features one bedroom and two bathrooms, complemented by two detached studio casitas, each with its own en suite bathroom. These spaces offer exceptional flexibility and are ideal for guests, multigenerational living, creative use, or private retreats. Meandering pathways, updated irrigation, and curated desert landscaping create a serene environment where native wildlife and natural beauty take center stage. A morning walk along the northern path reveals the desert awakening from the rock garden below. The extensive desert landscaping was thoughtfully designed by renowned Palm Springs landscape consultant Paul Ortega, an expert in desert horticulture and water management, and President Emeritus and Co Founder of the Desert Horticultural Society of the Coachella Valley. This historic property allows short term rentals, a rare benefit for a Class One designation. In addition, Class One homes in Palm Springs may qualify for Mills Act contracts, which can offer potential property tax benefits. Buyer to verify. text: Set across 28 acres of private hillside in Palm Springs' coveted Mesa neighborhood, this extraordinary 7 bedroom, 11 bathroom estate once enjoyed by actress and entrepreneur Suzanne Somers stands as one of the most storied residential compounds in the desert. Just minutes from downtown yet worlds away in privacy and serenity, the property unfolds as a series of terraces, gardens, and architectural retreats woven into the natural landscape of Mount San Jacinto. Originally established in the 1920s and thoughtfully expanded over time, the estate encompasses approximately 7,280 square feet of living space across multiple structures, including the main residence and a collection of guest villas. Meandering pathways, secluded patios, and expansive view terraces create a sense of discovery throughout the property, while sweeping vistas stretch across the Coachella Valley below. Arrival itself is an experience. A custom hillside funicular carries guests through dramatic rock formations as panoramic views reveal themselves with every ascent. Once above, the estate unfolds as a private world designed for both grand entertaining and quiet retreat. The main residence features a dramatic formal dining room with barrel ceiling and fireplace, multiple indoor and outdoor living areas, and a chef-caliber dual kitchen with hidden wine vault built directly into the hillside for natural temperature control. Throughout the estate, antique Balinese mahogany doors, custom stone vessel sinks carved from fossilized materials, and handcrafted architectural details lend warmth and character. Seven bedroom suites including romantic guest quarters, family suites, and the original caretaker's cottage provide both privacy and flexibility. Crowning the estate is a remarkable primary retreat offering balcony views, outdoor soaking tub, dressing area, office, gallery hallway, and lounge spaces that function as a private apartment within the compound. Adjacent to the pool, the iconic Rock House with architectural ties to legendary desert modernist Albert Frey appears to float above the landscape and features its own fireplace and dramatic views. The grounds themselves are equally compelling. A private outdoor amphitheater has hosted performances by renowned artists, while terraces, gardens, and hidden gathering spaces create a setting equally suited for intimate evenings or large-scale events. Scenic hillside trails wind through the property, where encounters with native bighorn sheep are not uncommon. Today the estate remains both a remarkable private sanctuary and a proven luxury vacation rental destination, with parking for more than twenty vehicles and infrastructure designed to accommodate gatherings with ease. Historic, theatrical, and utterly private - this is one of Palm Springs' most legendary hillside estates.

text: Located in the heart of Palm Springs' coveted Deepwell neighborhood, this quintessential 1961 mid-century modern home blends architectural character with thoughtful modern upgrades. Framed by a dramatic circular driveway and surrounded by gorgeous mountain views from both the front and back, the setting is as iconic as the home itself. Inside, a dramatic rounded wall and statement fireplace anchor the living room, creating a true architectural moment, while walls of glass and an effortless layout open to the outdoors, delivering the indoor-outdoor lifestyle Palm Springs is known for. The home has been updated with new terrazzo-style flooring, fresh interior paint, and new double-pane windows throughout, while preserving its original Italian stone and rock entryway an ideal balance of authenticity and refinement. The remodeled kitchen is both striking and functional, featuring gorgeous quartz countertops, premium Italian appliances, and a new gas line, all designed to connect seamlessly to the main living spaces and outdoor areas. Anchored by a dining area with beautiful mountain views, this space is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a large walk-in closet, a massive walk-in shower, enhanced ventilation, and direct access to a private outdoor shower, perfectly embracing the indoor-outdoor lifestyle. An additional bonus office/den/guest area, complete with its own bath and direct access to the backyard, adds versatility and function. Step outside to a private backyard retreat featuring a pool and spa, new landscaping and outdoor lighting, multiple areas to relax and entertain, and stunning mountain views that create a true desert backdrop. Additional upgrades include owned solar with a Tesla Powerwall, two new A/C units, two new hot water heaters, a brand new roof (approximately 5 months old), and two new sewer lines connected to the city, offering both efficiency and peace of mind. With 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, this is a rare opportunity to own a true architectural mid-century home in one of Palm Springs' most iconic neighborhoods, where timeless design meets modern comfort.

text: Architectural pedigree. Hollywood glamour. Resort-style living. Mountain views. A legendary Palm Springs setting. Get ready to fall in love with Palm Springs glamour! This showstopping Indian Canyons estate blends Hollywood Regency with Mid-Century Modern cool and a generous splash of desert drama. Tucked inside the coveted Indian Canyons enclave of South Palm Springs, this architectural gem has serious star power. Originally designed in the 1960s by celebrated architect Raymond Levanas and once owned by the legendary Chasen family of Beverly Hills hospitality fame, the residence was brilliantly reimagined between 2020 and 2022 in collaboration with acclaimed designer Michelle Boudreau. Featured in Modernism Week Magazine, this four-bedroom, four-bath retreat is a true love letter to Palm Springs design, with luxurious upgrades throughout. From the moment you arrive, the iconic champagne-bubble breeze-block facade and terrazzo entry set the tone. Inside, jaw-dropping mountain views unfold from nearly every room, complemented by bold architectural details and glamorous finishes. The dramatic living room centers around a spectacular fireplace wrapped in a custom Bauhaus-inspired slat design that continues overhead. The kitchen is equally impressive, pairing custom white oak cabinetry with gorgeous onyx marble and a full suite of Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, including a wine refrigerator, beverage drawers, built-in coffee system, and drawer microwave. Floor-to-ceiling Fleetwood glass walls create effortless indoor-outdoor living, framing panoramic views across the Indian Canyons Golf Resort toward the surrounding mountains. Every bathroom feels like a private spa, while the primary suite takes luxury to another level with mountain views, an indoor shower, outdoor shower, and sumptuous soaking tub beneath the desert sky. Outside, the backyard seems to flow directly into the golf course, creating an incredible sense of space. Two beautifully restored twin pergolas frame the glamorous Hollywood Regency-inspired pool, complete with its original turtle motifs. Gather beneath the pergola, dine al fresco, or simply relax beneath the palms and soak up the unmistakable Palm Springs sunshine. With mature landscaping, fragrant gardenias, and thoughtful design at every turn, this extraordinary residence was made for long lunches, sunset cocktails, and unforgettable weekends.

text: Located in the coveted Indian Canyons neighborhood of South Palm Springs, this newly reconstructed organic modern residence combines exceptional golf course and mountain views with refined design and effortless indoor-outdoor living. Set directly along Indian Canyons Golf Course, the home enjoys completely unobstructed panoramic views of the San Jacinto Mountains and spectacular sunsets, with natural light from morning through golden hour. Reconstructed through a comprehensive 12-month structural renovation, the four-bedroom, four-bath residence delivers the quality and precision of custom new construction. Every major system has been newly completed, including the roof, framing, electrical, plumbing, and heat-pump mechanical systems. A dramatic glass pivot entry opens to light-filled living spaces with solid oak doors, custom oak cabinetry, skylights, a volcanic stone fireplace, and pocketing glass walls that extend the interiors outdoors. Exterior stone continues into the entry garden, creating a seamless connection to the desert landscape. The chef's kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, with a 48-inch Dacor professional range, Sub-Zero refrigeration and integrated ice maker, dual dishwashers, prep sink, and walk-in pantry. Curated marbles and rare quartzites define the material palette, while spa-inspired bathrooms feature distinctive marble finishes and indoor succulent garden shower elements. A striking stone entertaining bar with built-in wine refrigeration adds another focal point to the main living spaces. Two primary suites offer spacious custom walk-in closets, complemented by warm under-cabinet and wardrobe illumination throughout. The home is prewired for automated shades, and the two-car garage is EV-ready. The outdoor space is truly designed for entertaining. The backyard opens directly to the golf course with uninterrupted fairway and mountain views, creating a spectacular setting for morning coffee, alfresco dining at sunset, and long afternoons around the pool. Mature palms and beautiful olive trees frame multiple lounge and fire-feature areas, while dramatic landscape lighting transforms the property after dark. A striking barbecue station anchors the outdoor living area, and the resort-style pool features a dive-worthy deep end, expansive sun shelf, and elevated spa with cascading waterfall. This fully reconstructed residence offers a turnkey Palm Springs lifestyle from morning through sunset.

text: Nestled on an expansive, low-maintenance desert-landscaped lot in the coveted Indian Canyons neighborhood, this home captures spectacular east and west vistas--from the dramatic San Jacinto Mountains to the west to the wide-open fairway views of holes one and two and the Murray Canyons to the east. Designed with effortless flow, the open-concept layout features a spacious living and dining area. The living room showcases a generous gas fireplace, direct access to the gated courtyard, and breathtaking views in both directions. The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, an island, and convenient access to the sunny breakfast nook. The en-suite bath offers a large tiled shower, dual vanities, and additional fairway views. The second primary suite is situated on the north side, complete with recessed lighting, a built-in sound system, and direct access to the covered patio and backyard. This exceptional property is offered fully furnished--just bring your toothbrush and start living the Indian Canyons lifestyle. No HOA dues!

text: Located within the prestigious Monte Sereno enclave in South Palm Springs, this exceptional Palazzo residence designed by Anthony Poon, AIA, delivers over 4,200 square feet of refined, design-forward living with a private south-facing backyard that defines resort-style luxury. Set on fee simple land (non land lease), the home blends architectural sophistication with cutting-edge systems and extensive recent upgrades. Tall ceilings, an open floor plan, and walls of glass create a seamless indoor/outdoor experience, filling the interiors with natural light while framing the resort-style backyard and capturing surrounding mountain views. Smart home integration includes Lutron RA3 lighting, whole-home audio, advanced security systems, and water monitoring. Additional highlights include custom California Closets, multiple garage spaces (two-car plus separate one-car), and thoughtfully curated finishes throughout. Architectural, efficient, and beautifully executed - this is modern luxury living at its finest in South Palm Springs.

text: A bold expression of modern desert architecture, this striking estate designed by award-winning architect Lance O'Donnell stands as a masterwork of design, light, and landscape framed by sweeping 360-degree mountain views in every direction. Completed in 2017, the residence is a study in precision and intention, where materials, orientation, and environment converge to create a home that is as intelligent as it is beautiful. From the moment of arrival, the architecture makes a statement. A facade of split-face concrete block and Corten steel introduces a palette that is both grounded and sculptural, setting the tone for interiors that unfold with clarity and purpose. Terrazzo floors run seamlessly throughout, while expansive walls of glass dissolve the boundary between indoors and out, capturing the changing light of the desert from sunrise to sunset. The home is thoughtfully composed as a private compound, offering a 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath main residence alongside a detached 1 bedroom, 1 bath guest house - ideal for hosting while maintaining a sense of retreat. The floor plan is carefully calibrated to the path of the sun, maximizing natural light in winter and minimizing heat in summer, a subtle yet powerful expression of architectural intelligence. At the heart of the home, the kitchen is both refined and functional, featuring Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, induction cooking, and a generous walk-in pantry - all opening to living and dining spaces that flow effortlessly to the courtyard beyond. Outdoor living becomes an immersive experience. A private interior courtyard anchors the home, centered around a saltwater pool and spa, fire feature, and multiple gathering areas framed by mature landscaping and uninterrupted mountain views. This is a setting designed not just for entertaining, but for living in rhythm with the desert. Equally impressive is the home's performance. Dual solar arrays, advanced water filtration, four-zone climate control, UV-protected glazing, motorized shading, and fully integrated smart systems deliver a level of efficiency and control that matches the home's architectural pedigree. Gated and private, with dual driveways, a two-car garage, and additional covered parking, the property offers both presence and practicality. Architectural, intentional, and quietly extraordinary. This is not simply a home, but a modern desert statement.

text: Perched high along the dramatic hillside of the San Jacinto Mountains in the iconic, guard-gated Southridge community, 2400 Southridge -- famously known as ''The Round House'' -- is a striking architectural masterpiece where sculptural design and breathtaking desert vistas converge. Just below the legendary Bob Hope Estate, this extraordinary residence commands sweeping panoramic views of the Coachella Valley, city lights, and endless desert horizons. This home was completely reimagined and rebuilt from the ground up, emerging as a striking expression of architectural innovation. Graceful curves, flowing lines and walls of automated retractable glass panels dissolve the boundaries between indoors and out, framing the surrounding desert landscape like living artwork. The residence offers 5 bedrooms, 9 bathrooms, a private office, and a spectacular 10-person luxury theater, with all bedrooms thoughtfully positioned on the second floor. Accessed by a graceful curved staircase or private elevator, the upper level features private balconies, views from every corner and a truly remarkable primary suite. The primary suite serves as a serene retreat with separate dual spa-inspired bathrooms, a steam shower, soaking tubs set against walls of glass overlooking the desert, a dramatic sundial-inspired walk-in closet and a separate massage room. Designed for grand entertaining and intimate desert living, the main level features a dramatic living room, elegant wet bar, billiards area, dining space, and a gourmet chef's kitchen with butler's pantry and dual built-in wine refrigerators. Every space is oriented toward the spectacular views. Step outside and the property becomes a breathtaking desert sanctuary. A stunning pool and spa sit dramatically at the edge of the mountainside, surrounded by multiple fire pits, two barbecue areas, poolside bath, shower and laundry and sculptural jagged rock walls carved directly into the mountain, creating a setting that feels both luxurious and elemental. Rarely does a home so perfectly blend bold architectural vision, modern luxury, and the raw beauty of the desert landscape. 2400 Southridge is more than a residence -- it is a transcendent experience that must be seen to be fully appreciated. Call today to make your own private showing appointment.

text: Welcome to Tennis Club's premier enclave of modern luxury homes in the community of Skye. This home brings a fresh interpretation of iconic mid-century style with transparent expanses eliminating the division of indoor and outdoor space. The floating butterfly roofline and walls of glass virtually disappear to maximize stunning mountain views. As you approach, enjoy the juxtaposition of clean architectural lines against a chaotic backdrop of mountain rock. Enter the private, front courtyard adorned with mature landscaping surrounding a central rectilinear stone covered fire pit for quiet mornings or cozy evenings or, literally, fireside chats. Inside, mid-century meets modern with the butterfly roof pushing ceiling heights to 14ft. The elevated hearth underscores the flush fireplace and a stunning wall of stone. With an open floor plan and enormous kitchen island, one has confidence and comfort in entertaining with ample space for both food & friends. Modern lacquer cabinets, quartz countertops and backsplash surround the suite of Jenn Air stainless steel appliances, gas cooktop and walk-in pantry. A nearby wet bar with wine refrigerator thoughtfully balances between kitchen and dining room. The formal dining room includes floating glass shelving, extensive storage, seemingly endless counter space, custom drapery. This room was made for holidays and special occasions. Thoughtfully designed, Skye homes were built with views and privacy as pinnacle passions. Inside the home, privacy extends to the bedroom suites with the primary bedroom located on opposite side of the home from the two additional guest suites. All three bedrooms enjoy direct exterior patio access and their own individual ensuite bathroom. The primary bedroom suite looks out towards the back yard and western mountain views. The luxurious primary bath includes dual vanities, a large glass-walled shower, freestanding soaking tub, dual water closets and spacious walk-in closet. A bonus room has been added as a home office or can be used as a fitness/yoga room. A retractable awning brings the indoors out for true year round enjoyment. Tiled in iridescent blue tiles, the infinity spa overlooks the expanded in-ground pool. Swing in the custom hammock and grill with the custom-built barbeque area with gas BBQ grill, bar seating, sink and refrigerator. Additional property features include: Exterior security camera system, 2-car garage with storage cabinets, tankless water heater, dual-zone HVAC, outdoor shower, and custom landscaping. Located downtown in the Tennis Club neighborhood, this home is a short walk or bike ride to Melvyn's, Johnny Costa, the Rowan, Orange Theory, the Lykken hiking trail, the Tennis Club and the O'Donnell Golf Club.

text: Welcome to a beautifully reimagined desert retreat, where architectural character meets elevated modern living. This 4-bed, 3-bath home makes an immediate impression with its striking curb appeal--clean lines, desert landscaping, and iconic double entry doors in a signature Palm Springs hue that set the tone for what's to come. Inside, the light-filled interior is defined by vaulted ceilings and large-format tile flooring throughout. The open-concept living and dining areas are both sophisticated and inviting, anchored by a dramatic double-sided gas fireplace that serves as a dramatic centerpiece. A spacious dining area sits just off the patio, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection ideal for entertaining, while the living room is complemented by a stylish wet bar--perfect for hosting or unwinding in comfort. The chef's kitchen is equally impressive, featuring sleek quartz countertops, custom Kerf cabinetry, a GE induction cooktop with range hood, GE Cafe double ovens (including convection and speed oven), a 36-inch Sub-Zero refrigerator, Fisher & Paykel DishDrawer dishwashers, and a full suite of thoughtfully integrated appliances. Walls of glass open to a private South-facing backyard designed for true resort-style living. Enjoy a saltwater pool and spa, fire table lounge, gas BBQ, and multiple seating areas--all framed by mature citrus, olive, and palm trees. Lush grass contrasts beautifully with desert landscaping, while block walls provide privacy and tranquility. The bedroom wing includes a large primary suite with a dramatic walk-in shower with picture window, refined finishes, and a generous walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed bath and offer flexible space for an office or studio. A fourth bedroom on the opposite side of the home has its own en-suite bath, ideal for guests. Comfort and efficiency are seamlessly integrated with Milgard energy-efficient windows and sliders, a central Carrier heat pump, Mitsubishi mini-splits in the guest suite and garage, two tankless hot water heaters, and a Culligan water softener. Additional features include ceiling fans throughout, two EV chargers, a finished attic space, and a storage shed. Offered furnished (outside of escrow/artwork excluded) with select electronics including TVs and a Sonos sound system, this home is move-in ready and perfectly suited as a full-time residence, vacation escape, or income-producing investment in one of the desert's most sought-after locations.

text: A cinematic interplay of architecture, landscape, and light defines this South Palm Springs estate that reimagines modern desert luxury. Nestled in the exclusive Andreas Hills enclave, the residence offers a rare harmony of artistry, comfort, and absolute privacy. Originally envisioned by the acclaimed firm Tichenor & Thorp, this Moorish-inspired masterpiece has been thoughtfully reimagined for contemporary living. Spanning nearly one third of an acre, the estate features 5 bedrooms, 5.5 baths, and over 4,800 square feet of refined living space including a private guest house and exceptional bedroom separation for privacy and flow. Every detail reflects the designers' celebrated eye for form, proportion, and garden composition. Grand scale meets serene restraint with high ceilings, tall Venetian plaster walls, and graceful arched passageways that frame curated views of courtyards and lush gardens. Carrara marble surfaces, broad skylights, and French doors bring balance and light, while the formal living room's commanding fireplace provides a striking architectural centerpiece. The chef's kitchen is both functional and inviting, blending custom cabinetry, an oversized marble island, and generous workspace that opens seamlessly to the family room. Designed for connection, it accommodates everything from morning coffee to large scale entertaining with effortless sophistication. Outdoors, the home's series of covered and open air patios dissolve boundaries between structure and nature. A fireplace warmed loggia, alfresco dining area, and intimate garden vignettes encourage lingering under the desert sky. Mature 100 year old olive trees, towering date palms, and lush layered plantings form a tranquil backdrop to the dramatic pool and secluded spa, enhanced by outdoor showers and complete privacy. With owned solar, a gated motor court, and every modern refinement, this Andreas Hills estate is both a timeless architectural statement and a deeply livable sanctuary, a rare composition of light, texture, and soul.

text: Welcome to 1650 E Murray Canyon Drive, historically known as The Waterfall House, a true contemporary architectural gem nestled within the coveted Indian Canyons neighborhood of South Palm Springs. This custom-designed home, built in 1978 by celebrated local architect James Cioffi, exudes timeless elegance and modern sophistication. Step through the private courtyard to behold the entrance's custom steelwork, introducing this striking home with its pool, cascading waterfall, spa, lounge seating area, and BBQ. The expansive open living areas seamlessly connect indoor and outdoor spaces, bathed in natural light from all directions. The interior structural lines beautifully complement the home's architectural imprint, creating a harmonious ambiance and optimal privacy. At 4,393 square feet, with three bedrooms including a luxurious en-suite primary and four bathrooms, this home is ideal for multi-generational living or entertaining guests. Dine al fresco under the covered back patio and enjoy sunsets over the 11th Tee of the North Course of the iconic Indian Canyon Golf Resort, a unique location surrounded by spectacular desert mountains. Key features include a putting green, floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, two walk-in primary closets, a chef's kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, a den, clerestory windows throughout, a sunken living room and immense bar, and a two-car plus golf cart garage, with golf courses, hiking trails, and horse stables nearby. This desert retreat offers the finest in Southern California living.

text: Designed in 1963 by acclaimed Los Angeles architect Harold Bissner, Sr., newly arrived in the desert following a long and distinguished career, the residence was originally commissioned by a local physician and remained in the same family for decades. Recently reimagined by fashion designer and Palm Springs style icon Trina Turk, it has been transformed into the radiant Soleil House. From the moment of entry, the home unfolds as a study in light, material, and horizon. Interior finishes from flooring and tile to wall treatments draw inspiration from the natural palette outdoors, creating a seamless dialogue between interior and landscape. Here, the immediacy of rugged, sculptural terrain meets the vast openness of the valley below, creating a dynamic spatial tension that animates every room. This dialogue is fully expressed in the dining room, where a monumental pane of glass dissolves the boundary between inside and out, pulling the craggy mountainside directly into the interior. With the slightest shift in perspective, the experience transforms from intimate proximity to the boulders to a sweeping, cinematic panorama across the desert floor. At the heart of the living room, a striking conversation pit anchors the space, both intimate and expansive, framing uninterrupted views while offering a warm, grounded connection to the fireplace. Just beyond, a generous deck projects outward, extending the architecture into the landscape and providing a commanding vantage point from which to observe the desert's ever-shifting light, color, and shadow. The floor plan is thoughtfully composed to enhance both privacy and flow. The primary suite is positioned poolside, immersed in light and landscape, while guest bedrooms are discreetly set apart at the opposite end of the home. The kitchen is large and luminous, with a huge picture window capturing the textured hillside and an overhead skylight that washes the space in natural light, an inspiring setting for daily living. Adjacent to the pool, a flexible bonus room offers an ideal retreat for a den, office, or studio. Arrival is both deliberate and architectural: a circular drive leads through a distinctive Trina Turk-designed breezeblock-clad carport, establishing rhythm, pattern, and permeability. Below, a substantial laundry room is complemented by an additional bonus space, well-suited for an office, artist's studio, or fitness room. The comprehensive renovation includes all new plumbing, soft water system, all new electrical systems, a brand-new HVAC system with owned solar, new roof, new doors and windows throughout, and all new kitchen appliances. Exterior improvements include new hardscape, a newly plastered pool with new pool equipment, and landscape lighting. The renovations come with a builder's warranty. The kitchen and all three bathrooms have been completely re-envisioned with a cohesive, design-forward approach. Soleil House is a rare and compelling expression of Palm Springs modernism, where architecture, site, and sky converge in a continuous, immersive experience of space, light, and landscape.

text: Sometimes, when presenting a property to market, there are so many exceptional features that it's hard to know where to begin, and this renovation just completed in 2025 is a perfect example. In this case, every aspect of living and entertaining at home has been thoughtfully considered, with a design that not only embraces but becomes one with its natural surroundings. For starters, the site itself is breathtaking, a spectacular setting that elevates this L-shaped modern home above the desert floor, offering seemingly endless mountain views and dramatic city lights. The architecture is deeply connected to the landscape, seamlessly integrating with the rugged terrain that so profoundly inspired the principles of desert modernism. This is a home that doesn't just sit on the land, it belongs to it. Inside, the open floor plan is an architectural dream, featuring an "invisible" kitchen with a large island and a striking natural stone wall. The interiors create a tonal and textured atmosphere, seamlessly blending organic materials that bring warmth to the modern aesthetic. Every detail has been designed to honor the desert environment, from the earthy color palette to the strategic placement of glass that frames nature like artwork. A hidden butler's kitchen sits behind the great room, with a galley of counter space and storage leading to what may be the most incredible laundry/mudroom we've ever seen. The integration of style and function throughout the home is next-level. On the other side of the house, a long hallway connects three ensuite guest bedrooms, a spacious den/media room, a gym, an office, and a powder room. A spa-style bathroom, complete with a steam shower, serves both the gym and the pool. And at the very end of this wing? The crown jewel: the primary bedroom suite. Wrapped in glass with a see-through fireplace and perched dramatically on the edge of the mountain, this is unlike any bedroom experience in Palm Springs, one where you wake up immersed in the landscape itself. Brand-new Monumental doors and windows dissolve the boundary between indoors and out, leading to a sunken concrete seating area with a fire pit, a swimming pool with a raised infinity spa, and a built-in BBQ with a sink. The outdoor spaces feel like a natural extension of the home, reinforcing the seamless connection between architecture and environment. And did we mention the forever views? Owned solar and all-new systems provide a highly efficient approach to desert modernism. A two-car carport with electric charging stations further enhances the home's sustainability. Truly one of a kind, this dramatic hillside property is the ultimate expression of the Palm Springs experience where modern design and the raw beauty of the desert exist in perfect harmony.

text: This iconic desert retreat oozes class,character and has a class one historical designation. Know as the Giannini residence, the original owners and founders of Bank of America made this their desert retreat nestled higher up in Araby Cove. Araby cove is one of the first and oldest subdivisions in South Palm Springs. The home was constructed with board formed , poured in place concrete and finely cut locally quarried stone over the concrete walls which is reminiscent of the craftsmanship from the 1880s-1930s era. The property also features a basement and bank type vault which could be a nice wine cellar. The basement stays at a cool temperature naturally through the year and has added AC in case you would like it even cooler. A large Albert Frey deck serves as a star and view gazing platform as well as a shade for the cars underneath. This could be a huge party space as well! Enter up a grand stair way to a stone porch! The porch is naturally cool being surrounded by rock and the orientation from the sun. The views from the front of the home are incredible and expansive. Enter the home thru old French doors and you are greeted with a huge original rock fireplace. The living room flows nicely into an office nook, then into a gourmet kitchen, butler pantry and coffee bar and breakfast nook. This all opens up to the lovely outdoor space surrounded by patios, a kidney shaped pool, spa and top of the line desert scape. There are outstanding views from each of the homes outside and inside viewing areas. Back inside the home we will find a large formal dining room to accompany your chefs kitchen. There is one guest bedroom and a den serviced by a jack and jill bath. The second bath on that side also able to serve the entertaining and dining areas. The other side of the home offers the primary suite with a large bath and sitting area. Also on that side is the second guest bedroom. This home has changed hands less than a handful of time in a 100 years. This is a a once in a lifetime opportunity to own a piece of history. The current owner has installed a very expensive and extensive HVAC system, added a whole house water softening system ,added new insulation, updated appliances, serviced the septic system , updated wiring and so much more. The home is ready for your upmost enjoyment and trouble free living!

text: Wonderful, bright 3 bedroom, 2 bath with many mid-century features and lots of charm and character. This home is located in the very desirable neighborhood of Indian Canyons in South Palm Springs. The extra large lot is surrounded by block wall and shrubbery, creating a private utopia. Once in the colorful green pedestrian gate, you enter into the enclosed front yard, which is a perfect combination of desert landscaping and grass, boasting layers of rock, fauna and trees. To the left of the front entry door note the slider that leads from the living room area onto to a covered front patio, which currently serves as an outdoor living room. Next, step through the full view, solid glass front door into the entry area and hallway. The living room features many mid-century vibes, including a cathedral, beamed ceiling, and a partial slump stone brick wall surrounding the fireplace, which sits almost at floor level and walls of glass. text: Experience effortless desert living in this modern, newer constructed home ideally located in one of South Palm Springs' most vibrant and walkable neighborhoods. Whether you're relaxing poolside, entertaining guests, biking through the neighborhood, or heading out for dinner just blocks away, this home delivers the ultimate blend of modern design, prime location, and easy living.

text: CALLING ALL MID-MOD ENTHUSIASTS! Welcome to this iconic South Palm Springs gem, perfectly positioned on a corner lot in the coveted ''Canyon Palms'' neighborhood. Situated on fee simple (owned) land with NO HOA, this authentic 1966 Mid-Century Modern residence delivers timeless architecture, thoughtful updates, and unforgettable mountain views. From the moment you arrive, the elegant circular driveway sets the tone. Meander through the signature citrus-yellow ''ring-a-ding-ding'' dual front doors into a striking foyer accented by rich walnut-toned wood batten walls. The living room captivates with its dramatic angled granite wall surrounding a natural gas fireplace, all framed by floor-to-ceiling windows and sliding glass doors that flood the space with natural light. The updated kitchen is a chef's delight, featuring custom walnut cabinetry, imported Krion counters, and a full suite of charcoal-toned KitchenAid appliances. Adjacent, a sun-drenched dining area boasts soaring ceilings and clerestory windows, while a tucked-away wet bar with sink and beverage cooler makes entertaining effortless-cocktails, anyone? The primary suite offers a private retreat, with double doors opening directly to the lush backyard oasis, from the bathroom as well. Guest bedroom #2 also enjoys double-door access to the pool and spa, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living. A third bedroom currently serves as an office or studio, offering flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Outside, the magic continues. Drift through the living room doors onto a lush lawn with dual dining patios, BBQ grill, and pizza oven anchored by the original raised fire feature. Wander around to the hidden garden lounge along the south side of the home which provides a peaceful escape, while the north end of the yard reveals a stunning PebbleTec, saline pool and relaxing spa (new heater and filter in 2025). There is a roomy storage shed too. The panoramic views of Mt. San Jacinto are simply breathtaking. This is Palm Springs desert living at its finest-stylish, serene, and unmistakably Mid-Century. Don't wait-come experience it for yourself!

text: MID-CENTURY MODERN meets modern-day Palm Springs! Set on land you own in coveted Indian Canyons, this beautifully updated 3 bedroom ensuite residence delivers nearly 3,500 square feet of stylish desert living centered around panoramic mountain views and an exceptional west-facing resort backyard. A gated double-door entrance creates a sense of arrival before revealing the home's signature moment: an impressive double-sided brick fireplace rising between the formal living and dining areas, framed by walls of glass and Fleetwood sliders that pull your attention directly toward the pool and mountains beyond. The architecture, natural light, and indoor-outdoor connection immediately set this home apart. Designed for entertaining, the interiors flow from formal to casual spaces with ease. A separate wet bar creates another gathering point, while the skylit gourmet kitchen features an oversized island, professional-grade appliances, double ovens, abundant workspace, and room for everyone to gather. A built-in serving counter with sink conveniently connects the kitchen and formal dining area, making entertaining at scale effortless. Three private bedroom suites offer excellent separation. The Primary Suite is a destination of its own with a gas fireplace, sitting area, direct pool and spa access, and a generous spa-inspired bath highlighted by a dramatic double shower with its own fountain feature. Privately positioned on the opposite side of the residence are Junior Ensuites Two and Three, each with its own bath. Outside, Palm Springs takes over. The west-facing backyard is designed around magnificent mountain views with a striking blue-tiled pool and spa, cascading waterfalls, fire features, multiple conversation and lounging areas, and a built-in BBQ. Mature citrus trees including grapefruit, tangerine, lemon, and orange complement the low-maintenance landscaping and create a private desert setting from morning through sunset. Owned solar, dual-zone HVAC, an inside utility room with sink, and an attached three-car garage add comfort and functionality. Best of all, there is no land lease and no HOA. Ideally positioned near golf, hiking, Downtown Palm Springs, and the best of South Palm Springs, this is a home designed around everything that makes desert living extraordinary. Architecture. Mountains. Indoor-outdoor living. This is Indian Canyons done beautifully.

text: This distinguished mid-century residence is set on one of the largest parcels along Alhambra Drive in the Indian Canyons enclave of Palm Springs. Designed by Boris Gertzen, the home reflects classic desert modernism, highlighted by his signature marble faced fireplace, strong horizontal lines, and expansive walls of glass that connect interior spaces to the outdoors. The floor plan is open and intentional, allowing natural light throughout while thoughtfully separating bedrooms, each with mountain views. The primary suite opens directly to the covered patio and pool, while additional bedrooms enjoy individual access to exterior spaces. The central kitchen is modern and efficient, featuring KitchenAid(R) appliances, a large built-in refrigerator, and a separate built-in ice maker designed to support both daily living and entertaining. Living and dining areas are generous and fluid, complemented by a game room and a family room with a substantial wet bar. Storage is abundant, including multiple interior closets, an oversized walk-in closet in the primary suite, exterior storage for pool essentials, and additional closets in the spacious garage. The landscaped grounds are framed by views of Mount San Jacinto and include a Zanzibar white mini pebble pool and spa completed in 2020 with Pentair equipment, water features, and cascading spa. Additional amenities include a built-in firepit, lighted bocce court, multicolored bougainvillea hedge, white plumeria, multiple citrus trees, and a mature fruiting mango tree. Located on the 17th fairway of the historic Indian Canyons North Golf Course, the property offers seclusion, open views, and a setting within one of the least windy areas of town. The Indian Canyons neighborhood is known for premier mountain views, a strong sense of community, underground utilities, and access to hiking trails, all just minutes from shopping and dining.

text: 1530 Palm Colony Drive, Palm Springs - A Private Palm Springs Architectural Retreat Designed for Elevated Living. Perched within a private gated intimate enclave of just 19 residences built in 2005 in South Palm Springs, this exceptional fee-simple home is a study in design, intention, and quiet luxury set against the breathtaking backdrop of the San Jacinto Mountains. From the moment you arrive, there is a sense of entry into something rare, an environment defined by privacy, architectural clarity, and a refined connection to the surrounding landscape. Tucked within a peaceful, gated courtyard setting, the home offers a quiet retreat just moments from Palm Springs' most coveted lifestyle destinations. Conceived as a living gallery, the residence has been elevated through an extensive, design-driven remodel by award-winning Dallas firm Bodron Fruit and featured in INTERIORS Magazine bringing a level of architectural intention and refinement rarely found in the desert. Every detail reflects that vision: Clerestory windows invite natural light to move gracefully throughout the interiors, while museum-quality recessed lighting, wall washers, and art spotlights create a dynamic canvas, designed to showcase a collection or simply elevate everyday living and atmosphere. The result is a home that feels both curated and deeply livable. The interiors are striking yet serene. Porcelain terrazzo floors provide a seamless, gallery-like foundation, while soaring ceilings and expansive walls of glass dissolve the boundary between indoors and out. A Carrara statuary marble fireplace and built in book shelve anchors the main living space with quiet sophistication, creating a setting that feels both grand and intentional. At the heart of the home, the volume-sque open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas are designed for effortless entertaining. A custom indoor/outdoor bar connects through retractable glass panel, allowing gatherings to flow naturally to the private pool and spa set against panoramic mountain views that shift beautifully throughout the day. The kitchen is tailored for both design and performance, featuring custom cabinetry with retractable opaque glass panels and a suite of professional-grade appliances, including a Wolf range and oven, Sub-Zero refrigeration, and a whisper-quiet Bosch dishwasher each selected for style, longevity, precision, and elevated daily use. The primary suite offers a tranquil retreat generous in scale, with custom drapery, high ceilings, and a spa-inspired bath clad in Carrara marble. Fantini fixtures bring a level of Italian craftsmanship and precision, while a Kohler bidet enhances comfort and refinement. Guest spaces continue the narrative, including a steam shower and custom detailing throughout. Technology is seamlessly integrated, with a full Lutron system allowing effortless control of lighting, shades, and ambiance transforming the home from bright and airy by day to warm and cinematic by night. Outdoors, the experience is equally compelling. The private pool and spa are framed by mountain views, while thoughtfully designed exterior lighting enhances the architecture and landscape after sunset. A detached casita, complete with its own fireplace and wet bar, offers versatility as a guest retreat, creative studio, or private office. Built with modern systems and solar, this residence offers the best of Palm Springs living architectural integrity, contemporary infrastructure, and a level of design that would be exceptionally difficult to replicate today. Positioned just moments from local favorites like Koffi Palm Springs and the iconic Ace Hotel & Swim Club, the home offers access to the vibrant energy of the city while preserving a sense of retreat and exclusivity. This is more than a home, it's a fully realized lifestyle. A place where design inspires, privacy restores, and every detail has been considered to elevate the way you live.

text: SUN, POOL, and MOUNTAIN VIEWS to the south and west set the tone for easy South Palm Springs living at this private backyard retreat. Tucked into a quieter pocket of the Los Compadres neighborhood, this residence offers a sense of privacy while remaining close to the best of town. Situated on Fee Land (you own it) and currently eligible for a Short Term Rental Permit. 3 bedrooms and 3 baths in 2,783 square feet. The backyard is a highlight with mature citrus, swaying palms, and a pool and spa with waterfall set against the mountain backdrop. No power lines to interrupt the view. Inside, main living areas are light and bright with tall ceilings and tile floors, opening to a long covered patio through a series of sliders. The living room features custom built ins, a fireplace, and wet bar with refrigerator and views. Formal dining includes a coved ceiling, motorized blinds, and French doors to a separate patio. The kitchen centers around a large island with counter seating, plus a walk in pantry, breakfast area, and desk alcove. Great separation of bedrooms. The ensuite primary features vaulted ceilings, clerestory windows, direct patio and pool access, a soaking tub, walk in shower, and generous closet space. Junior Ensuite 2 also opens to the pool with its own bath. Guest Bedroom 3 is currently used as an office and sits near a full bath featuring a clerestory window. Laundry room with utility sink is located off the kitchen. Direct access to a 3 car garage. All of this in a desirable South Palm Springs location close to dining, shopping, and everything that makes this part of the desert so easy to enjoy.

text: Quintessential mid-century modern architecture, thoughtfully updated to modern standards, defines this exceptional Indian Canyons residence, designed for gracious living and effortless entertaining. Expansive, light-filled living areas create a seamless connection between indoors and out, offering generous spaces ideal for both everyday living and large-scale gatherings. The recently updated kitchen is a standout, anchored by a large social cooking area and featuring updated appliances, a dedicated coffee bar, and a separate wet bar that serves the main living space-perfectly suited for entertaining. An attached casita with kitchenette and ensuite bath provides flexible accommodations for guests, extended stays, or a private office or studio. In the main house, the primary suite serves as a serene retreat, complete with a spacious primary bath and a step-out outdoor shower area that enhances the home's indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The en-suite guest room was re-designed for privacy and comfort and opens onto its own patio space. In addition, there is a smaller room that can serve as a bedroom or office. The outdoor spaces are a true Palm Springs oasis. In the backyard, wide, open views of the Santa Rosa mountains stretch beyond the golf course, while mature hedging ensures privacy. The pool has been completely rebuilt and repiped and is complemented by a new spillover spa. Multiple dining and seating areas surround the pool, along with a covered cabana, plumbed fire pit and a large built-in BBQ with bar seating. The lush, mature, and fully curated landscaping continues in the walled front courtyard, which has stunning views of the San Jacinto mountains. Additional features include solar power and whole-house water filtration. Located in Indian Canyons, one of Palm Springs' most sought-after neighborhoods, celebrated for its iconic modernist architecture and country club setting, this home offers the rare advantage of no HOA and no club dues. With phenomenal views in all directions and timeless design throughout, this is a special offering and a perfect opportunity to live out the midcentury Palm Springs dream.

text: Donald Wexler, FAIA, Architect | The Royal Singapore, 1966, as featured in Dwell, Robb Report, The New York Times, and Wallpaper. This remarkable mid-century modern home in Palm Springs, designed by Donald Wexler, seamlessly blends Polynesian design influences with the open flow and climate-responsive elegance of Desert Modernism. A dramatic rubber tree frames the facade, leading to a serene courtyard centered by Wexler's signature custom water feature. The setting offers unobstructed views of the Tahquitz Creek golf course and San Jacinto Mountains, creating an ideal artist's retreat. Built in the mid-1960s by the Alexander Construction Company, the residence is located in the historic Green Fairway Estates (now part of the Tahquitz Creek Golf Neighborhood) in South Palm Springs. It represents one of the final and most ambitious phases of the Alexanders' residential developments. Wexler, renowned for his pioneering use of steel construction, open-plan layouts, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration tailored to the desert environment, designed this exclusive enclave around the golf course. The neighborhood is historically significant, frequently featured on Modernism Week tours, yet remains a little-known and rarely seen gem even among dedicated enthusiasts. The home exemplifies Wexler's signature style: light-filled interiors with clean lines, abundant natural light, and expansive views. A gated entry opens through double doors to a raised walnut-paneled hall that steps down to polished concrete floors throughout. The generous open floor plan features recessed lighting and custom fixtures that preserve the original spatial flow. At the heart of the living room stands a fully restored, rare Alexander Cone fireplace, a sculptural conical centerpiece iconic to Wexler's Alexander-era designs. The residence offers four spacious bedrooms (two with sitting areas), three bathrooms with beautiful period tile work, a new kitchen with a breakfast bar, a formal dining room, and a family room. The expansive backyard backs directly onto the 3rd fairway, offering scenic golf-course and mountain views. Outdoor living is enhanced by a refinished saltwater kidney-shaped Pebble Tec pool, a new BBQ area, refreshed landscaping with sprinklers, leased solar panels, and an evaporative cooler, all true to Desert Modernism's climate-responsive principles. With no HOA, fee-simple land ownership, and vacation rentals permitted, this meticulously preserved Wexler home stands as a rare architectural treasure in one of Palm Springs' most storied modernist enclaves. Artwork and furnishings are available for purchase separately, offering a turnkey opportunity. A great place to call home. Photography courtesy of Cameron Carothers.

text: Escape to this entertainment hideaway located in the heart of Palm Springs' historic mid-century Twin Palms neighborhood. Extensively updated in 2013, this stylish El Camino Estates 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home has been thoughtfully curated to preserve and expand upon its vintage heritage. Nestled within a natural high-desert landscape, sculpted berms and native desert plantings create privacy and intrigue for the single-story structure that has a courtyard accented with breeze block and a low-profile roofline with a gravel finish. Entering through the original double front doors, the open floor plan incorporates breeze-block partitions to define the living, dining, and kitchen areas. Features include the living room's corner gas fireplace and original mirrored display cabinet, and multiple sliding glass doors that open to a covered rear patio. The rear patio extends 75 feet along the back of the home, featuring multiple open skylights and repeating the breeze-block partitioning to create conversation areas and gathering points. The interplay of shade and sun is enchanting, with the freshly replastered lap-pool and spa just beyond. A side-yard fire pit with mountain views and an outdoor shower further enhance the resort-style setting. There is a chef's kitchen with a dining nook offering ample space for entertaining. It features a combination of white cabinetry, Caesarstone countertops, a prep island, and white appliances. The rear patio's barbecue station with a classic vent hood is right outside. The kitchen also includes a washer and dryer closet, pantry, and access to the two-car garage. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet and an en-suite bath as well as sliding doors opening to a dedicated outdoor conversation area on the back patio. The en-suite bath's updates incorporate designer Formica accents on the restored 1960s cabinetry, paired with fresh solid-surface countertops and complimentary shower tile. Two additional bedrooms are located at the front of the home, both with mountain views and featuring sliding doors opening to the front courtyard, where each has a dedicated outdoor seating area for relaxation. Between these bedrooms is a shared Jack-and-Jill bath with windows that provide stunning mountain views while showering. Its vintage design includes earth-tone ceramic and glass tile, a restored 60s vanity, and a mid-century slatted shower curtain. This home also has a guest half bath and leased solar.

text: Located in the prestigious Indian Canyons neighborhood of Palm Springs, this re-imagined 1965 mid-century residence blends timeless architecture with thoughtful, design-forward updates. The home was substantially redecorated in 2019 by Palm Springs firm Anthony Cochran Design with restraint and discernment, avoiding many all-too-familiar clichs. A design work that pairs East Coast and European sophistication with a breezy California sensibility and a desert-inspired color palette. The home's street presence was dramatically enhanced with the addition of brick facing over the original stucco and a heightened perimeter wall, increasing both visual impact and privacy.Behind the gates, a west-facing, front-loaded pool anchors the expansive front courtyardan iconic mid-century welcome that immediately sets the tone. text: Designed by renowned midcentury architect William Krisel, this iconic butterfly-roof residence in Little Beverly Hills captures the very essence of Palm Springs modernism; refined, architectural, and effortlessly cool. In a beautiful enclave of mid century properties, the front of the home is distinguished by an architectural screen, back lit at night to set this apart as the crown jewel of this architecturally significant neighborhood. Set against dramatic western mountain views, the home's crisp palette creates a timeless, gallery-like backdrop that honors its heritage while feeling entirely current. Clean horizontal lines and walls of glass celebrate Krisel's signature indoor-outdoor philosophy, flooding the interiors with natural light and framing the desert landscape beyond. Offering 4 bedrooms and 3 baths, the layout is both functional and design-forward. The open living spaces feature exposed beams, walls of glass, custom bar and a striking fireplace focal point. The kitchen maintains the home's minimalist integrity with warm walnut cabinetry, sleek white surfaces, coffee bar and seamless flow to dining and outdoor entertaining areas. The private and somewhat hidden primary suite is a true sanctuary looking out to a private courtyard with a shower and fountain designed for relaxation, sleep, and rejuvenation. Guest accommodations thoughtfully designed and spaced to provide privacy for all. Every space feels curated yet relaxed... a sophisticated neutral canvas layered with texture, light, and architectural detail. Outdoors the quintessential Palm Springs experience unfolds: a sparkling pool and spa set beneath open sky, framed by sculptural desert landscaping and uninterrupted western mountain vistas. Multiple lounging and dining areas, cabana, fire feature, bbq, and bar invite sunset cocktails and effortless entertaining. Authentic. Architectural. Timelessly neutral. A rare opportunity to own a true Krisel-designed butterfly in one of Palm Springs' most celebrated midcentury neighborhoods.

Thoughtfully designed for everyday comfort and elevated entertaining, the home features three ensuite bedrooms, four bathrooms, a family room, office/flex space, and a showstopping great room with a full wall of Fleetwood sliding doors opening to a private resort-style backyard. text: The Mesa | Spanish Colonial Revival with Guest Casita and Mountain Views Nestled against the majestic San Jacinto Mountains, The Mesa has long been one of Palm Springs' most coveted and storied neighborhoods. Established in 1921, this secluded enclave--often called the ''Hollywood Hills of Palm Springs''--is celebrated for its lush landscape, wind-sheltered microclimate, and rich history of celebrity residents. This lovingly restored 1948 Spanish Colonial perfectly captures the area's timeless allure. Beyond the welcoming entryway, refinished original hardwood floors lead into a step-down living room framed by a bay window and centered around a cozy fireplace. Graceful archways connect the living and formal dining rooms, while an adjacent sitting area offers a relaxed space for media or conversation. The remodeled kitchen opens seamlessly to both formal and informal dining spaces, ideal for modern entertaining. The home offers four bedrooms and four baths, including a private-entry casita with kitchenette and direct access to the pool--perfect for guests or extended stays. Outdoors, the generously sized backyard unfolds as an entertainer's paradise. A charming patio off the dining room invites intimate after-dinner conversations, while a dining pergola beneath the stars and a rustic steel fire feature create an ambiance of desert elegance. Completing the scene are a classic swimming pool and spa, all set against the dramatic backdrop of the rugged mountain range. A rare opportunity to own a piece of Palm Springs history--where Spanish Revival architecture meets effortless California living.

text: Experience the quintessential Palm Springs lifestyle in this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom classic built in 1966 by the legendary Alexander Construction Company. Located in the highly sought-after Los Compadres neighborhood historically known as Araby Estates, this property offers a unique blend of architectural pedigree and incredible value. Unlike many other communities of its era, this enclave features buried power lines for unobstructed, "photo-perfect" mountain views and wide, sidewalk-lined streets that showcase the thoughtful development making it a local favorite for decades. Offered for the first time in over thirty years, this home has been a cherished retreat and features significant updates.
