Efficiency is enhanced by newer dual-pane windows and doors throughout, while the outdoor living space has been thoughtfully improved with a recently resurfaced pool deck and a new custom patio covering, providing the perfect setting for desert entertaining. True to its 1966 roots, the home showcases the clean lines and indoor-outdoor synergy that defined the Desert Modernism movement. This is a rare chance to acquire a piece of Palm Springs history and personalize a classic Alexander to your own taste. We have priced this property aggressively - well under the market value of fully remodeled homes in the immediate area, providing the savvy buyer with immediate equity and a prime foundation in one of the city's most peaceful and picturesque neighborhoods.

text: DESERT DREAM OASIS-Welcome home to your Desert Dream Oasis in the quiet, serene Los Compadres neighborhood with buried utilities, sidewalks, and a location just two blocks from the new CV LINK. This absolutely stunning home is a beautiful blend of style and comfort an entertainer's dream. You enter this gorgeous home through a lush courtyard with a fountain and are then greeted by a double glass door into the light and bright entry. Inside, you will find an enormous, open, sunken living room and dining room with vaulted ceilings, exquisite travertine tile floors, and walls of sliding glass doors with stunning mountain views and privacy. The warm and inviting family room, with a tile open-flame gas fireplace and adjacent half bath, is the perfect place to relax and unwind. If you enjoy game nights, there is even a game room that opens to the lush courtyard. Entertainers will love the 12' long full-service bar with a sink, ice maker, and refrigerator/wine cooler that opens to the magnificent pool. If you love cooking, the kitchen will knock your socks off with top-of-the-line Electrolux ICON appliances, gas cooking, two dishwashers, a bright kitchen nook, and a walk-in pantry. Off the kitchen, the entertaining continues with the irresistible covered outdoor poolside living space featuring a heavenly large JennAir grill with an oven, perfect for outdoor cooking year-round. The artistic pool area is a classic Palm Springs Oasis with a stunning pool, hot tub, great outdoor sunbathing, and a bocce ball/cornhole court. Wait no longer; you will be mesmerized by the primary bedroom, which features a vaulted ceiling, a custom walk-in closet, a separate, nicely equipped home gym, and a spa-style bath with a large walk-in tile shower, double vanity, and sunken tub. Also in the bedroom wing of this magnificent home are three additional bedrooms (two with walk-in closets), a beautiful home office with a view, and a large guest bath with a double vanity that opens to a lush, private outdoor shower. No Palm Springs home is complete without a double garage; this home even has custom built-in cabinets and gorgeous glass garage doors, allowing for plenty of natural light. Fee Simple land and 34 solar panels to be paid off at closing! This home truly has it all. Hurry, this one will not last

text: A true mid-century modern opportunity in one of South Palm Springs' most cherished architectural neighborhoods: Twin Palms. Built in 1958 by the famed Alexander Construction Company, this classic "Butterfly Alexander" showcases the iconic roofline, soaring vaulted ceilings, tongue-and-groove exposed beams, and clerestory windows that frame swaying palms and dramatic mountain silhouettes. Set on land you own (no land lease) and no HOA, the property offers tremendous architectural potential along with immediate lifestyle perks. The west-facing backyard captures the best of Palm Springs sun and scenery and features a freshly resurfaced pool and spa, updated equipment, and owned solar panels for year-round efficiency. Inside, the traditional mid-century floor plan includes a west-facing dining area and a living room with fireplace, an adjacent kitchen with backyard access and exterior views, and a classic bedroom layout that includes a Primary Ensuite plus two guest bedrooms with a nearby hall bath. The original footprint has been expanded to add a casual living space with a bar that opens to the backyard: a great foundation for indoor/outdoor entertaining. Move-in updates include new interior and exterior paint, a new water heater, and a new garage door. With its architectural pedigree and prime location, this is the ideal canvas for someone ready to bring a classic Butterfly Alexander forward into 2026. Even better: the property qualifies for a Vacation Rental Certificate, offering short-term rental possibilities for investors or part-time residents. This is a rare chance to restore, reimagine, and celebrate one of Palm Springs' most recognizable mid-century forms - all in a neighborhood beloved by enthusiasts from around the world.

text: This stunning contemporary 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom remodeled home in the Luminaire community is nestled near the Santa Rosa mountains in the iconic Araby neighborhood of South Palm Springs. With over 3000 sq. ft. of luxurious living space, residing on a 14,810 sq. ft. DOUBLE, CORNER lot, this home's prime location offers truly gorgeous, expansive, panoramic western and southern mountain views. Exclusive features from an extensive 2015 remodel include an expanded and upgraded kitchen, remodeled bathrooms, a custom, oversized Pebble Tec pool with raised spa and a 600 sq. ft. guest house on a beautifully landscaped private backyard. From the moment you walk in, this home welcomes you with its cathedral ceilings, clerestory windows, Indonesian marble floors, and a spacious living room with a floor to ceiling stacked stone fireplace and a set of French doors that open to a tiled front patio. The beautiful and expanded chef's kitchen has an oversized island, granite countertops, and custom German Poggenpohl cabinetry. Revel in high-end appliances including a Wolf double oven, cooktop, microwave, Miele refrigerator and dishwasher, and a Sub-zero wine refrigerator. The primary bedroom has a large ensuite bathroom with Carrera marble floors & countertops, a walk-in closet and sliding door access to the outdoor patio. The guest bedroom is thoughtfully separated from the primary bedroom, has an upgraded, ensuite bathroom and a dressing area. Other home features include a formal dining room, a separate powder room, laundry room, walk-in pantry, Control 4 sound system, speakers in most rooms, and a two-car garage. The expansive outdoor area of this home is something to behold. The south-facing French doors lead out to an exclusive back patio with steps up to the pool and raised spa, and the 600 sq. ft. guest house. The entire back yard oasis has phenomenal mountain views and is surrounded by lush landscaping. The spectacular guest house is situated on the east side of the property and directly faces the San Jacinto mountains. It boasts tiled floors, a kitchenette with sink, small electric stove top, refrigerator and dishwasher. It has a living area, bedroom with an ensuite bathroom, office space, a door to the back garden with fruit trees, and a set of French doors that open to the patio, pool & spa. The renovations and upgraded amenities in this home create a luxurious Palm Springs lifestyle filled with elegance, privacy, tranquility and breathtaking mountain views.

text: Architecture, location, views. Organic modern finishes and luxury amenities. Thoughtful, fully custom, new construction in Andreas Hills, one of the best neighborhoods of South Palm Springs. Designed by Lance O'Donnell AIA of O2 Architecture. Four bedrooms, each with a private bath, one as an attached poolside casita. 21,344 sq ft very private corner lot. The views of the mountains in all directions are extraordinary, with the living room and pool lined up to directly face the famous ''sleeping giant'' ridgeline. The list of luxury details and amenities is extensive: a climate-controlled garage, high-density insulation, sound-attenuated walls, Level 5 smooth finish walls, smooth stucco exterior, hemlock tongue and groove ceilings, diamond-polished concrete floors, floor-to-ceiling rift-oak doors, high-efficiency window walls, double walk-in closets in the primary and a six-foot-wide pivot entry that frames the landscape. Interiors highlight craftsmanship at every turn: custom cabinetry with Gola pulls, Brazilian quartzite surfaces, handmade Moroccan tile, floating vanities, and a 72-inch linear fireplace wrapped in a custom iron surround that serves as both sculpture and structure. Technology is well integrated: 14.3 kW solar array with Tesla Powerwall backup, Lutron Caseta smart controls, Sonos audio inside and out, prewired shade pockets, Ring surveillance, and five independent high-efficiency Trane HVAC zones-including the garage-deliver comfort and resilience. The kitchen program features Thermador appliances in the main house and Bosch in the casita, alongside a butler's pantry with additional sink, dishwasher, and storage. Outdoors, the landscape is fully realized: mature olives, palms, mesquites, rostradas, aloe, ocotillo, jasmine, and desert spoons are layered with architectural lighting and six-foot garden walls lined with eight-foot ficus for complete privacy. The pool is designed as an extension of the architecture, with a tanning shelf, integrated seating, generous spa, pebble finish, salt system, and LED lighting powered by Pentair equipment. Hemlock-clad automated gates, a built-in barbecue island, gas fire pit, and dedicated service zones complete the outdoor program. This is a property that must be seen to be believed. True luxury in one of the best locations.

text: SOPHISTICATED DESERT LIVING IN LUMINAIRE PRICED TO SELL - Welcome to Luminaire, a sought-after enclave in South Palm Springs' Araby/Smoketree neighborhood where community and privacy blend seamlessly. Offered at an exceptional value, this 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence is your gateway to the refined desert lifestyle you've been seeking. From the moment you arrive, the home's thoughtful design stands out. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame garden vistas from nearly every room, flooding the interior with natural light and creating a seamless connection with the outdoors. High ceilings, decorator niches and an airy open-concept living space add architectural drama, while cozy window seats and a gas fireplace bring warmth and intimacy. The remodeled kitchen is a true showpiece, featuring custom cabinetry, molding detail, a tile backsplash, pull-out pantry drawers, Bosch stainless refrigerator, Fisher & Paykel double drawer dishwasher, GE Profile oven, microwave and gas cooktop. The spacious dining room opens to a tranquil fountain courtyard, filling the space with soothing sound - ideal for dinner parties. Many neighbors have converted this room into a third bedroom or office, offering flexibility for your lifestyle. Both bedrooms are generously scaled retreats. The primary suite features oversized sliders leading to the covered patio, stationary clerestory windows, a spa-like bath with dual vanities, sunken tub, shower and a walk-in closet with abundant storage. The secondary ensuite bedroom, with its cozy alcove, functions beautifully as a second primary suite. A bright powder room, large laundry room with cabinets and utility sink, and oversized two-car garage round out the thoughtful floor plan. Outdoors, a PebbleTec pool and spa provide the perfect spot to enjoy dramatic mountain views. Mature Meyer lemon and tangelo trees frame the backyard, while covered patios and shaded dining areas invite year-round entertaining. On fee land - you own it! - with low HOA dues, Luminaire offers a unique lifestyle: a welcoming sense of community with monthly neighborhood gatherings, while still maintaining privacy and tranquility. Whether you're seeking a full-time residence or a desert retreat, this property combines elegance, comfort, and value. This is more than a home - it's an invitation to experience the best of Palm Springs living.

Don't miss your opportunity make this exceptional residence, located on historic Anza Trail, your own!

text: Stunning mid-century home in Tahquitz Creek Golf community, a hidden gem in Palm Springs! This home was designed by iconic architect Donald Wexler, built in 1965, and is one of a few left in updated yet original condition. The current owners have updated what needed to be and have lovingly restored key features. Some of the key original features are: kitchen cabinets, cabinet hardware, stove top, oven, the amazing fireplace, bathroom cabinets, the roman shower in the primary bath, the atrium off the primary shower, the covered patio, the block walls, the rock walls and the pool. In addition a detached MCM inspired ADU/casita was added that can be a guest house or income producing. The ADU is 499 sq ft in size, features a living room, bedroom, kitchenette and bath. The main home features a living room, open to the dining room via a stunning stone wall, an oversized primary bedroom with sitting area, and 2 guest bedrooms, one was used as a Den. The outdoor spaces truly typify the Palm Springs lifestyle. Large, open rear yard, pool, spa, multiple lounging areas all looking towards golf course greens and fabulous mountain views. The finishing touches are owned solar, and desert friendly landscaping. A stunning home!

text: Exceptional Mid-Century Modern Retreat in South Palm Springs. With no visible utility lines and only two neighboring properties, this residence enjoys rare privacy and unobstructed mountain views. Step through decorative reeded-glass double doors that flood the interior with natural light and reveal an inviting open layout designed for modern desert living. The open-concept living and dining area is ideal for entertaining, with seamless access to the backyard and pool. On cooler evenings, the fireplace adds a cozy touch of warmth and ambiance. San Jacinto vistas, or entertain guests on the expansive patio with built-in BBQ and counter-top seating for four. Experience the best of Palm Springs living.

text: Rare-to-market opportunity in South Palm Springs! Tucked against the mountain and a short hop to the heart of town. Laundry located in the 2-car garage. There is a powder bath too. Low HOA fees make things all the better. Location meets fabulous design! Enjoy it all.

text: OO LA LA! Discover the allure of this meticulously RESTORED Alexander Regent model home. Ideally situated on nearly a 10,000 sq ft CORNER lot in the Sonora Sunrise neighborhood (on the dividing line of Los Compadres). Originally Farrell Canyon Estates, it remains a mid-century haven on the tranquil, less traveled end of Farrell Drive within SOUTH PALM SPRINGS. Enjoy stunning, WIRE-FREE mountain VIEWS from your PRIVATE backyard, featuring a refreshing, RENOVATED pool and brand new hot tub-the perfect playground to frolic in for both vacations and year-round living. This special neighborhood, developed on fee simple land by the renowned ALEXANDER CONSTRUCTION CO, was designed for ''Permanent Value'' and originally showcased 6 exotic and international designs. This notable model, the Parisian Modern elevation, truly sparkles from the street as a true gem of Palm Springs HISTORY. From its VINTAGE-INSPIRED accents and sculptural lighting to its distinctive mansard roof, this design is the epitome of CHIC. Step through the double 'peach mimosa' doors into a casually elegant and completely remodeled interior, ready for its new owners. The kitchen, bathed in natural light, seamlessly opens to the dining and living areas. It boasts ALL-NEW cabinetry, counters, stainless steel appliances, and a custom zellige tile backsplash. Guests will delight in a perfectly pink powder room and spacious bedrooms with their own mountain views. The primary suite offers direct access to the backyard through new sliding glass doors and features a warm, bronze-toned en-suite bath, playfully evoking the romance of Gay Paris. The property was reimagined by a talented INTERIOR DESIGN DUO and one of the Valley's most respected GC's. Besides the interior, it's in TERRIFIC MECHANICAL SHAPE with newer roof, sliders & windows, HVAC, and entirely updated pool (new equipment, including heater, plaster, tile and decking). Even more value exists for investors & seasonal owners wanting to obtain a FULL SHORT TERM RENTAL PERMIT with the city of Palm Springs. At of the time of listing, this neighborhood is under 6% density; please do your own diligence regarding STR's with the City of Palm Springs. Furnishings package available for purchase outside of escrow.

text: Opportunity is knocking at the iconic double doors of this 4 bed, 3.5 bath 3,288 square foot detached home in sought-after Canyon Estates in South Palm Springs. Designed by renowned architect Charles E. DuBois, AIA, and maintained with a pride of ownership, this ultra-private residence adjacent to Smoke Tree Ranch offers key highlights that buyers will surely appreciate: tall ceilings, multiple sets of sliding glass doors, great separation of ensuites, quartz counters in the kitchen and baths, upgraded plumbing in the baths and electrical outlets and switches throughout, and a large private backyard that offers panoramic views and refreshing Pebble-tec pool with commanding gazebo. Ownership in Canyon Estates also includes access to a 9-hole golf course, gym, tennis courts, and 14 community pools and spas. Cable (HBO and Showtime) included, too! Additional highlights are noticeable as soon as you enter through the double doors that lead to a light and bright living room that has 14 ft tall ceilings with clerestory windows, multiple sets of sliding glass doors, and views of the private yard and surrounding mountains. You will love the conversations that can occur around the wet bar! Separate kitchen with built-in appliances and quartz counters also offers views, casual eating area, and access to the backyard pool. Primary Ensuite One offers views, access to the outside, a large walk-in closet, and a private ensuite bath. Junior Ensuite Two also offers a large walk-in closet and an ensuite bath. On the other side of the house is Junior Ensuite Three (which feels like a guest casita). Bedroom Four, which is currently enjoyed as a den, has easy access to a hallway bath. Inside laundry room with access to the attached two car garage.

Located just minutes from downtown Palm Springs, this private retreat offers a rare sense of stillness and serenityan oasis where timeless architecture, natural beauty, and desert tranquility come together.

Each of the two bedrooms feature the original casement corner windows. In addition, this home has 2 baths, one of which is attached to the rear bedroom. There is a large 2 car garage with plenty of storage. This home is quintessential Spanish charming and in a top, South PS neighborhood close to ACE hotel, Koffi, Smoketree Shopping Center, Elmers, and minutes to downtown!!!!!!

Designed by the renowned architect Barry Berkus, the home features original Saltillo tile floors, a dramatic living area with an adobe-style fireplace flanked by cactus-view windows, and soaring vaulted ceilings that create a sense of spaciousness and light. With true lock-and-leave convenience and peace of mind, this gorgeous property offers the perfect blend of sophisticated charm and modern luxury. Don't miss your chance to live in one of Palm Springs' most coveted architectural communities. Showings to begin 06/23

text: This light-filled midcentury modern home, with owned solar, is located on the best street in Seven Lakes Golf & Country Club with the most spectacular views of the Santa Rosa and San Jacinto Mountains in all of Palm Springs. The home is located on the 15th hole of the Ted Robinson executive golf course with an extra wide fairway and true mountain panoramas from every room. It has been styled to reflect modern living and capture the outstanding views of snow peaked mountain tops and Bob Hope's house. Designed in 1969 by Palm Springs architect Richard Harrison, this Mid-century Modern two bed, two bath home is located in the Seven Lakes Country Club Community known as ''The Gem of the Desert.'' Truly designed for year-round outdoor living, the north & south walls of glass open to extend your living space. The private courtyard offers beautiful views of the mountains and a BBQ perfect for entertaining. Designed in true Palm Springs style, the home boasts ten-foot ceilings, tile flooring, walls of glass, skylights and clerestory windows. Built between 1964 and 1972, Seven Lakes Golf & Country Club is the only private, guarded and gated mid-century modern community in South Palm. The community provides breathtaking views over a Ted Robinson designed 18-hole executive golf course enhanced by mid-century modern architecture designed by Richard Harrison and William Cody. Amenities include a 24-hour attended-gate, an 18-hole par 58 golf course that is 2, 712 yards long, a club house complete with a restaurant and lively bar, 15 community heated swimming pools and spas, 11 BBQ areas, full sized tennis and pickleball court, shuffleboard, golf/pro shop, and electric car charging stations. Seven Lakes CC is a very low-density community with over 30% percent of the area being green space. Just steps away from The Parker Hotel, a 5 minute drive to several grocery stores and restaurants, and a 10 minute drive to downtown Palm Springs. Designed in 1963 by Ted Robinson, the Executive golf course is suited for all types of players, from beginners to the most experienced golfers. Limited membership means youll rarely, if ever, have to wait for a tee time. No matter how you choose to participate at Seven Lakes, you will be on the same course that PGA Hall of Fame Johnny Revolta lived and played, and where President Eisenhower shot his famous hole in one.

text: Charming property in Palm Springs! Built in 1957, this 1988 sq ft single story home offers 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and a 6534 sq ft lot, perfect for comfortable living and entertaining. With its impressive curb appeal, this property features low-maintenance landscaping and a horseshoe shaped driveway for easy entry and exit. The backyard is a private oasis, featuring a cozy back patio that leads to an inviting in ground pool and spa and the added convenience of a poolside bathroom, perfect for relaxation and gatherings! Upon entering into this bright and inviting home, you will be greeted by a spacious open floor plan boasting tile flooring that seamlessly connects every room. The entry flows into a versatile space that can be used as a dining area or an additional sitting room. The kitchen, featuring tile flooring, ample storage in the cabinets, stylish counters tops with plenty of space and an island with bar seating, an ideal spot for casual dining. Stainless steel appliances, including a 4-burner stove with middle warmer and oven, dishwasher, microwave and recessed lighting, make cooking a delight. Just beyond the kitchen, the heart of the home is the spacious living room, where a warm wood-burning fireplace takes center stage. Natural light pours in through the windows, and a sliding glass door provides seamless access to the backyard patio. To the right of the entry, the master suite featuring tile flooring, recess lighting, decorative wallpaper and two separate closets with mirror sliding doors. The ensuite master bath offers a doorless walk-in shower, multiple shower heads, a soaking tub, dual sink vanity, and a door leading to the back patio. The hallway bathroom features a doorless walk in shower, tile flooring and a single sink vanity. The two additional bedrooms showcase recessed lighting, windows filling the rooms with natural light, closets with sliding mirrored doors and tile flooring. Outside, the backyard is a perfect oasis, complete with an in-ground pool and spa. The covered patio, featuring a ceiling fan and a fire pit beyond the pool, is ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The blank concrete canvas side yard is ready for your personal touches and the poolside bathroom adds convenience featuring a walk in showing, single sink vanity, making it easy to enjoy the outdoor space without having to go back inside. This home is conveniently located near major highways, shopping centers, public transportation, and dining options.

Inside, walls of glass, clerestory windows, and tongue-and-groove ceilings flood the home with natural light. Carrera marble is used generously throughout framing spa-like bathrooms and accenting the kitchen - creating a cohesive sense of elegance and ease. Dual primary suites are smartly separated for privacy, while a floating dining bar anchors the open living space, ideal for entertaining. The south-facing backyard offers spectacular mountain views, a resort-style saltwater pool with tanning shelf and spillover spa, and plenty of room for a future guest house. Updated copper plumbing, smart home features, and remote-control systems add modern functionality to this stylish desert escape. Homes in Tahquitz River Estates can currently obtain a full vacation rental license through the City of Palm Springs.

The park features 12 pickleball courts, baseball diamonds, soccer fields, basketball courts, and tennis courts. Enjoy rolling hills full of green open space with walking and bike paths, picnic tables, a children's playground, and yes, a large dog park.

text: Step into a striking blend of historical mid-century architecture and today's modern comforts at 1986 S. Yucca Place in Palm Springs' renowned Twin Palms neighborhood, designed by famed architect Palmer & Krisel, AIA and built by the Alexander Construction Company. Featuring 4 bedrooms and 3 baths, including an attached casita, this fully remodeled residence showcases iconic design elements including a dramatic butterfly roof, expansive clerestory windows, soaring ceilings, and a signature curved ceiling detail that carries from the front entry through to the backyard. Bathed in natural light, the home offers an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle paired with gorgeous mountain views from both inside and outside the residence. From the moment you enter, the home's dramatic curved ceiling creates an unforgettable architectural statement, drawing the eye through the open living spaces toward the resort-style backyard beyond. Walls of glass and expansive clerestory windows flood the interiors with light while highlighting the clean lines and timeless design that define classic Palm Springs living. The iconic butterfly roofline further enhances the home's striking mid-century presence. Designed for both elevated entertaining and relaxed everyday living, the home features multiple gathering spaces throughout, including a fantastic wet bar, gorgeous statement fireplace, and a variety of lounge and conversation areas that create warmth, style, and flexibility throughout the home. The freshly updated kitchen opens seamlessly to the living and dining spaces and features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and tremendous cabinet space, combining style and functionality with an ideal flow for hosting family and friends. The primary suite is a true private oasis, combining fantastic architecture with majestic mountain views, generous closet space, and direct access to a private outdoor yard area. Guest bedrooms are thoughtfully positioned for comfort and privacy, while the attached casita offers excellent flexibility for visitors, a home office, or additional living space. Outside, the backyard delivers the quintessential Palm Springs experience with a sparkling pool and spa, firepit lounge area, outdoor shower, and a covered patio designed for year-round entertaining and al fresco dining. New landscaping in both the front and rear yards enhances the home's striking architectural lines while creating beautiful and functional outdoor spaces. Additional improvements include fully owned solar, a new roof, fresh interior and exterior paint, a replaced sewer lateral, and numerous thoughtful upgrades throughout the property. Located moments from South Palm Canyon's shopping, dining, and entertainment, this beautifully updated home represents a rare opportunity to own a thoughtfully restored piece of Palm Springs mid-century design within one of the city's most historically significant neighborhoods.

Every element of the home was considered as part of a cohesive architectural vision rather than a collection of individual upgrades. text: Welcome to 1075 S. Manzanita, an iconic 1964 architectural gem by Charles W. Doty, blending timeless mid-century innovation with the allure of Old Hollywood glamour. Located in the legendary Deepwell neighborhood, in South Palm Springs, an enclave steeped in celebrity history and architectural significance, frequently featured during Modernism Week and home to stars like William Holden, as well as renowned mid-century architects such as E. Stewart Williams, Lapham, and Wexler-Harrison, this 3, 510 SqFt architectural home sits on a premium, oversized southwest-facing corner lot, ideal for capturing natural light, golden-hour sunsets, and serene mountain vistas in total tranquility and privacy. At the center of the home is a show-stopping circular living room with soaring 14-ft origami-inspired ceilings, wraparound glass walls, terrazzo flooring, and a suspended fireplace, an entertainer's dream and a design lover's sanctuary. The koi pond entry and sculptural garden paths further enhance the home's quiet elegance and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. This luxury estate has been upgraded with designer finishes and modern amenities, including 49 leased solar panels, and three HVAC zones. The secluded primary suite is a true private retreat, opening to a cascading waterfall and open-air shower. Two additional en-suite bedrooms offer privacy and either pool or mountain views, while a detached office/studio/gym with a private entrance and separate A/C provides the perfect space for remote work or creative endeavors. Set on a 15, 245 SqFt fee-simple lot, the landscaped grounds feature mature citrus, fig, guava, and plumeria trees, plus tall privacy hedges. A circular gated driveway offers a grand arrival and ample parking for multiple cars, including a two-car garage, ideal for car collectors or entertaining in style. Just minutes from the vibrant Downtown Palm Springs scene, shopping, fine dining, art galleries, and museums, this one-of-a-kind residence also qualifies for short-term rentals (Deepwell currently under 13%). A rare architectural trophy home with celebrity provenance, iconic design pedigree, and a soulfully modern lifestyle, this is a once-in-a-generation opportunity for the discerning collector or design connoisseur.

text: Tucked within the exclusive gated community of Bella Monte in South Palm Springs, this extraordinary tennis estate spans 1.3 acres of lush, meticulously designed grounds, offering the pinnacle of luxury desert living. Reimagined by renowned designer Orlando Diaz-Azcuy, this estate blends timeless materials and modern elegance to create a one-of-a-kind sanctuary. Sophistication greets you at every turn from reclaimed wide plank walnut flooring and Cantera stone to antique lighting and hand-selected stone imported from a mosque in India. The result is a curated mix of textures and tones that elevate every living space. The formal living room, family room, and dining area flow seamlessly, anchored by a stunning wet bar with custom cabinetry perfect for entertaining in style. The chef's kitchen is both functional and beautiful, outfitted with handmade cabinetry, limestone slab countertops, and top-of-the-line appliances including Sub-Zero, Wolf, Miele, Viking, and Fisher & Paykel. It's a culinary haven and a natural gathering space for guests. The expansive primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a fireplace, tranquil views of the pool and gardens, a spa-inspired bathroom, and an oversized walk-in closet. A private office, den, and an additional powder room complete the primary suite. Two well-appointed en-suite guest rooms offer comfort and privacy, with one currently used as a gym. Outside, the grounds rival any luxury resort with towering palms, mature citrus trees, water features, and a spectacular custom pool and spa with a raised babbling brook waterfall. A spacious covered patio with heat lamps and a fireplace creates the perfect ambiance for al fresco dining or relaxed evenings under the stars. The one-bedroom guest house is equally impressive, offering its own living room, kitchen, and full bath ideal for visiting friends and family. At the heart of the estate lies the crown jewel: a private tennis court with a resurfaced US Open inspired color scheme (2022) and an adjacent tennis pavilion surrounded by manicured gardens making it an entertainer's dream. Additional highlights include a 3-car garage with paver motor court, owned solar with 86 panels, and 4 Tesla Powerwalls for sustainable, energy-efficient living. This estate is more than a homei t's a rare and refined lifestyle experience, offering privacy, grandeur, and exceptional amenities in one of Palm Springs' most coveted communities.

text: STUNNING MOUNTAIN VIEWS! Located on a private cul-de-sac in South Palm Springs, this fully remodeled home features a west-facing retractable 8x20 foot glass wall which opens to a fully renovated and private outdoor living space complete with an inground pool (on the west and south side of the home), spill over hot tub/spa, large firepit, updated low-maintenance landscaping, as well as spectacular and unobstructed views of the mountains. In addition, this home which is on fee land, also has views of the north and south mountain vistas! The open-concept living room, dining room and kitchen create a versatile grand space, with breath-taking views, to configure as you see fit for any occasion whether it is hosting an intimate dinner or entertaining large groups of family and friends. This open and bright space brings the outdoors inside, creating an ideal home to view and enjoy this desert oasis called Palm Springs. The modern kitchen includes a 5-burner gas stovetop, double ovens, a stand alone filtered ice maker, a separate wet bar with ample glassware and beverage storage, as well as a pass through window to an outdoor bar on the fully covered patio. This home features 26 fully-owned solar panels with one power storage battery to keep cooling bills low, to negative. This home boasts two zones for heating and cooling, with two new Lennox air conditioning units installed this year which will reduce cooling costs even more. The large primary bedroom includes an updated en suite and a walk-in closet with plenty of storage. Two guest rooms and a large office/den that could be converted to a fourth bedroom, complete the private living spaces. The laundry area is conveniently located next to the bedrooms. Additional upgrades include a new tankless water heater, desert landscaping, a remodeled pool and a spill over spa with remote control access, a newer pool heater, patio pavers, large windows, sliding glass doors, a new epoxy garage floor, patio misters, brand new garage doors with smart openers, lots of built in storage cabinets, and fresh paint. This home is located in the Los Compadres neighborhoood of South Palm Springs, conveniently located one mile from groceries, drug stores and restaurants. Downtown Palm Springs is only 2.5 miles away, Demuth Park and pickleball courts one mile, the airport is 1.5 miles, and the new Prescott Preserve is only one-half mile from your door. You cannot fully appreciate all this home has to offer, especially the amazing views, unless you see it for yourself, so book a showing, today.

Central air and heat for the front cottage, and split air/heating system for the back. Private yards and patios for each.

text: Welcome to this reimagined, 1948 single story residence located in the Tahquitz River Estates neighborhood of south Palm Springs. Owned by an architect and his partner, this home was taken down to the studs in 2017/2018 and brought back to life as a modern, desert domicile. This home features three bedrooms and three baths, as well as additional office space off the primary, which could be used as any number of iterations. Additionally a large walk in closet accompanies the primary suite for ample storage and enhanced clothing capacity.Added features of the home include a large circular driveway, two car garage, a covered entryway that leads into an expansive foyer with 9' ceilings and floor to ceiling windows. The open concept floor plan between the kitchen, dining and living rooms all face the pool, spa and mountains for exceptional, south Palm Springs views.Two of the three bedrooms have direct access to the walled, landscaped and private backyard equipped with an in-ground, salt water, heated pool and spa and ample areas for sunbathing, entertaining and dining. The views of Mt. San Jacinto really are lovely from the backyard of this stylish residence. Additionally the primary suite is located across the home from the two guest suites for added privacy and hushed evenings. The kitchen has been fully renovated and features custom teak and walnut cabinetry, quartz countertops, Bosch, Kitchen Aid and Frigidaire appliances, and features a 16' slider to the back, covered patio. Seating is available at the kitchen bar, or other options include the outdoor patio or for a more formal evening, the dining area. Additionally, new windows, doors and a new HVAC system including new ductwork were installed as well as new electrical and plumbing and two new tankless water heaters and a new mini-split in the primary. This home retains the traditional mid-century concepts of its original inception and was renovated to accommodate today's modern world and modern family. This home offers an abundance of features to any prospective buyer interested in maintaining mid-century charm in a modernized world.

text: Located near the 13th hole of the Indian Canyons Golf Course, this architectural masterpiece in South Palm Springs embodies timeless mid-century modern design by Harry Kelso, AIA, combined with the finest contemporary upgrades. Originally built in 1964, the home underwent a meticulous 16-month, down-to-the-studs renovation completed in 2018. The result is a seamless blend of original charm and modern luxury. The interior features 40 x40 Italian porcelain tiles throughout, creating a sleek and cohesive aesthetic. The reimagined layout enhances flow and functionality, while seismic updates and fully modernized systems ensure structural integrity. At the heart of the home is a state-of-the-art chef's kitchen, boasting custom European cabinetry, Miele appliances, and an impressive 11-foot Silestone island, perfect for entertaining. Oversized custom Fleetwood pocket doors flood the home with natural light and frame pristine mountain views. Originally a three-bedroom design, one bedroom has been converted into a stylish den/media room but can easily be restored. Additionally, there is a two person home office, perfect for working from home. Technological upgrades abound, including owned solar, level two charge point car charger, a Lutron system for lighting and automated sunshades, and integrated smart home features for HVAC, air conditioned garage, security, lighting, and sound. Systems such as Sonos, Nest thermostats, Exacq security cameras, and Ring floodlight cameras provide convenience and peace of mind. The outdoor spaces are as remarkable as the interior. A modernized front desert garden, partially enclosed with mid-century-inspired brise-soleil elements, offers privacy and a striking first impression. The backyard is a true oasis, featuring a redesigned salt water swimming pool, separate spa, and outdoor shower. The built-in BBQ area near the kitchen includes two burners for alfresco dining. Rarely does a home of this architectural pedigree, modern sophistication, and prime location come to market. This is an unparalleled opportunity to own a piece of Palm Springs history redefined for the modern era.

text: Introducing 'La Petite Maison', a glamorous 3 bed / 3 bath Hollywood Regency style home inspired by John Elgin Woolf. Exuding elegance and sophistication, legend has it that Liberace commissioned this one-of-a-kind residence for his mother Frances. Lovingly restored & upgraded with a warm and inviting feel throughout. Features include black & white marble floors, high ceilings, French doors, and smart home technology. The stunning living room includes a gas fireplace, original crystal chandelier, heated floors, surround sound speakers, custom millwork and access to the pool courtyard. The spacious dining room is perfect for entertaining. The dramatic and renovated black & white service kitchen includes new Kitchen Aid appliances including two dishwashers, an induction cooktop, and integrated microwave/convection wall oven. The spacious primary bedroom boasts a soaker tub, steam shower, heated bathroom floors, vintage lighting from Paris & outdoor shower with views of the San Jacinto mountains. Two guest rooms each have their own en-suite bath. Outside, a private salt-water pool and estate-like lush garden offer views of the San Jacinto Mountains. Elegant garden gates provide access to a desert oasis: sunny and quiet, with solid hedging, mature trees, a fire pit and water fountain. The rear patio features a charming al fresco setting for outdoor dining. This especially rare piece of Palm Springs history must be seen in person to be truly appreciated.

text: Welcome to the Prestwick Model, one of the few of its kind built in Heritage Palms Country Club! Offering approximately 2,200 sq. ft. of living space, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath home plus den features a spacious floor plan, generous rooms, and endless possibilities to make it your own. This is the perfect home for someone looking for a great layout and a wonderful opportunity to personalize a property to fit their own taste, style, and lifestyle. Whether you envision updating the kitchen, refreshing the bathrooms, adding your own designer touches, or simply moving in and making changes over time, there are many opportunities to create the home you've always wanted. Step inside to a bright living and dining area with plenty of space for gathering with family and friends. The spacious great room features a cozy fireplace and offers a comfortable place to relax and unwind. The open kitchen provides abundant cabinetry and counter space, a center island, and a charming breakfast nook perfect for morning coffee or casual meals. Luxury vinyl and tile flooring run through the main living areas, while one guest bedroom offers comfortable carpeting. Custom window coverings, including silhouettes and shutters, add style and function throughout the home. The private backyard is your own little oasis, complete with a spa, partially covered patio, and plenty of room to relax, entertain, or simply enjoy the beautiful desert surroundings. Enjoy resort-style living as part of everyday life. text: Welcome home to this single-level Montego retreat in Heritage Palms Country Club, a guard-gated 55+ golf community in the heart of Indio. The open floor plan connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, while a flexible second bedroom gives you room to host guests, set up a home office, or carve out a hobby space - whatever you need it to be. Step out back and you'll find your own private pool and spa, framed by mountain views and shade by mature citrus trees you'll enjoy for years to come. It's a rare chance to shape a home in one of the desert's most sought-after communities, right from the start. The home is vacant and easy to show, so come see for yourself why Heritage Palms living, and this address in particular, is worth a closer look.

text: Welcome to Heritage Palms Country Club, where resort-style living meets everyday comfort. This beautifully maintained Westerwood model offers 2,504 square feet of thoughtfully designed space, with three bedrooms and two-and-a-half baths. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac and just a short stroll from the clubhouse, the setting is as desirable as the home itself. Positioned on an elevated lot along the 15th fairway, the property captures sweeping panoramic views of the golf course and surrounding mountains--creating the perfect backdrop for stunning desert sunsets right from your backyard. Inside, a bright and inviting layout welcomes you with living and dining areas, along with a separate great room. The great room features a cozy gas fireplace and an upgraded picture window that frames the outdoor scenery beautifully. The kitchen blends style and function with rich cherry wood cabinetry, slab granite countertops, a center island, and a built-in buffet for added storage and convenience. The expanded primary suite offers a private retreat, complete with a bay window, a spacious ensuite bath with soaking tub and walk-in shower, a generous walk-in closet, and direct access to the covered patio. Two guest bedrooms share an adjoining bath, providing both comfort and privacy--one enhanced with custom cherry wood built-ins, making it ideal as a bedroom, home office, or flexible space. The laundry room complete with a sink leads to an expanded garage with additional space for a golf cart and its own dedicated air conditioning. Outdoors, the backyard is designed for relaxation and entertaining, featuring brick pavers, a flagstone-style overlay, and drop-down shades--perfect for enjoying peaceful evenings overlooking the course. A cozy front patio adds yet another inviting space for morning coffee or quiet moments. Additional highlights include newer Lennox HVAC systems, pavered driveway and walkway, tile and luxury vinyl flooring throughout, ceiling fans and Hunter Douglas window coverings. As a resident of Heritage Palms Country Club, you'll enjoy access to an 18-hole championship golf course, fitness center, indoor and outdoor pools, tennis and pickleball courts, and a vibrant clubhouse with an active social scene. More than just a home, this is a lifestyle--offering the very best of desert living. Come see it for yourself. (Some Photos Have Been Virtually Staged)

text: Life at the Trilogy Polo Club is among the finest in the Coachella Valley. This stunning contemporary Liberty model 2,357 square foot, 3-bedroom, 3-full baths home with office, is upgraded to the max. The quality and artful design of the home and natural beauty of the Polo Club resort makes every day living extraordinary. Once inside your greeted by 10 ft. ceilings, sparkling custom lighting, and inviting wide-plank tile floors. Off the hallway is an executive-sized room with tall custom glass doors perfect as an office, study or game room. The great room with a large linear fireplace, 70'' big screen TV against a wall of marble is a great place to relax, read, and stream your favorite shows. The windows feature custom electric shades, and a 5-ton Lennox gas heating and cooling system with UV sterilization and whole house attic air filter keep air quality and temperature perfect year-round. A wall of triple glass sliding doors provides a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor living and entertaining. The beautifully landscaped private backyard with covered patio and ceiling fan is a peaceful place to enjoy by day. By night, watch the brilliant colors of the sunset and the landscape light up against the dark night sky. The gourmet kitchen is inspiring with an abundance of custom white shaker cabinets, radiant quartz countertops against a custom glass subway tile backsplash and grand center island with pendant lighting. Upgraded professional stainless appliances include a six-burner gas cooktop and custom range hood, new refrigerator, oven, microwave, and dishwasher. The generous size and pantry make it easy to keep all your cooking appliances neatly tucked away. The spacious primary bedroom is a luxury retreat, with a built-in linear fireplace and above and opening for a 70'' TV. The sumptuous bath radiates luxury with quartz counters and a large walk-in shower with custom tiles to the ceiling. The walk-in closet is thoughtful in design with custom built-ins to accommodate even the most prolific shoppers. Two comfortable additional guest bedrooms are located away from the primary bedroom. One is an ensuite with a full bath and walk-in closet while the third guest bedroom with an adjacent full bath, could double as an office with built-in cabinets and shelves plus a closet. The laundry room is oversized with white shaker cabinets, washer, dryer and deep sink. The 2-car plus extra golf cart garage has an epoxy flooring and built-in tool chest and storage. An oasis in the desert, Trilogy Polo with its big mountain views, cool lakes, mature trees and brightly colored flowers is a resort of exceptional beauty and fun. Play a game of giant chess outdoors, jog or walk your pets along miles of landscaped trails, and test your golf skills on the outdoor putting green and indoor golf simulator. Play Tennis, PickleBall, work out at the club, or hang by the pool. Meet friends for dinner at the famous June Hill restaurant, or hit up the many restaurants and events in nearby Old Town La Quinta. An exclusive golf option is available at Trilogy Golf Club at La Quinta. The Polo Club Social Membership is available to transfer to new owners for $3,000.

text: Welcome to Madison Estates, one of South Indio's most sought-after gated communities. As you approach this exceptional 4,075 sq. ft., 5 bed, 6 bath estate, a sweeping circular driveway & striking iron entry gate immediately set the tone. Step through the gate into a private courtyard, where the home begins to reveal privacy, scale, & sophistication within. Step through the front door & into a dramatic great room, where soaring ceilings & walls of floor-to-ceiling glass immediately draw your gaze to the sparkling pool & spa beyond. Oversized sliding glass doors open wide, creating a seamless transition from sophisticated indoor living to an inviting resort-style outdoor retreat. Continue into the chef's kitchen, designed to be as impressive as it is functional. An oversized granite slab island anchors the space, complemented by a custom backsplash, professional-grade stainless KitchenAid appliances, & a built-in Miele coffee system. Open to the main living areas & overlooking the pool, this is a kitchen made for everything from quiet mornings to unforgettable evenings with guests. As you explore further, each of the 5 bedrooms offers the privacy of its own ensuite bath. A detached casita creates a welcoming retreat for guests. Throughout the home, refined details include 8-foot solid-core doors, plantation shutters, new bright interior paint, newly installed neutral-colored carpet, new pool pumps, pool heater, newer main-house AC & furnace units & oversized baseboards. Upstairs, an expansive 5th bedroom suite with private bath opens to a covered observation deck which is perfect for enjoying sunset cocktails. The upstairs 5th bedroom can easily be converted into a game room, theater, or private retreat. The epoxied tandem-style garage holds 3 cars & the large laundry room with sink is sure to help get your toughest stains out. Step back outside, where generous side yards enhance the sense of privacy & the beautifully designed pool & spa become the centerpiece of the property. A new firepit & built-in BBQ were recently installed. With the home opening effortlessly to the outdoors, this is where afternoons drift into sunset & evenings unfold beneath the desert sky. Expansive retractable awnings will provide shade when needed from the beautiful west facing leisure. Set on nearly half an acre and minutes from golf, shopping, dining, equestrian & polo grounds, & the Coachella & Stagecoach festival grounds, this is desert living designed to be experienced.

This home can be yours for a VERY reasonble $530,000. Come check it out, You won't be disapointed.

text: Experience resort-style living in this beautifully maintained Monaco floor plan located behind the gates of the highly sought-after adult community of Trilogy at the Polo Club (55+). Perfectly positioned to capture breathtaking mountain views, this exceptional home showcases stunning Santa Rosa vistas from the great room, den and primary suite, while the front courtyard and kitchen offer picturesque San Bernardino Mountain views. An inviting courtyard with perennial flower beds and privacy hedge creates an impressive welcome. Located within walking distance to the Polo Club. Inside the open -concept design is filled with natural light and offers comfortable living spaces ideal for entertaining and everyday enjoyment. The Monaco plan includes unique architectural details and oversized windows to bring the indoor/outdoor feeling to every room. The spacious great room with dining area is accessed through the entry foyer and flows seamlessly to into the gourmet kitchen with upgraded built-in GE cook top and oven, featuring a large center island, counter seating, abundant cabinetry with under lights and a casual dining space with curved linear widows overlooking the front courtyard. The den with oversized windows captures mountain views and provides flexible space for an office, sitting or hobby area. The primary suite is a peaceful retreat with spectacular mountain views, a large walk-in closet, a beautifully appointed ensuite bathroom dual vanity and large shower with integrated seat. A separate versatile guest bedroom with adjacent full bathroom provides flexible space for visitors. Step outside to the expansive south facing backyard designed for year-round living. Enjoy the covered patio with ceiling fan, attractive paver landscape, accented by planters and gas BBQ connection; all framed by Santa Rosa Mountain views and vibrant sunrises & sunsets. Additional features include an indoor laundry room, attached two car garage with ample storage, energy efficient construction including a tankless hot water heater along with low maintenance landscaping allowing you to spend more time enjoying the community exceptional amenities. Trilogy at the Polo Club offers an unmatched active adult lifestyle with a spectacular clubhouse including June Hill's Table Restaurant overlooking the lake and Santa Rosa Mountains. The Polo Club offers a vibrant calendar of club activities and social events. Polo Club membership is available to transfer for $3,000.

text: Professionally updated by Flair Design Build, this special home - located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac within the gated community of Indian Palms Country Club - is full of personality and character. The rustic cottages of the Spanish Riviera provided inspiration for this home, giving it its relaxed, fresh design that is in keeping with the Mediterranean architecture of the home and the neighborhood - but with playful and comfortable styling, and fun vibes. This inviting home has two en suite bedrooms; a completely outfitted office that's big enough for a sleeper sofa to accommodate guests, including vacation rental guests as Indian Palms allows STVRs; a powder room; two temperature-controlled garages - a two-car garage with additional golf cart garage, and a 46-foot RV garage with hook-ups and 14-foot-tall rollup door. The RV garage is perfect not only for RVs, but also for a car collection (four to six cars could easily fit with lifts); workshop; extra storage; or for a fun rec room. Interior highlights include: CAFE kitchen appliances; decorative Spanish-style tiles; natural materials combined with vibrant pops of color and cheerful accents; up to 300-bottle, dual-zone wine cooler; Andersen sliding patio doors; custom, old-world wall finishes throughout; whole-house audio; water filtration system; built-in cabinetry; charming laundry room with stacked LG washer/dryer, countertop, drying rack, and storage; large format floor tile; designer lighting and fixtures; keyless entry at multiple points; and security system. Outside, the property features a private, fenced, fully-furnished back patio with a unique, built-in, wood-burning Santa Maria grill that doubles as a fire pit; KitchenAid natural gas grill; mature, low-maintenance landscaping; artificial turfed patio areas; citrus trees; multi-zone, timer-controlled irrigation; extensive landscape lighting; remote-controlled solar shades; multiple open-lattice covered patios; speakers at the back patio; security cameras; and ample driveway space. A truly lock-and-go property. Great for full-time or part-time use, and would also make a great income property for long- or short-term rental - especially for seasonal months, and for music festivals given the property is located within walking distance of the Empire Polo Club. Indian Palms Country Club community amenities include: on-site restaurant and bar, pools and hot tubs, golf, and lifestyle center. Furnished and accessorized per inventory list.

text: TURNKEY FURNISHED MANHATTAN MODEL in the exceptional, 24-hour guard-gated community of Indian Springs Country Club--a desert retreat open to all ages, not limited to 55+. One of the Coachella Valley's best-kept secrets, this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 3-bath home offers resort-style living, privacy, and sweeping golf course and mountain views. A welcoming rotunda entry opens to a spacious, light-filled great room with vaulted ceilings and an open-concept design ideal for entertaining. The inviting living area features an upgraded gas fireplace with log set, creating an elegant focal point for relaxing evenings. Throughout the home, remodeled 6x24 porcelain tile flooring and fresh interior paint provide a clean, modern feel. The gourmet kitchen features granite countertops, premium cabinetry, a center island, and breakfast bar, flowing seamlessly into the dining and great room areas. Large windows frame views of the pool, spa, and golf course, bringing the beauty of the desert surroundings indoors. The spacious primary suite offers golf course views and a well-appointed bath with dual vanities, Jacuzzi tub, separate shower, and generous walk-in closet. A versatile attached casita with its own remodeled bathroom and private exterior entrance provides an ideal space for guests, extended family, or a private retreat. A third guest bedroom and full bath complete the thoughtful floor plan. Outside, your private desert oasis awaits. The Pebble Tec pool and cascading spa are surrounded by an expansive patio designed for entertaining, while panoramic views across the par-3 3rd fairway and surrounding mountains create a peaceful backdrop for relaxing and enjoying the desert lifestyle. Additional features include a 2-car garage with built-in storage and a conveniently located interior laundry area near the garage and kitchen. Indian Springs residents enjoy an impressive array of amenities, including two fitness centers, two large lap pools, and BBQ areas for outdoor dining. The low HOA fee includes front-yard landscaping, tree trimming, and seasonal flowers. Ideally located near world-class golf, the Indian Wells Tennis Garden, polo grounds, Coachella and Stagecoach, dining, shopping, and major retailers, this turnkey furnished home offers an exceptional combination of comfort, amenities, privacy, and location--truly a desert lifestyle worth discovering.

text: Welcome to elevated desert living in this stunning 'Excite' floorplan, ideally situated in the premier 55+ community of Trilogy Polo Club. Set on a private lot adjacent to a wide-open greenbelt with no rear neighbors and only one side neighbor, this gorgeous home built by Shea Homes in 2021 offers 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and a versatile den that is perfect for a home office, additional guest space, or optional third bedroom. Loaded with designer upgrades, the home features plank tile flooring, 5.25'' baseboards, a modern Therma-Tru Pulse front door, and custom finishes throughout. The expansive great room opens seamlessly to the backyard through a triple-panel sliding glass door, creating effortless indoor-outdoor living. Favorable sun exposure provides early afternoon shade, allowing the outdoor space to remain comfortable and usable even on warm desert days. The chef's kitchen is both functional and beautifully appointed, featuring GE Cafe Series stainless steel appliances, a 6-burner gas cooktop, quartz countertops, soft-close cabinetry, and a spacious island with pendant lighting ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a floor-to-ceiling tiled, frameless glass shower and dual quartz vanities. Guests enjoy their own private en-suite, making it easy to host. Step outside to a resort-style backyard complete with a pool and CHILLER - perfect for staying cool through the summer months. Unlike many homes in the community, this lot offers unobstructed rear views so instead of looking out at another rooftop, you'll enjoy mountains, palm trees, and a greater sense of space. Additional highlights include a laundry room with sink, a leased 15-panel solar system keeping electric bills low, and a climate-controlled garage. Residents of Trilogy Polo Club enjoy a highly social, easy-to-plug-into lifestyle with scenic walking paths and access to resort-style amenities, including the clubhouse, fitness center, resort and lap pools, pickleball and tennis courts, golf simulator, social clubs, and the on-site restaurant, June Hill's Table. Conveniently located just minutes from shopping, dining, and everyday essentials in La Quinta or Indio, the community offers both connection and convenience. This home presents a rare opportunity to own a thoughtfully upgraded, move-in-ready residence in one of the desert's most sought-after active adult communities.

A southeast-facing orientation brings in abundant natural light, while peek-a-boo mountain views and an interior location in the ALL AGES section of Trilogy make this a perfect opportunity to downsize or a have a fun weekend getaway. The open-concept floor plan features high ceilings, tile floors, new carpet, and wood shutters for a clean, contemporary feel. The kitchen features modern looking upgraded cabinetry, granite countertops, bar seating, a dining nook, pantry, and opens to the living areas. The flexible den offers additional space for a home office, dining area, or multipurpose use. Outside, enjoy an extended concrete patio with artificial turf, saguaro cactus and lemon tree, and low-maintenance desert landscaping-an ideal setting for enjoying the morning sun and desert climate. The community features a peaceful scenic pond with views of the mountains, ducks and turtles, beautifully landscaped grounds, and walking trails. The clubhouse features an on-site restaurant open to the public. This home currently has a Polo Club membership that may be transferred to the buyer for a $3,000 fee, payable by buyer. The membership transfer is optional and is not required to purchase the home. Membership provides access to amenities and activities that may include social events, pickleball, tennis, swimming pools, fitness facilities, art club, and classes. (Additional fees may apply to certain activities and programs and there is a monthly fee for the membership which is currently $230/mo.) text: Welcome to Casa Bougainvillea, an elevated desert retreat where warm Hacienda character, resort-style outdoor living, and the energy of the Coachella Valley come together. Tucked inside a private gated community in Indio and just minutes from the iconic Empire Polo Grounds, this beautifully reimagined 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,590 square feet designed for effortless desert living. Whether you're searching for a personal vacation escape, a full-time home in the desert, or an established short-term rental investment, Casa Bougainvillea offers the flexibility to make it your own. Step inside and discover interiors thoughtfully inspired by the warmth of the desert and the romance of Hacienda and Moroccan style. An open, inviting layout creates an easy flow between the kitchen, dining, and living spaces, all equally suited for quiet mornings at home or weekends spent entertaining friends. Beyond the updated home, life at Casa Bougainvillea is meant to spill outdoors. The private, fully landscaped backyard feels like your own boutique desert resort, complete with a pool and spa, built-in BBQ, covered entertaining spaces, and multiple areas to lounge beneath the California sun or gather under the desert sky after dark. It's the kind of setting made for slow mornings by the water, sunset cocktails, festival weekends, and long evenings spent outside. Currently operating as a successful short-term rental, Casa Bougainvillea has generated over $52,000 in gross rental revenue year-to-date through September 2026, offering buyers a compelling opportunity to step into an established Indio investment property or Coachella Valley vacation rental. At the same time, the home remains equally appealing as a second home or primary desert residence. And the location is difficult to beat. From Casa Bougainvillea, you're just minutes from the Empire Polo Grounds, Coachella and Stagecoach festival venues, along with the dining, golf, shopping, recreation, and year-round experiences that make the Greater Palm Springs and Coachella Valley lifestyle so desirable. Come for the sunshine. Stay for the lifestyle. Invest in the possibilities. Welcome home to Casa Bougainvillea.

text: As you pass through the gated 55+ community at Trilogy at the Polo Club, one of the deserts premier lifestyle communities in the Coachella Valley, you're enveloped by tranquility. Manicured landscapes and elegant architecture invite you to embrace life of relaxation and luxury in your new home. This meticulously upgraded Affirm model offers 1622 square feet of sophisticated living. As you approach notice the striking Thermal Tru 4 panel front door with privacy glass, setting the tone for luxurious living. Step inside to an inviting entrance that leads to a spacious great room with 9 ft ceilings adorned with 5 1/2 inch baseboards. There are many amenities to take in, like the three pools, gym, pickleball, and various club spaces to keep you entertained. Experience the epitome of desert resort living. Your dream lifestyle awaits at Trilogy at the Polo Club.

text: Rare opportunity in the short-term-rental-approved section of Indian Palms Country Club. This 2019, energy-efficient golf-course pool home includes full access to clubhouse, fitness center, and community amenities not included in all HOA's within Indian Palms CC. Located minutes from the Empire Polo Club, making it an excellent investment for festival rentals during the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival and Stagecoach Festival. This attractively priced 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home is uniquely positioned on the golf course offering views of the mountains and signature island green on Mountain Hole 5. It features premium marble-look porcelain tile flooring throughout except the bedrooms, adding style, durability, and comfort to the space. The open-concept great room offers 9-foot ceilings and creates a seamless flow between all areas, making it ideal for entertaining or relaxed desert living. A modern fireplace anchors the living room, while the island-style kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a spacious pantry. The primary suite, positioned apart from guest bedrooms, offers privacy and views of the greens and mountains. A spacious bathroom with double sink vanity and a large walk-in closet complete the main suite. There are two additional bedrooms, two upgraded bathrooms, a large laundry room, a 2-car garage, and a 3rd garage for golf carts or additional storage. Step outside to your private, saltwater pool with tanning shelf and umbrellas, lush landscaping featuring citrus trees, and a private covered patio perfect for outdoor dining and BBQs with mountain views and beautiful Coachella Valley sunsets. The energy-efficient systems, including a tankless water heater and a Nest thermostat are an added bonus. Low HOA dues include front and back yard maintenance, security, and access to all resort amenities. Set within the historic Indian Palms Country Club, once the private playground of icons like Amelia Earhart, Clark Gable, and President Eisenhower, this community features: 27 holes of championship golf across three 9-hole courses (Mountain, Royal, Indian), initially designed by LPGA pioneer Helen Dettweiler, double-ended driving range, putting practice, golf shop, 5 tennis courts, community pools and hot tubs, fitness center & gym and on-site restaurant.

text: Welcome to exclusive Stonefield Estates, a gated community of only 25 semi-custom luxury homes on large lots. This 4BR/5BA home on a Premium Lot of over 2/3rd of an acre has been carefully maintained and upgraded by original owners. Stonefield Estates is located along what some call the Coachella Corridor, within a few hundred yards of the pedestrian entrance into Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival and Stagecoach. It is close to golf, hiking trails, restaurants and shopping, the Desert Int'l Horse Park, the Thermal Club (motorsports track) and much, much more. Offered unfurnished, but most of the furnishings (per inventory list) can be purchased outside of escrow. Showings by Appointment Only.

text: So, you want to live in A GATED COMMUNITY, ON A GOLF COURSE, WITH A VIEW, and a POOL BUT you don't want to spend $675,00. Fear not, as I have the home for you. As we enter this wonderful Bd 2.5 Ba + Bonus Rm/Den/Library/Sewing R,m BALBOA property in the highly sought after INDIAN SPRINGS COUNTRY CLUB, we are greeted by a light & bright great room. The property has a NORTH/SOUTH orientation, ideal positioning for the Coachella Valley. The inviting fireplace gives the home a warm & inviting quality. Two of the spacious MASTER BEDROOM SUITES, yes, I said TWO Master Suites, both of which have new carpeting, while the third bedroom is tiled as is the rest of the house. The wonderful kitchen has newish stainless-steel appliances (August 2019) and includes Microwave, Stove Top, Oven, Fridge, & Dishwasher. It has plenty of counter & cupboard space. There is a new water heater (August 2024). The garage door motor was replaced (April 2022). To cap it off, the property has a sparkling POOL, a VIEW, & is on the GOLF COURSE. If that isn't enough, & by all rights it should be, the pool is fully heated by a newer heater purchased in (June 2019) & a new heating system (June 2025). The filtration system was upgraded (December 2013), & a new cartridge filter system was installed (December 2023). To complete the improvement of the pool, it was resurfaced with pebble-tech technology (September 2019). As an added plus, the entire exterior of the house was repainted approximately 2 years ago. This is the Desert Outdoor Living experience at its finest. The BBQ was converted to propane (February 2024). A home like this doesn't come up very often. Indian Springs is home to the beautifully manicured Big Rock Golf Course; a challenging yet fair 18-hole par 72 track. SEEING IS BELIEVING, SO COME VIEW THIS VERY SPECIAL HOME!!!!

text: Experience the epitome of luxury living behind the gates of Stonefield Estates in South Indio's sought-after Festival Corridor. Ideally located within a short walk, drive, or bike ride from the Empire Polo Club-home to the iconic Coachella and Stagecoach Music Festivals. This stunning 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home boasts 3,932 square feet of meticulously designed living space on nearly an acre of estate-sized grounds. Beyond its refined living spaces, the home's rare proximity to the festival grounds creates a compelling opportunity for supplemental income, as its expansive layout and resort-style ambiance are ideally suited for Peerspace bookings by brands and private groups seeking distinctive event settings. Perfect for entertaining both indoors and outdoors, the property offers a long driveway and two spacious 2-car garages, one of which opens directly to the private backyard-an ideal setup for car enthusiasts. The welcoming front courtyard, complete with a cozy fireplace, sets the tone for memorable gatherings during the holiday season and beyond. Step through the formal entryway with its impressive rotunda, leading to a grand living room adorned with soaring ceilings, clerestory windows, a fireplace, and doors that open to the south and west-facing backyard. Culinary enthusiasts will delight in the gourmet kitchen, showcasing an oversized island, chic finishes, and top-of-the-line Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances. Just beyond the breakfast area, retreat to a covered patio offering breathtaking pool and mountain views. A series of tranquil waterfalls frame the saline pool and spa, creating a true resort-style experience. Inside, the bedrooms are thoughtfully positioned across separate wings of the home. The Primary Suite, with its private retreat, features direct patio access, expansive walk-in closets, dual vanities, a striking tiled shower, and a luxurious soaking tub. Junior Ensuite #2 offers charming courtyard views, while Junior Ensuites #3 and #4, each with their own private bath, are situated on the opposite side of the home. Ideally located near golf courses, restaurants, and retailers, this property truly has it all.

The primary bathroom fulfills your desires with dual sinks, walk-in custom closet and an idyllic tiled shower for an indulgent bathing experience. The guest bedroom with plush wool carpeting is adjacent to the guest bath for privacy and ease. The Den is your home office, perhaps a music room or a hobby space - you decide! The laundry room is well-placed between the kitchen and garage. Old Town La Quinta shopping and dining, Golf and Empire Polo all nearby. Unlock the door to your new beginning!

text: Exceptional move-in-ready home in the sought-after 55+ gated community of Las Brisas II-where comfort, privacy & thoughtful design come together to create the perfect desert retreat. Whether you're seeking a full-time residence, second home or seasonal getaway, this property offers a lifestyle defined by relaxation, convenience & effortless indoor/outdoor living. Step inside and take in the eye-catching interior with vaulted ceilings & plantation shutters throughout. The formal living & dining rooms provide elegant spaces for entertaining, anchored by a cozy fireplace for cool desert evenings. For everyday comfort, the separate family room sits adjacent to the chef's kitchen, creating a welcoming gathering space. The kitchen serves as the heart of the home w/ a butcher block island, abundant cabinetry & a spacious pantry-ideal for home chefs. A sliding door opens to the backyard, seamlessly connecting cooking & lounging spaces. Your private outdoor oasis awaits in the serene south-facing backyard. The saltwater pool & spa invite year-round rejuvenation-perfect for morning laps, low-impact exercise or unwinding beneath a starlit sky. An Alumawood patio cover spans the full length of the patio, offering shade and comfort while you enjoy panoramic mountain views & stunning pink and purple sunsets. The exquisite primary suite provides direct patio access, a large private bath & walk-in closet. Step right outside to the heated pool & spa-an unparalleled luxury for daily wellness rituals. A second bedroom sits separately from the primary w/adjacent bath, ideal for visiting guests. The third bedroom offers versatility as an office, den, or additional sleeping quarters. Practical features enhance everyday ease: a dedicated laundry room w/newer washer/dryer and storage cabinetry, plus RV parking with water & septic hookup-a rare and valuable amenity. Las Brisas II is a peaceful, well-managed community with friendly neighbors who value privacy. Enjoy gated entry, quiet streets, and a private parklet exclusively for residents and their pets-a perfect spot for morning walks, relaxation, or socializing outdoors. This prime location offers the best of both West Indio and La Quinta. Just outside the gates, you'll find local markets, cafes, and Old Town La Quinta with boutiques, restaurants, a weekly farmers market, and the renowned La Quinta Arts Festival. The Polo Grounds-home to the Coachella and Stagecoach festivals-are just minutes away.

The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat after a day on the golf course or at the festivals, complete with a luxurious ensuite bath featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Ideally situated near shopping, dining, and the vibrant energy of Indio's world-class events, this home captures the essence of desert luxury living. Whether as a full-time residence, seasonal getaway, or investment opportunity, this property delivers the perfect combination of comfort, sophistication, and location.

text: STUNNING RARE BEAUTY!!! Fully renovated and impeccably upgraded, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom plus den home offers 2,672 sq ft of sophisticated desert living in the highly sought-after 55+ resort community of Heritage Palms Country Club. Perfectly positioned on the 15th fairway, enjoy rare golf course views from both the front and back of the home, with breathtaking mountain vistas as your backdrop. From the moment you step through the leaded glass double entry doors, you'll be captivated by the bright, open layout, designer finishes, and high-end updates throughout. The gourmet kitchen is a showstopper, featuring quartz counters, a large island, glass mirror tile backsplash, professional-grade vented hood, double oven, built-in wine fridge, and gas stove (wired 220 for an electric induction cooktop). A stylish sliding barn door separates the kitchen from the laundry room. Tile floors flow throughout the home, custom shades, Nest thermostat, and Toto washlet toilets add both elegance and comfort. The den offers a built-in desk area, ideal for a home office. The spacious primary suite features patio access, a spa-like bathroom with soaking tub, quartz counters, a beautiful rain shower, and dual closets (large walk-in, and slider). The guest bedrooms are spacious and the guest bathroom is beautifully renovated. Enjoy the best of outdoor living with a saltwater pool and spa, two infrared patio heaters, alumawood awning/pergola, and panoramic mountain and golf course views. The oversized garage includes a mini-split A/C for climate control, added storage, and a dedicated golf cart space. This home features newer A/C units and hot water heater with recirculating pump. Located just a short walk from the clubhouse, this exquisite home is your gateway to the desert lifestyle, with access to golf, tennis, pickleball, indoor and outdoor pools, a fitness center, meeting rooms, card room, banquet facilities, billiard room, restaurant, and vibrant social scene. Don't miss this rare opportunity in one of the Coachella Valley's most desirable active adult communities.

text: Nestled within the exclusive gated community of The Gallery at Indian Springs, this exceptional home is designed for effortless entertaining and luxurious living. The seamless open floor plan blends modern style with comfort, featuring a private front entrance, a covered patio, a beautiful pool and spa, and breathtaking panoramic mountain viewsan ideal setting for both relaxation and social gatherings. The spacious great room is highlighted by an electric fireplace, an elegant built-in bar, and expansive sliding doors that open to the patio, pool, and stunning views.
