text: Experience elevated desert living in this beautifully upgraded, move-in ready home designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living. From the moment you arrive, the extensive custom paver hardscaping set the tone for a low-maintenance yet highly refined outdoor environment. The backyard is a true private retreat, showcasing a saltwater pool and spa with a stunning flagstone beach entry-creating a rare, resort-inspired setting perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. An outdoor shower with handheld fixture, set against a striking stacked-stone wall, adds a spa-like touch, while professionally designed landscaping features 14 towering palm trees, citrus trees including Meyer lemon and lime, and ambient lighting for magical desert evenings. A remote-controlled retractable awning provides shaded comfort, allowing you to enjoy the space year-round. Inside, the home is thoughtfully upgraded for both comfort and style, featuring wide-plank laminate flooring throughout (no carpet), crown molding, LED recessed lighting and surround sound speakers in the great room. Natural light fills the home through well-placed solar tubes in the kitchen, laundry and primary closet, enhancing the bright and welcoming atmosphere. The kitchen is designed to impress with quartz counters, full-height 42-inch cabinetry, an upgraded tile backsplash, and stainless steel KitchenAid appliances-perfectly blending functionality with modern design. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a sliding glass door providing direct access to the pool and backyard, along with a barn door entry to the en-suite bath. Additional features include custom wood shutters, room-darkening window treatments and ceiling fans throughout. Practical upgrades provide peace of mind, including a newer Lennox HVAC system (approx. 2 years old), a tankless water heater (approx. 1 year old), and a mini-split system in the garage-ideal for added comfort and flexibility. The garage is equally well appointed with epoxy finished flooring and overhead storage. This home seamlessly combines modern upgrades, energy efficiency and a resort-style outdoor living-offering the ultimate desert lifestyle. Residents of Sun City Shadow Hills enjoy resort-style amenities including golf, clubhouses, fitness centers, pools, tennis, pickleball, dining, and a vibrant social lifestyle--all with low HOA dues.''

text: Stunning custom home built by Fox Brothers, sits on an elevated golf course lot with views of a lake and the mountains beyond. text: The most extraordinary lot in Four Seasons Terra Lago is ready for its next chapter. Perched on a premium 13,068 square foot parcel with unobstructed golf course frontage overlooking the 16th tee and stunning 360-degree mountain views, this 2023 completed residence is in a class of its own within one of the Coachella Valley's most coveted 55+ communities. A FULLY OWNED and PAID OFF solar system conveys with the home, meaning no lease payments, no monthly surprises, and no inflated energy bills. Paired with access to the Imperial Irrigation District, which offers significantly lower rates than most of the valley, utility costs here are among the lowest you will find. Inside, 2,026 square feet of living space opens under soaring 9-foot ceilings. Upgraded porcelain tile flows throughout the main areas while 4-inch plantation shutters filter the abundant desert light. The chef's kitchen features dual ovens, a quartz island, stainless steel appliances, walk-in pantry, and roll-out cabinet drawers. The primary suite is a true retreat with a spa-inspired bath and custom California Closets walk-in system. The laundry room also features California Closets built-ins for maximum functionality. A flexible den is perfect as a home office, studio, or guest space. A tankless water heater adds modern efficiency. Outside, fully landscaped grounds showcase drought tolerant plantings, artificial turf, and mature fruit trees creating a private oasis framed by golf course and mountain views. The oversized three car tandem garage is a rare find in this community where most homes offer only two, with room for vehicles, a golf cart, and storage plus a dedicated EV charger already installed. The 22,000 square foot Four Seasons clubhouse delivers resort-style living with a fitness center, full-service salon, yoga and aerobics studios, library, billiard room, ballroom, bistro, and indoor and outdoor pools and spas. Championship golf, tennis, and pickleball are steps away, along with a year round calendar of clubs and social events. Perfectly positioned near Acrisure Arena, El Paseo dining and shopping, world class golf, local casinos, the Palm Springs Aerial Tramway, and quick freeway access. La Quinta, Palm Desert, and Palm Springs are each a short drive away. Turnkey and move-in ready. Schedule your private showing today!

text: Welcome to Casa de Los Sueno's " House of Dreams ". This Southwestern sanctuary is located in the Sedona community in the unincorporated city of Bermuda Dunes! Situated on a Cul de Sac street of homes of similar quality of construction and appeal, this home is ready for you to purchase as your primary dream home OR it is turnkey furnished and ready to operate as an Airbnb for which it is currently being used as! Minimal rental restrictions here!!! Polo grounds just a few minutes away. Most all community services are within excellent proximity as is freeway 10 access! Casa de Los Sueno's has an excellent floor plan which include a large kitchen with an island, breakfast counter, coffee bar and large dining room area which seats 12. Off of the Dining area is a separate extra-large bedroom/bathroom that is currently used to sleep 6 comfortably with its own self-contained fully upgraded bathroom and eating area. This room could easily be used as self-contained guest quarters or a separate rental from the main house, it is self-contained and accessed from the interior of the home and has a separate exterior door as well. There is a great room off of the kitchen with a raised hearth fireplace. The living room has high ceilings and opens up to the rear extensive concrete patio and saltwater pool which has all newer pool equipment and heater. In addition there is a concrete retaining wall which is elevated to the rear neighbor and offers excellent privacy. The primary suite is separated from the other three bedrooms and is an ensuite which offers remodeled bathroom with dual sink, soaking tub and large glass enclosed shower with bench and assist handle. The front of the property has a long concrete driveway which leads to an insulated oversized two car garage. The front entry is enclosed with a front courtyard fence and patio area. There are dual zoned HVAC units which are located on the roof and two water heater tanks. The HOA has two small grass areas along with the SEDONA sign, those are the only common areas for which there is an annual HOA fee of $240.00 per YEAR! This development has extremely amazing AIRBNB potential with minimal restrictions as well as a private dream home potential for you to own!

text: A rare opportunity to acquire a proven, high-performing lakefront short-term rental in Terra Lago--positioned for the investor who understands that the best STR acquisitions combine documented revenue, differentiated amenities, a strong depreciation basis, and the ability to perform from day one. This fully established 3-bedroom, 3-bath, 2,157-square-foot lakefront retreat generated $131,000 in verified gross rental revenue in 2025 and is currently on pace to exceed that performance in 2026. Unlike a speculative STR purchase where the buyer must renovate, furnish, build reviews and establish a rental history, this property already has the amenities and proven performance guests are looking for. The outdoor space is the centerpiece: a private saltwater pool and spa, expansive lake and mountain views, commercial-grade misters, lakeside fire pit, built-in BBQ, covered outdoor TV lounge and multiple entertaining areas create a true resort-style guest experience. Inside, the property features an open entertaining layout, custom bar, upgraded finishes, custom TV wall and a private primary-suite balcony overlooking the water. An arcade/game-room component further enhances the property's appeal to vacation-rental guests. The home accommodates up to 10 guests and has been thoughtfully positioned to compete in Indio's event-driven STR market. For investors focused on tax efficiency, the numbers become even more compelling. Public tax records currently allocate approximately $302,757 to land and $706,429 to improvements, meaning roughly 70% of the current assessed value is attributed to improvements rather than non-depreciable land. A buyer should have their CPA and cost-segregation specialist establish the appropriate allocation at acquisition, but the property's substantial building and amenity basis--including the pool, spa, outdoor improvements, furnishings and qualifying components--could make it an attractive candidate for a cost-segregation study and accelerated depreciation, subject to the buyer's individual tax situation. Compass For a 1031 exchange buyer, this is an opportunity to move equity into an established income-producing vacation rental rather than starting from scratch. For the hybrid buyer, it offers something equally compelling: a lakefront desert residence that can be personally enjoyed while producing meaningful rental income when not in use. And for an investor looking to enter the STR market, the property provides a documented operating history and an established guest-oriented amenity package. Located within gated Terra Lago, adjacent to the golf course and minutes from the attractions and major events that drive Coachella Valley tourism, this is more than a furnished vacation home--it's an opportunity to acquire a proven hospitality asset with six-figure gross revenue, significant depreciable improvements, and continued upside.

text: A Private Desert Paradise in Prestigious Bermuda Dunes Country Club. Experience refined resort-style living in this immaculate 4-bedroom, 3-bath home, nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Bermuda Dunes Country Club. A gated entry courtyard with arbors and low-maintenance desert landscaping sets a tranquil, upscale tone from the moment you arrive. Inside, elegant formal living and dining rooms are complemented by vaulted ceilings, Italian stone floors, plantation shutters, and custom French doors that open to an extraordinary outdoor retreat. Just minutes from the Bermuda Dunes Airport-''Gateway to the Desert''-this residence blends resort living with unmatched convenience. Low HOA dues include cable TV with HBO and Showtime, WiFi, and 24/7 guard-gated security. Club membership is optional and offers access to the clubhouse, fitness center, bocce ball, and world-class golf across 27 beautifully designed holes.

text: This incredible 2022 new build in the beautiful Paradiso gated community along the mountain range is a must see. The style and beauty of this particular home is not seen anywhere in the community. It is a 4 bedroom and 2 full bath with an incredible interior. The amount of extras in the home are too many to detail. It is a smart home that you are able to control lighting, garage door, and appliances, as well as offers fire sprinklers throughout. With new water con serving landscape as you walk up to the home is a relaxing oasis and in the evening you can enjoy the large back patio. The solar panels are owned outright on top of a clay roof. The entry with office/workout/ reading area off to side, the new flooring is amazing and scratch and water resistance in the kitchen and living areas. The kitchen wide open has new quartz counters, Reverse Osmosis Flo water monitoring system, walk-in pantry, coffee area, new appliances, and a huge island for cooking and entertaining, the living room also wide open to the back and has the most relaxing atmosphere, and gas fireplace. As you make your way to the bedrooms they are large and roomy, with tons of closet space, a common bathroom huge, that is bright and long counter and full bath with shower and bathtub. The laundry just off the inside separated and has its own storage on doors. Then you make your way to the master bedroom (ensuite) that is so spacious and bright with natural light much like the rest of the home, with the bathroom being wide open and beautiful. Also comes with tankless water heater and ring door system. With a large open backyard with grass area for pets or kids, nice open patio with lighting and fan perfect to relax in the morning or evenings. The garage is a 3 car garage with two charging stations for electric vehicles both 220V. The home HOA includes internet and cable TV, parks and walking areas, and a playground. Awesome views of the mountain range. This home is near so many amenities, a growing community and a short distance to Joshua Tree national park.

This popular layout features 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, plus a versatile den, ideal for a home office, hobby room, or additional guest space. From the moment you step inside, you'll appreciate the elegant diagonal tile flooring throughout, creating a seamless, open flow and a bright, airy feel. The spacious great room opens effortlessly to the kitchen and dining area--perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen offers rich cabinetry, granite slab countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a generous island with bar seating. Large windows and sliding glass doors invite natural light while connecting you to the beautifully landscaped backyard. The primary suite is a relaxing retreat with dual vanities, a walk-in shower, and ample closet space. A well-separated guest bedroom and full bath provide comfort and privacy for visitors. Step outside to your covered patio--an inviting space for morning coffee or evening gatherings--overlooking low-maintenance desert landscaping and lush turf. Whether you're dining al fresco, lounging in the sun, or hosting friends, this backyard offers the perfect setting to enjoy the desert lifestyle. text: Situated on an oversized corner lot, this beautifully appointed residence offers exceptional indoor-outdoor living and sweeping mountain views from the upper level. The private backyard is a true outdoor oasis, featuring a custom 30-foot saltwater pool with Baja bench, aerator for wave-style movement, two decorative bowl fountains, and four cascading water arches. A spacious spa with waterfall spillover enhances the resort-style setting. Thoughtful design elements include a hidden drain seamlessly integrated into the brickwork, a natural gas fire pit for evening gatherings, and remote-controlled accent lighting surrounding the fire feature. Mature landscaping includes lime and orange trees, creating a lush and inviting atmosphere. Expanded driveway designed to accommodate RV or recreational vehicle parking, along with a generous three-car garage featuring epoxy flooring and additional covered parking. Inside, the flexible floor plan provides a full bedroom plus a den and 3/4 bath on the main level, along with two generous living areas ideal for entertaining or multi-generational living. Upstairs features an additional expansive living area, well-sized secondary bedrooms, and a spacious primary suite positioned to capture beautiful mountain views. The primary retreat includes a substantial walk-in closet, dual vanity sinks, a soaking tub, and a separate walk-in shower. Recent improvements include a newer A/C unit for the upstairs, new carpet on the staircase and in the upstairs flex room, upgraded flooring in one of the upstairs bedrooms and a newer dishwasher. Residents enjoy access to six lush parks and playgrounds within the community.

text: Welcome to the CASTELLANO MODEL-where charm meets grandeur. This is a great Corner-Lot with lovely curb appeal. A half-walled courtyard greets you as you approach. What a perfect spot to have dinner al fresco with palm trees rising like royalty against the distant mountain views. Entering the home you immediately find an office or den space. This room could easily be used as a 3rd guest bedroom. Traveling further into the home you will find the forgotten treasure of a formal dining room. Perfect for those large gatherings or hosting a mahjong game night. The stylish, open-concept kitchen was designed for everyday ease but clothed in rich granite and maple hued cabinets. This kitchen features sleek stainless-steel appliances-including a double wall oven, dishwasher, microwave, double sink & a sleek black 5 burner cook top. A central island offers additional prep space and storage. A cozy breakfast nook completes the kitchen area. The open layout flows effortlessly with bar seating off the kitchen counter into the adjacent living room, creating a seamless space for entertaining or relaxing. Large windows & a massive sliding glass door with plantation shutters bathe the room in natural light. A guest half bath & laundry room with tons of cabinets & a utility sink, round out this area. The Bedrooms are on opposite sides of the home, evoking separate wing living. The master is large & bright with a master bathroom retreat. A glass-enclosed shower with a built-in bench offers both comfort & accessibility, while the adjacent soaking tub-set beneath welcoming windows-creates the perfect spot to unwind in natural light. The dual-sink vanity stretches across the opposite wall and features sleek solid-surface countertops. There is an expansive walk-in closet with plenty of room for all your shoes or clothes obsessions. The 2nd bedroom is down its own hallway with a full bathroom located right before entering. Venturing out to the back yard you will find your own serene retreat-this beautifully landscaped backyard offers relaxation by the fire-pit, mountain views, & a lemon tree that is ready to lend its zest to your next cocktail. The covered patio is ideal for morning coffee, evening cocktails, or weekend gatherings. This spotless, oversized 2.5 car garage is a dream for homeowners who value organization & functionality. Ceiling-mounted metal grid racks provide overhead storage, while custom wall-mounted cabinets keep tools & supplies neatly tucked away.

This newer section of the community is known for its modern homes and convenient access to resort-style amenities. The home features a contemporary front elevation with low-maintenance desert landscaping and sits on a generous lot with ample space for a future swimming pool. Inside, the well-designed layout includes 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a versatile den that can easily function as a third bedroom or home office. The interior showcases 24' x 24' tile flooring laid on the diagonal throughout the main living areas, plantation shutters throughout, and freshly updated designer white paint, creating a bright and cohesive aesthetic. The kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring crisp white cabinetry, coordinating white appliances, granite countertops, and a stool-height island that opens seamlessly to the dining area and spacious great room-ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with direct patio access via sliding glass doors, a charming barn door entry to the bathroom, dual vanities, a glass-enclosed shower, and a generous walk-in closet. Both the primary and guest bedroom closets feature new diagonal-pattern carpet for added comfort. The extended garage includes an insulated overhead door, anchored storage cabinets, and a convenient man door providing direct access to the sidewalk and driveway. Step outside to a beautifully enhanced backyard retreat, featuring an extended concrete patio with Alumawood cover, a fire pit, three raised garden beds, and plenty of space to relax or entertain while enjoying breathtaking sunset skies. This outdoor setting truly elevates the desert lifestyle experience. This home offers an exceptional blend of comfort, style, outdoor living, and prime location close to the clubhouse and amenities-a must-see opportunity in Sun City Shadow Hills.

text: Refined Desert Living at Its Finest | 81569 Corte Monteleon. Experience the serenity of desert mornings and the golden glow of evening sunsets in this beautifully designed Socialite floor plan within Sun City Shadow Hills, Indio's premier 55+ resort community. Built in 2012 and meticulously maintained, this 3-bedroom, 3-bath residence offers 2,955 sq. ft. of refined living on a 7,405 sq. ft. lot. Step inside and be greeted by elegant tile floors that flow seamlessly through open-concept living spaces, drawing your gaze to breathtaking south-facing views of twin lakes and the 6th hole, framed by the majestic San Jacinto Mountains. Enjoy tranquil mornings and golden evenings in your private backyard retreat, complete with a sparkling saltwater spool accented by graceful Greek-inspired water features and a built-in BBQ station ideal for al fresco entertaining. Inside, entertaining is effortless. The chef's kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring stainless steel appliances, a generous island with seating for four, a spacious pantry, and an adjoining office nook perfect for quiet mornings or creative afternoons. Nearby, the wet bar, finished with rich dark wood wine racks and a wine fridge, sets the stage for memorable gatherings. A double-sided fireplace adds warmth between the great room and dining area, while a wide-blade ceiling fan stirs a gentle breeze beneath soaring ceilings. The primary suite is a serene sanctuary with two oversized closets, dual vanities, a deep soaking tub with a ledge, and a separate shower for spa-like relaxation. Living in Sun City Shadow Hills means more than owning a home. It is an invitation to embrace a lifestyle. Enjoy championship golf, two clubhouses, state-of-the-art fitness centers, indoor and outdoor pools, tennis and pickleball courts, dog parks, and more than 60 active clubs. Whether your passion is art, music, sports, or community, you will find your rhythm here. Welcome to your private desert paradise.

text: Bermuda Dunes CC - Enjoy the daily magic as sunlight filters through floor-to-ceiling French doors into a Great Room where the boundaries between indoor and outdoor living dissolve completely at this remarkable Bermuda Dunes Country Club estate, a 4, 708 sq. ft. testament to sophistication that commands its elevated position above the 8th fairway. Recently transformed through an exhaustive two year collaboration with Desert Modern Design + Build, the home marries the romance of Modern Spanish design with the ease of contemporary desert living. The result is a residence that feels both rooted in tradition and entirely of the moment, where hand troweled mission finish walls meet sleek Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances. The journey begins in a cobblestone courtyard, where mature desert landscaping creates an intimate prelude to the homes pice de rsistance: an 18-foot beamed rotunda entry that announces the architectural ambitions within. Here, soaring 11 foot ceilings become the standard rather than the exception, carrying through the Great Room, the chefs kitchen, and the nearly 1, 000 sq. ft. primary suite. At the heart of the home, the kitchen doesnt merely function, it performs. A dramatic 70 square foot island anchors the space around the farmhouse sink, wine storage and professional-grade appliances. Above, coffered ceilings create architectural rhythm, while a handcrafted wrought-iron beehive fireplace adds an artisanal counterpoint to the modern functionality. The primary suite occupies its own wing of tranquility. Morning arrives gently here, illuminating the hardwood floors, with a private balcony accompanied by fairway views. Dual walk-in closets, a fireplace, and a spa-like bathroom with freestanding soaking tub create a private resort within the residence. This homes true genius reveals itself in its multi-generational flexibility. A lower level bonus space adapts effortlessly from home office to fitness studio to creative workshop. The attached casita, nearly 500 sq. ft., with a private entrance offers sophisticated autonomy for guests or extended family. Outside, the blue Talavera tiled pool and spa anchor an entertainment complex with outdoor fireplace and lawn theater area. Four bedrooms, four baths, four fireplaces and an oversized three-car garage complete this exceptional offering. This is an incomparable opportunity that will continue to provide an extraordinary setting for all who have the pleasure of spending time here.

Sun City Shadow Hills is a premier 55+ community, and this home is just a short walk to the Santa Rosa clubhouse & fitness center for gym, pickle ball, tennis, bocce ball and a Nationally ranked Executive par 3 golf course. text: 4 acres of country living right off of Washington St. This stately, custom, Spanish style home of approx. 4800 sf with 4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms, has been thoughtfully remodeled and updated, including the kitchen, bathrooms and bedrooms, while adhering to the original architectural details. Enter the arched Mahogany front doors to a gracious foyer, calling attention to the multiple brick interior archways featured throughout. Venetian Tile and floating wood floors under wood beamed vaulted ceilings, add to the grace of this home. Flawless indoor to outdoor flow with glass sliders opening to the interior courtyard, and the backyard with it's pool and spa plus an outdoor cook station. Acres of grass, birds and leafy trees lead to the 6 stalls, a kennel, tack/feed room and a triple garage. Unique to this property is all the water! A private well with 2 pressure tanks and a 5000 gal holding tank plus city water to site. Over 70 mature and diverse varieties of trees, including lemon, lime, grapefruit, kumquat, orchid, olive & pepper. The electronic entry gate opens to a long driveway with a circular turn around for easy in and out. Multiple archways decorate the exterior and encircle the front entry courtyard. There is another circular driveway behind the home, and a second gated entry into the pastures, as well as several pedestrian gates. Current zoning allows for horses and a secondary home can be built. Land use is MDR, (Medium Density Residential), so there is the possibility for further development of this property. (Buyer to verify). Bermuda Dunes is under the jurisdiction of the County of Riverside and is short term rental approved, making this property perfect for festival season or events. Close to shopping, dining, hwy 111 and the 10 fwy. You do not want to miss this incredible opportunity! Appointment only. County zoning, parcel report and amenities are attached under documents.

Whether you're soaking in the desert sun or stargazing by the fire pit, this home provides the perfect backdrop for relaxation and fun. This masterpiece is nestled in the heart of Sun City Shadow Hillswhere timeless design and modern comforts blend in perfect harmony. This 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom, 2, 433 sq. ft. home is more than just a residence; it's a serene desert sanctuary designed for both quiet moments and vibrant gatherings. Elegant ceramic tile spans the main living areas, while warm laminate wood flooring adds comfort to the bedrooms. A stately fireplace and rich, floor-to-ceiling darkwood built-in entertainment center anchor the great room in style. Upgraded ceiling fans, lighting fixtures, and 4-inch plantation shutters throughout the home create a gentle ambiance from dawn to dusk. The kitchen is the heart of this homeoffering stainless steel appliances, a stylish tile backsplash, and a spacious island with secondary breakfast bar extension, comfortably seating 4 or more. A thoughtfully integrated desk at the end of the counter provides flexible space for work, planning, or extra prep. Adjacent dining areas flow easily, perfect for both intimate meals and festive occasions. The expansive master suite is a true private retreat, complete with dual vanities, a large shower stall, a separate soaking tub, and a generous closeta spa-like oasis designed for rest and renewal. Outside, your personal paradise awaits. The lushly landscaped backyard is wrapped in privacy greenery accented by yard lighting, creating a secluded haven. A wide-blade fan spins gently over the extended Alumawood-covered patio, where you'll find a built-in BBQ ready for summer feasts. At the center of it all: a stunning, 12' x 40' saltwater pebble tech lap pool with three cascading waterfalls and multi-colored underwater lightinga space where evenings shimmer and time slows down. Additional highlights include a versatile den, separate living and great rooms, a new kitchen refrigerator as well as a second garage refrigerator, an extended garage with epoxy flooring plus evaporative cooler, and a completely new HVAC system installed in 2023. Sun City Shadow Hills Amenities: Enjoy two clubhouses, indoor and outdoor pools, an 18-hole championship golf course, tennis and pickleball courts, walking and biking trails, and a state-of-the-art fitness center. text: Welcome to Whittier Ranch -- one of the Coachella Valley's most sought-after communities, with No HOA fees and no Mello-Roos tax. This beautifully appointed single-story home offers 4 spacious bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and an open, light-filled layout designed for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. Soaring ceilings and generous natural light set a welcoming tone from the moment you enter. Elegant wood plank tile floors flow throughout the main living areas, transitioning to soft luxury vinyl plank in the bedrooms for a cozy, refined feel underfoot. At the heart of the home, an expansive great room connect the kitchen, dining, and living areas seamlessly together. A chef-inspired kitchen featuring a 6-seat island, custom granite countertops, rich mahogany cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a large walk-in pantry. A sun-drenched breakfast nook opens directly to the backyard through a slider, blending indoor warmth with outdoor living. A private guest bedroom and full bath near the entry offer a gracious retreat for visitors or an inspiring home office. Three additional oversized bedrooms are tucked down a hallway, including a generous primary suite with dual vanities, a large walk-in shower, and a well-positioned walk-in closet, plus private patio access to the backyard. Outside, your own personal oasis awaits -- a extended covered patio and a separate Alumawood patio area, a built-in crushed glass fire pit with wrap-around bench seating, a custom smart-app heated pool with cantilevered spillways and a raised spa, a 3-hole artificial turf putting green, and beautifully landscaped grounds with ample entertaining space. The attached 3-car garage is accessible through a large indoor laundry room. Plantation shutters throughout the main living areas, bathrooms, and front bedroom help keep the home cool and stylish year-round. The Whittier Ranch community has spectacular mountain views, community sidewalks, a fully equipped park, proximity to schools, shopping, dining, and is walking distance to Indian Palms Country Club and Empire Polo Club; home of the Stagecoach & Coachella festivals making this a rare opportunity. ** This beautifully maintained home is currently operating as a successful Short-Term Rental, offering excellent income potential.

text: Welcome to 520 W Via Lola, a reimagining of modernist design rooted in the principles of International Style architecture. Spanning approximately 4,581 square feet, the home offers 4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms which includes an attached casita. Interior architectural atriums invite natural light deep into the living spaces, creating a seamless indoor outdoor flow. Guided by the philosophy that form follows function, this residence blends clean geometry, purposeful space, and a refined sense of minimalism. Located in the sought after neighborhood of Old Las Palmas the estate was originally built in 1954 and transformed in 1984 by designer James Callahan. His vision draws clear inspiration from Walter Gropius, Le Corbusier and Richard Meier, resulting in a residence that feels both architecturally significant and livable. Upstairs, two expansive patios frame panoramic mountain views, capturing the essence of desert living. The fully walled and gated grounds provide privacy and serenity, set among mature palms and notable neighboring estates - including the former home of Kirk Douglas, Sidney Sheldon, Kitty Karlisle, and Winthrop Rockefeller. This is a piece of architectural narrative, evolved for modern luxury living - minutes to the new Soho House Palm Springs, multiple hotels slated to complete renovations 2026, The Plaza Theatre set to reopen this year along with a restaurant scene setting up for a revival of the good times of the legendary Rat Pack era for today's lifestyle.

text: Extensively reimagined with a striking ultra-modern aesthetic, this 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath detached residence located on land you own at Canyon Estates blends iconic mid-century architecture with today's most desired finishes, systems, and indoor/outdoor lifestyle. Originally designed by Charles Du Bois, AIA, the home offers nearly 3,000 square feet of light-filled living space framed by panoramic mountain views and a private resort-style yard complete with saline pool, spa, and fire pit. Tall ceilings, clerestory windows, and multiple sets of sliding glass doors create dramatic architectural volume while seamlessly connecting the interiors to the surrounding landscape. A formal entry opens to expansive living and dining areas anchored by a wet bar and walls of glass that showcase the mountain views beyond. The gourmet kitchen has been thoughtfully redesigned with sleek modern cabinetry, quartzite countertops, built-in appliances, and a casual dining area that opens directly to the outdoors. An adjacent butler's pantry with wine refrigeration, laundry area, and direct garage access enhances both functionality and entertaining. The Primary Suite enjoys backyard access, panoramic views, dual walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired bath with oversized walk-in shower and dual vanities. Guest Suite Two offers a walk-in closet and adjacent bath, while Bedroom Three currently styled as a media lounge to provide flexibility for guests or office use. Additional upgrades include solar panels, a newer roof, and recently installed HVAC systems. Residents of Canyon Estates enjoy access to a 9-hole golf course, tennis courts, fitness center, and 14 pools and spas, while the HOA includes exterior landscaping, cable, earthquake insurance, and exterior maintenance. Architectural pedigree, premier finishes, and exceptional views come together in one of South Palm Springs' most iconic communities.

text: Some homes offer square footage. This one offers a way of life. Set within the sought after Four Seasons at Terra Lago, this 3 bed, 3 bath + den retreat spans 2,411 sq ft and was designed with intention at every turn. Dual en-suite guest rooms offer privacy and comfort, while the flexible den invites whatever suits your season of life. A personal favorite feature: the laundry room connects directly to the primary bedroom walk-in closet, a small detail that makes everyday living feel effortlessly luxurious. Outside, a private saltwater Spool that is heated, chilled, and fitted with therapeutic jets and a serene water feature, anchors a backyard built for pure relaxation. The north facing orientation is a prized desert advantage: natural shade, cooler temperatures, and energy savings that make summer living a pleasure rather than a chore. The community matches the home in every way. At its center stands The Lodge, an expansive 22,000 sq ft clubhouse with a state of the art fitness center, indoor lap pool, aerobics and yoga studio, arts and crafts studio, full service beauty salon with massage room, library lounge, game room, billiards lounge, and bistro. Step outside and the resort experience continues with a pool and spa, patio, fire pit, tennis and pickleball courts, bocce ball, horseshoes, and basketball. Two championship 18-hole courses at the Golf Club at Terra Lago are right next door and Beyond the gates, the Coachella Valley delivers in every direction. Just minutes away, Fantasy Springs Resort Casino offers live concerts, dining, bowling, and gaming and the surrounding mountains and canyons are laced with hiking and biking trails for those who love the outdoors. Easy freeway access puts you just minutes from the shopping and dining of Palm Desert, the energy of Acrisure Arena, and the iconic charm of downtown Palm Springs. Whether you're browsing the galleries of El Paseo, catching a world-class show, or simply enjoying a quiet dinner close to home, everything you need is within easy reach. This is 55+ living, beautifully redefined.

text: The Factor Residence (Hank Webber + Don Staska, 1969) When Jerome Factor commissioned architects Hank Webber and Don Staska to design a desert retreat on one of Canyon Country Club's premier fairway lots in 1969, the brief was uncompromising: absolute privacy, monumental presence, and an interior world capable of housing one of the most remarkable private art collections in the American West.The result with interiors by the celebrated Chicago decorator Richard Himmel and landscape architecture by David Hamilton, ASLA was a compound that read, from the street, as a study in restraint. The brutalist stucco facade, entirely windowless and relentlessly horizontal, disclosed nothing of what lay within. It was, and remains, one of the most architecturally confident statements in Palm Springs: a house that keeps its own counsel.Inside, the scale is immediate and total. Twelve-foot ceilings span 5,500 square feet of living space organized around a gallery-length entrance corridor designed from the outset to display Pop and Op Art at a scale worthy of the work and a vast living and entertaining sequence anchored by a black granite fireplace wall and framed by bronze-tinted glass walls opening to the San Jacinto Mountains. The pool terrace, engineered to accommodate events for up to three hundred guests beneath a canopied sky, completes a compound conceived for both intimate retreat and grand occasion.The Factor Residence was featured across six pages of color photography in House Beautiful, April 1973 a distinction that recognized not merely the architecture but the singular totality of the vision: building, landscape, furnishings, and collection conceived and executed as one. That totality endures. Nearly all of the furniture and art museum quality, original to the Factor family remains in place, an extraordinary continuity that transforms the estate from a significant residence into a living record of one of California's great mid-century collecting traditions.Documented in Steve Treinen's Canyon Country Club: History and Design of Palm Springs' Garden of Eden and recognized among the finest preserved examples of large-scale California Modern architecture in the Coachella Valley, the Factor Residence is offered for the first time since 2017. At 5,500 square feet on a half-acre fairway lot, with three bedrooms, five baths, and an irreplaceable collection intact, it represents a convergence of architecture, history, and provenance that the market will not see again.

text: An elegant, simple, refined, 1958 William Krisel, Alexender built, home in the iconic neighborhood of Sunmor is awaiting a new owner. All work has been completed so you can move right in and enjoy. This home sets the standard for a restored Kriesel with an amazing attention to detail by the current owner who went so far as to source one of the original stone masons from the Alexander Company to replicate the stone placement for the new outdoor fireplace to match existing stone cladding on the home's front facade. Upgrades and completed projects in the past three years include: NEW foam roof, NEW exterior paint, NEW HVAC, NEW water filtration system, and a NEW water heater. There are also NEW window coverings and exterior shades. The pool was remodeled (but the midcentury shape remains) with the addition of a saltwater system, new tile, new coping, all new equipment. This is all set in an amazing yard with new landscaping and underground (yes, underground) sod watering system and outdoor fireplace. Palm trees were added, as were boulders and Ficus. The kitchen and baths were remodeled by a previous owner. This home is on fee (owned) land and has leased solar. For buyers who simply want to soak in midcentury living without having to do weekend projects for years and years and years this is the house for you. Step in, take a breath, soak it up, and enjoy this home. All other homes will pale by comparison. We have a binder with receipts and maintenance records, which were done by the seller. This home is gladly shown by appointment.

text: Welcome to this exquisitely renovated Meiselman home tucked away on a charming cul-de-sac in coveted Sunrise Park, where soaring vaulted wood ceilings, expansive walls of glass, and breathtaking panoramic mountain views create an unforgettable Palm Springs living experience. Beyond the gated courtyard entry, guests are welcomed by a striking fountain water feature that leads directly into a dramatic living room. Thoughtfully reimagined with timeless sophistication, this extensively renovated residence captures the essence of elevated desert design while offering seamless indoor-outdoor living. Situated on an expansive lot, this stunning property offers 3 bedrooms and 2 baths. Dramatic clerestory windows and Fleetwood sliders flood the home with natural light while connecting the spacious open-concept living and dining spaces to the spectacular outdoor areas. The designer kitchen features custom minimalist cabinetry, quartz countertops, a Viking range, and Sub-Zero refrigerator. Designer lighting and a striking statement fireplace beautifully anchor the living and dining spaces. Fleetwood pass-through windows open directly to the outdoor entertaining areas, creating effortless flow throughout the home. The luxurious primary suite offers a spa-inspired retreat complete with a deep soaking tub, oversized walk-in shower with seamless glass enclosure, spacious dressing area, and direct access to a private outdoor shower. Towering mature hedges frame the spectacular backyard, creating exceptional privacy while showcasing breathtaking San Jacinto Mountain views. Designed for exceptional outdoor living, the expansive covered lanai features a built-in Viking barbecue, dining bar, multiple lounging and entertaining areas, firepit, oversized spa, and a stunning 60-foot rectangular pool with oversized tanning shelf. Fleetwood sliders open from the living room, bedrooms, and primary suite directly onto the patios, pool, and lush outdoor spaces, embodying the quintessential Palm Springs lifestyle. Sunrise Park remains one of central Palm Springs' most desirable neighborhoods and is also one of the few neighborhoods currently well below the city's 20% short-term rental cap, leaving applications open for a STR Permit -- and best of all, you own the land. Minutes to the Tahquitz Corridor, Alice B., John Henry's, Sherman's Deli, Palm Springs International Airport, and 5 minutes to downtown Palm Springs shopping, museums, celebrated restaurants, and vibrant Arenas nightlife.

text: Framed by mature Ficus trees and set behind a newly automated artistic gate, 206 E. Morongo welcomes you into an extraordinary private courtyard retreat. Located on one of the most coveted streets in all of Palm Springs, 206 E. Morongo captures the essence of timeless desert luxury. Nestled just off South Palm Canyon Drive, this highly sought-after neighborhood is celebrated for its gentle desert breezes, breathtaking mountain vistas, and iconic Palm Springs charm. This magnificently remodeled Spanish-style estate seamlessly blends classic architecture with refined modern luxury. Thoughtfully curated finishes, designer-selected color palettes, and rich wood flooring flow beautifully throughout the residence. Offering four bedrooms and four beautifully remodeled bathrooms, the home is designed for both elegant entertaining and relaxed everyday living. The remodeled kitchen showcases quartz countertops, a stainless-steel sink, and premium finishes while opening effortlessly into the dining and living spaces. Additional highlights include a beverage center, indoor laundry room, and a warm, inviting living room designed with both sophistication and comfort in mind. Two luxurious primary en-suites offer direct access to the resort-style pool and backyard, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience. Modern technology has been thoughtfully integrated throughout the property. Newly installed climate-control systems, automated window coverings, and spa controls can all be managed directly from your phone, allowing you to cool the home, warm the spa, and prepare the residence for your arrival from anywhere in the world. The detached casita offers a private luxury retreat complete with its own bedroom, kitchenette, bathroom, and sitting area - ideal for visiting family, long-term guests, a quiet home office, or an inspiring studio space. Designed to embody the absolute best of Palm Springs living, the expansive resort-style backyard is truly one of the estate's defining showpieces. The grounds comfortably accommodate large-scale entertaining while still offering intimate spaces for quiet relaxation. The outdoor setting features a generously sized sparkling pool and spa, cabana, outdoor fireplace, firepit, and multiple lounge and entertaining areas. Both indoor and outdoor fireplaces create warmth, ambiance, and an elevated atmosphere throughout the property.

text: One of the most unique and affordable opportunities on an expansive 18,295 sq. ft. lot in the prestigious Indian Canyons neighborhood of South Palm Springs. Once owned by Fey's Canyon and long been said to have originally served as a William Krisel and Dan Palmer designed "clubhouse" for Canyon View Estates, this updated single family home with NO HOA is a captivating expression of Mid Century architecture and Palm Springs living. Enter into a dramatic great room crowned by an 8 beamed "Umbrella" ceiling and clerestory windows that flood the space with natural light and create an unforgettable architectural statement. The expansive living area offers exceptional flexibility for multiple seating arrangements and entertaining spaces, anchored by a stunning painted wall mural that adds warmth and artistic character. The primary suite enjoys beautiful mountain views, a large walk in closet, and an attached bath, while the guest bath features an oversized walk in shower with a picture window framing the surrounding hillside. The spacious updated kitchen and dining area showcases charming "peek a boo" windows overlooking the landscape along with generous counter space and abundant cabinetry. Outside, the breathtaking backyard becomes a private sanctuary tucked against the hillside with dramatic mountain views and a palm tree lined landscape stretching into the distance. Lounge beside the sparkling pool and spa, gather under the shaded gazebo, or enjoy evenings around the festive gas firepit. The setting is serene, magical, and quintessentially Palm Springs. The property offers remarkable versatility and may be enjoyed immediately as a full time residence, seasonal retreat, or successful vacation rental, as it has been in recent years. Yet perhaps even more exciting is the extraordinary future potential. Surrounded by multi-million dollar estates, this property presents a rare opportunity to create a truly spectacular gated luxury compound or reimagined architectural estate. The scale of the lot, the setting against the hillside, and the prestigious surrounding homes create tremendous upside for a buyer with vision. Additional highlights include a renewed land lease through 2080, 32 seller-owned solar panels, and a 10kWh battery system. There is simply nothing else like this in Indian Canyons. A rare architectural gem that offers charm, flexibility, income potential, and exceptional long term value in one of Palm Springs' most sought after neighborhoods.

text: Oh My, It's a Meiselman! Prized by mid-century enthusiasts due to rare availability, this 1959 Jack Moyer designed residence in historic Racquet Club Estates perfectly captures the innovative spirit of desert modernism. Known as "Les Trois Palmes" named for the signature palms rising dramatically through the breezeway this home has been thoughtfully reimagined from the studs up, seamlessly blending 1950s soul with 21st-century luxury. From the street, the property makes a striking architectural impression with rare Meiselman hallmarks: sculpted concrete block, scored stucco, and textural decorative walls that stage a private, serene courtyard entry. Recognized twice with features on Palm Springs Modernism Week tours, this residence stands as a true celebrated showcase of authentic restoration. Inside, classic post-and-beam volume, tongue-and-groove ceilings, and polished concrete floors ground the open-concept design. Sunlight streams through clerestory windows framing views of the San Jacinto Mountains, while dual sliding glass doors collapse the boundary between inside and out. The original layout was modified to expand the great room into a spacious dining and seating area ideal for seamless entertaining (and easily converted back to a 3-bedroom setup if desired). The fully rebuilt modern kitchen and two sleek, updated baths bring sophisticated drama while honoring the home's original character. Designed for the California indoor-outdoor lifestyle, the rear yard is a private sanctuary. Float the day away in the newer automated pool, unwind in the spa beneath starry desert skies, or relax on the patio with integrated Bluetooth audio and curated landscape lighting. Smart infrastructure includes Nest-controlled HVAC, thermal-pane windows, digital entry, Frontier fiber-optic internet, and a fully monitored security system. Two designer "accessory sheds" with power and lighting offer the perfect setup for a workshop, art studio, or extra storage. Outside, web-controlled irrigation waters lush landscaping, planter pots, and fruit-producing edible olive trees. Situated on fee-simple land, even the address holds a romantic piece of desert lore as Berne Drive was lovingly named for Berne "Babe" Meiselman, Jack's wife, muse, and co-equal business partner. Just minutes from downtown Palm Springs, this isn't just an iconic architectural home; it's a love letter to desert modernism waiting for its next great love story.

text: Welcome to 767 E El Escudero - a beautifully remodeled Palm Springs retreat with clean lines, effortless style, and the kind of indoor-outdoor flow that makes desert living feel easy. Set on a quiet cul-de-sac just minutes from downtown Palm Springs, this light-filled home sits on an expansive private lot with incredible flexibility for the future - whether you envision expanding the home, adding an ADU/casita, or simply enjoying the space as your own private desert sanctuary. Inside, the vibe is fresh, open, and uplifting. From the moment you step through the double-door entry, the home delivers that instant Palm Springs feeling - bright, fresh, open, and effortlessly cool. One-run porcelain tile flows throughout, creating a clean and cohesive foundation, while double-pane windows and sliders bring in abundant natural light. An oversized skylight adds even more brightness, and the living room's rock-wall fireplace creates a striking architectural anchor. The open kitchen and family room connect beautifully to the outdoors through a double-opening slider leading to the covered patio. Short-term rental licenses are currently available in this neighborhood, offering the opportunity for income potential to help offset ownership costs. Fresh, fun, crisp, and full of good energy - this is the kind of Palm Springs home designed to lift your mood, slow you down, and make every day feel like a getaway.

text: Located within the highly sought-after Escena Golf Club community in Palm Springs, this beautifully upgraded contemporary residence offers refined desert living with exceptional indoor-outdoor flow, and stunning southern and western mountain views. Situated on the 4th fairway, this 3 bedrooms plus den home showcases an open-concept layout centered around an expansive kitchen and great room designed for entertaining. Large sliding glass doors off the kitchen lead directly to the covered patio, while dramatic bi-fold sliding doors in the great room create a seamless transition to the outdoor living space. The chef's kitchen is appointed with quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, GE Cafe double oven, and a walk-in pantry. A built-in bar with additional cabinetry and quartz counters enhances the entertaining experience. Integrated indoor and outdoor speakers create the perfect ambiance throughout the property. Elegant tile flooring extends throughout most of the home, with plush carpeting reserved for the guest bedrooms. The luxurious primary suite offers direct sliding door access to the pool & patio along with breathtaking views. A barn door leads into the spa-inspired primary bathroom featuring a soaking tub, oversized dual vanity with quartz countertops, large shower, and an expansive walk-in closet complete with California Closets built-ins, a desk area, and convenient access to the laundry room. The first guest suite includes its own ensuite bathroom, a walk-in shower, and custom designed closet, while the second guest bedroom has a walk-in closet and is adjacent to the third bathroom which doubles as a powder room for guests. Additional conveniences include a dual-access laundry room with sink and cabinetry. Outside, the private resort-style backyard, designed for year-round enjoyment, features a covered patio with motorized shades, artificial turf, citrus trees, and a Pebble Tec pool & spa. The spacious outdoor area provides ample room for entertaining or simply relaxing beneath the Palm Springs sky. Additional property enhancements include an epoxy-finished garage, 30 solar panels (leased) for energy efficiency, newer tankless water heater, and a recently painted exterior. Modern luxury, sophisticated upgrades, and effortless desert living come together beautifully in this exceptional home. Escena is a guard-gated golf course community with low HOA dues and resides on fee simple land (you own it).

text: One of Seven! A rare opportunity to own Steel House #4, an all-steel residence designed by legendary architect Donald Wexler. Widely regarded as one of the most significant examples of Mid-Century Modern architecture in Palm Springs, the Wexler Steel Houses were conceived as a groundbreaking experiment in prefabricated steel residential design. Thoughtfully reimagined in 2019, the home underwent an extensive renovation that took the structure down to its bones while carefully preserving its architectural integrity. Major systems were upgraded throughout, creating a rare combination of historic significance and modern livability. Expansive walls of glass, clean steel lines, and seamless indoor-outdoor connections embody the timeless design principles that have made Wexler's work internationally celebrated. Located in the heart of Palm Springs, this architectural masterpiece offers the opportunity to own not just a home, but a piece of design history--meticulously restored, thoughtfully updated, and ready for its next steward.

text: Experience the perfect blend of modern sophistication and desert tranquility in this meticulously upgraded "Connect" floor plan within the prestigious Trilogy Polo Club. text: FEE LAND. NO HOA. Set above the city in Palm Springs' sought-after Araby Cove, beneath Steve McQueen's former Rimcrest residence, this private hillside villa captures sweeping views across the valley, surrounding mountains, the tram, and distant wind fields. From sunrise to the last light over the desert, the outlook shifts constantly. At night, the city glows below while the hills behind remain quiet and protected. Just 10 minutes from Palm Springs International Airport, the home offers both privacy and immediate access to the best of Palm Springs. Approximately 3,453 square feet, the home offers five bedrooms and four baths with a floor plan designed for both daily living and entertaining. Grand arched entry doors open to formal living and dining spaces with vaulted wood-beamed ceilings, multiple fireplaces, stone and quartzite flooring, and a custom open staircase. French doors throughout connect the interior to expansive outdoor terraces, balconies, pool and spa areas, and multiple places to gather or retreat. The kitchen features custom cabinetry, stone counters, gas cooktop, double ovens, breakfast nook seating, and direct views to the garden and pool terrace. A nearby family room with built-in wine storage opens seamlessly to the outdoor entertaining areas and custom barbecue space. Two guest suites are located on the main level, while the upstairs primary suite occupies a private wing with cathedral ceilings, hardwood floors, a walk-in wardrobe, spa-style bath, and balcony overlooking the valley below. Two additional guest bedrooms complete the upper floor. The property has been extensively upgraded with integrated smart home systems including cameras, alarm, Wi-Fi-enabled lighting, smart locks, thermostats, pool controls, sprinklers, and LED lighting throughout. Additional improvements include upgraded pool equipment, fire suppression system, on-demand hot water, new window treatments, and fresh interior and exterior paint. Since the last sale, the current owners have added a 55 panel (17.04 kw) solar energy system and two Tesla backup batteries, effectively eliminating the home's electric bill. Privately positioned against the hillside yet only minutes from downtown Palm Springs, dining, shopping, and hiking trails, this is a rare offering in one of South Palm Springs' most established and luxurious enclaves. No showings September 3 to 9. The property is rented.

text: Vista Las Palmas | Palm Springs. Some homes are well-designed. This one is design -- a true Palmer & Krisel-designed Folded Plate Mid-Century Modern, built by the legendary Alexander Construction Company, in a neighborhood people come to Palm Springs hoping to find, where the architecture feels like it was placed here on purpose and the mountains decided to cooperate. The layout is as livable as it is stylish: three bedrooms, a private attached casita, and a flexible bonus room ready to become a home office, den, or gym -- whatever your life actually needs. The renovated kitchen and bathrooms are polished without being predictable, with thoughtful design details and wallpaper choices that make guests ask who did this? in the best possible way. Step outside and the home makes its case effortlessly. A spectacular reimagined pool and spa anchor a backyard built for living -- mountain views, an outdoor kitchen with grill and bar, and a generous firepit that invites long evenings under the desert sky. The guest bedroom opens to its own private patio, and out front, a fire feature with comfortable seating catches the view in a way that feels both unexpected and completely right. Every system, surface, and fixture has been thoughtfully reimagined -- from the Perlick wine refrigerator to the Louis Poulsen path lights, and the owned Solar, the details here are anything but afterthoughts. Two-car garage. Desert-modern landscaping. Easy access to everything Palm Springs offers, yet tucked into the kind of quiet that reminds you why people fall in love with this city in the first place.

text: The Harold Matzner Estate occupies a private promontory above Old Las Palmas where the San Jacinto range rises directly behind the compound and the full sweep of the Coachella Valley opens below a position no other residential address in the desert shares, on nearly an acre and a half of assembled ground comprising three structures, nearly 16,000 square feet, eleven bedrooms, sixteen bathrooms, and multiple pools and spas across two fully realized estates and a guesthouse.The main residence at 555 North Patencio Road was originally designed in 1982 by renowned brutalist architect Laszlo Sandor, (A.I.A.). The interiors by Steve Chase result in a timeless combination of architecture and design regularly celebrated whose work defined the aesthetic and vernacular of desert luxury for a generation. The homes have a fortress-like experience with a focus on function, honesty in materials and sculptural quality. Its architecture is uncluttered and horizontal, built around a single organizing principle: Light. Hallmark Chase details like raked plaster walls and natural stone flooring move through the interior, their texture alive at every hour as the desert sun crosses the compound catching at dawn along the entrance hall, settling into warmth across the great room by afternoon, receding at dusk to something quieter and more considered. Architectural Digest devoted a full feature to the property in May 1983, the first owner having commissioned a second layer of interiors by Jack E. Lowrance for the occasion testament to a house already considered among the most significant residential works in the desert. For all its scale, the residence lives with a remarkable intimacy soaring volumes that draw inward rather than expand outward, each room organizing itself around a human moment rather than an architectural statement. The great room opens entirely to the terrace through a retractable wall of glass, dissolving the boundary between interior and desert. A sunken conversation space anchors the living room gathered below the principal floor, oriented toward the wide opening to the mountain beyond a room that manages to feel both intimate and boundless. Stone floors carry throughout, a Steinway anchoring the living room alongside Asian art and antiquities accumulated over four decades with a collector's deliberateness giving the residence the quality of a place continuously deepened rather than ever simply finished.The second residence at 575 North Patencio is a fully resolved estate in its own right, its architectural language distinct but its conviction equal. The entrance hall rises to a sweeping curved staircase, a grand piano centered on a raised circular platform below a rain chandelier. The great room reaches double height, the valley visible through glass on three sides. The master bath curved black stone, a suspended rain shower open to a skylight above, a slit window framing the palm canopy and valley beyond carries the same architectural seriousness as everything around it. One room is carved into the boulder face of the mountain itself, a stone fireplace set into the rock, the terrace visible through a full width of glass beyond.The guesthouse, finished to the standard of both residences, offers a world entirely its own private, self-contained, and quietly removed from the life of the compound. It was here that the film festival's most celebrated guests found their desert. Sale includes the following APNs 505-312-011 and 505-312-014 (555 N Patencio Rd and 575 N Patencio Rd)

text: Architecturally significant mid-century modern residence designed by renowned architect Charles Du Bois and extensively restored in 2024. Showcasing unobstructed San Jacinto Mountain views and exceptional privacy, as the property backs to acres of protected open space beyond its walled grounds, creating a rare sense of seclusion. This remarkable residence underwent a comprehensive down-to-the-studs transformation. Virtually every component was reimagined, including a new roof, 40 fully owned solar panels with battery storage, electrical and plumbing systems, insulation, drywall, windows, doors, porcelain terrazzo flooring, designer fixtures, and premium finishes throughout. Beyond custom iron entry gates and a secure private atrium, the home reveals sophisticated modern living, enhanced by a Control4 smart-home system that integrates security, climate control, automated shades, exterior lighting, and entertainment systems. The expansive living room features floor-to-ceiling glass, vaulted ceilings with clerestory windows, abundant natural light, and sweeping views of the resort-style backyard, pool, and mountains. A vintage book-matched marble fireplace, a dramatic wet bar with black lacquer cabinetry, quartz countertops, mirror-backed glass shelving, and iconic Scalamandr Banana Leaf wall covering create an unforgettable entertaining space. The adjacent media room/den, which also features the signature wall covering, can easily serve as a fifth bedroom. The showpiece kitchen is appointed with a fully integrated custom-paneled Sub-Zero refrigeration, freezer, and wine storage suite, Wolf professional range, Miele dishwasher, Zip HydroTap instant hot, cold, and sparkling water system, quartz countertops, oversized under-mount sink, custom cabinetry with under-cabinet lighting, mirrored backsplash, and a built-in workstation with concealed power and USB connections. The luxurious primary suite serves as a private retreat with mountain and garden views, a striking four-slab black-and-white marble feature wall, dedicated climate control, and a spa-inspired bath featuring mosaic-tile walls, premium fixtures, and a Toto Neorest smart toilet. The extraordinary walk-in closet showcases more than $50,000 in bespoke cabinetry and lighting, creating a true jewel-box dressing room. Additional accommodations include a private family/guest suite with a bedroom, walk-in closet, a 3/4 bath, and a custom bunk room configuration off a separate interior foyer. Off the kitchen, a separate bedroom, gym, or studio with full bath, laundry area, and private exterior entrance provides exceptional flexibility. The professionally designed outdoor environment features mature landscaping, custom low-voltage lighting, a beautifully upgraded pool and spa with new tile, lighting, and Pentair systems, heat-reducing deck coating, and multiple entertaining areas. Featured is a custom art installation by Dustin Gimbel. Community amenities include a nine-hole golf course, clubhouse, fitness center, tennis and pickleball courts, cable and internet service, and landscape maintenance. A rare opportunity to own a meticulously restored architectural residence in one of Palm Springs' most desirable settings.

text: Whether you're seeking a vacation escape or a full-time desert lifestyle, this beautifully maintained Bella model in Mountain Gate delivers. The main house offers 3 bedrooms and 2 baths, complemented by a separate attached casita with its own private entry and en-suite bath ideal for guests, extended family, or a private workspace. From the entry courtyard, watch the sun dip behind the mountains with a glass of wine in hand. The views stretch spectacularly from the San Jacinto Mountains to the windmills across a sweeping 180-degree panorama. Outside, a saltwater pool and spa anchor a thoughtfully designed outdoor oasis enclosed by smooth-plastered walls for privacy. Gather around the gas fire pit, entertain under the custom Alumawood patio with integrated lighting and fans, or set the mood with color-adjustable Malibu lighting all with minimal upkeep thanks to the desertscape front and rear yards. Select sculptural pieces will convey with the property. Practical touches abound: side yard parking accommodates an RV or extra vehicles, and storage sheds remain for tools and outdoor gear. Recent upgrades include mini-split systems in the casita, garage, and both the primary and secondary bedrooms letting you direct utility costs precisely where you're living while whole-home central air and heat provide backup comfort. Solar screens on east- and west-facing windows manage the desert sun, and the home is Alexa-compatible, pre-wired for a security system, and fitted with pool alarms on the patio sliders for added peace of mind. Mountain Gate's location puts you steps from the western end of the CV Link near the Visitors Center, with easy access toward the Tramway and a future trail entry point planned just outside the back gate at Desert Highland Park. Low HOA fees cover the gated entry, daily security patrols, community pools, tennis courts, and basketball court. Spacious, elegant, and endlessly adaptable this is desert living on your terms.

Once owned by Milburn Stone, the well-known actor best known for portraying "Doc" Adams on the long-running television series Gunsmoke, this pedigreed residence has been thoughtfully transformed into a sophisticated modern retreat. The open-concept floor plan creates an effortless flow between the kitchen, dining area, and living spaces, ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. Four bedrooms and three beautifully designed bathrooms provide an abundance of space that is flexible for full-time residents, weekend getaways, or hosting family and friends. Accessed via a dramatic glass breezeway, the show-stopping primary retreat is bathed in natural light through walls of glass that overlook the resort-inspired backyard. The luxurious spa-like bath embraces Palm Springs' signature indoor-outdoor lifestyle and features a soaking tub and shower surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass. Outside, the quintessential desert experience awaits. The shimmering pool serves as the centerpiece of a beautifully reimagined outdoor environment complete with a bocce ball court, multiple lounge and dining areas, and spectacular mountain views. Beautifully landscaped, both the front and rear yards showcase drought-conscious desert landscaping that is as sustainable as it is stunning. Modern upgrades enhance comfort and efficiency throughout the home, including dual-pane windows, a 32 panel leased solar array, and two air conditioning systems installed in 2024. Combining architectural significance, celebrity provenance, thoughtful contemporary design, and exceptional outdoor living, this extraordinary home represents a rare opportunity to own a true piece of Palm Springs history while enjoying the conveniences of modern luxury. Call for your private showing and start living the Palm Springs lifestyle.

text: An Authentic Alexander Home by William Krisel -- Restored, Turnkey, and Ready for Your Palm Springs Story. Discover this Atomic Age retro gem on a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Palm Springs' most architecturally celebrated neighborhoods -- Racquet Club Estates. Meticulously restored and updated to honor its original vintage mid-century character while delivering every convenience of 21st-century living, this is the home Palm Springs dreamers have been searching for. Architectural Pedigree You Can Feel Post-and-beam construction, exposed tongue-and-groove ceilings, clerestory windows, and a classic block fireplace -- these are the defining details that make William Krisel's Alexander homes legendary. Designed in 1959 as part of the Alexander Construction Company's largest single-family tract development in Palm Springs history, this home represents the pinnacle of Atomic Age desert modernism. The kind of architecture that draws collectors, design enthusiasts, and Modernism Week pilgrims from around the world. Restored with Obsessive Attention to Detail The kitchen has been thoughtfully renovated to mirror Krisel's original vision -- a central island on hairpin iron legs and signature pegboard cabinetry that feels period-correct yet fresh. Both bathrooms feature custom cabinetry in the original Alexander style. Major systems have all been addressed: newer roof, updated plumbing, sewer line, A/C, dual-pane windows, lush desert landscaping, and breeze block walls at the front elevation. Nothing left to do but move in. A Backyard Built for the Desert Life The oversized resort-style backyard is pure Palm Springs fantasy -- glorious San Jacinto mountain views, tanning decks, custom-designed fire features, and a heated oversized pool and spa. Whether you're hosting a weekend getaway, or simply living your best desert life, this outdoor space delivers. Turnkey and Fully Furnished This home comes fully furnished (with a few seller-excluded items), making it an exceptional opportunity for owner-occupants and investors alike.

text: Price Improvement! Offered turnkey furnished, this majestic home exudes spaciousness, understated elegance and tasteful luxury, making it the perfect Palm Springs retreat. Once you enter, you experience the generously proportioned spaces and light-filled interiors, with high ceilings, and tall windows and doorways that add a lofty feel to the spaces in the house. The inspired floor plan makes indoor-outdoor living a breeze. The home was reimagined and remodeled in a contemporary yet timeless style, featuring clean lines, large format "limestone style" porcelain tile flooring, refined stone-faced fireplace, and architecturally paneled library/den all appointed with perfectly chosen furnishings and art. Sleek modern lighting tops it off. It's no wonder that this home has recently proven itself to be a very successful vacation rental. Whether you're looking for the perfect full-time home, a seasonal retreat, or a property that can be used as a vacation rental, this home is well-suited to those options. There are three generously-sized ensuite bedrooms, two off the front with direct views to Mt. San Jacinto. The primary suite faces the pool and back gardens, and has a large, open sitting room, which offers a flexible bonus space that can fulfill a variety of today's lifestyle needs. The spa-like bath has a water closet, two vanities, a soaking tub, and a shower enclosed by glass block. A glass door leads to the spa and pool, with an adjacent outdoor shower. These suites of rooms offer style and comfort that are quintessentially Palm Springs. The open-concept living room, kitchen, and informal dining area are all "poolside" with the pool and spa just steps away. The kitchen can easily accommodate large gatherings, and is stocked with handsome dishware and high-end cooking utensils. The tastefully clad gas-burning fireplace and adjacent "entertainment hub" not only anchor the room, but also create perfectly balanced focal points. The front library or den, with its beautifully crafted architectural paneling, is another incredible feature of this gorgeous home. It can easily be used for any number of functions, such as a formal dining room, and is conveniently accessible through the open wet bar (or Butler's pantry!), or as a less formal, cozy space to entertain, relax, or enjoy cocktails or casual meals, or perhaps even a home office with views of San Jacinto. Indoor-outdoor living is virtually seamless. Two sets of French doors open to the pool and spa and the "courtyard" patio, which is covered to help define and shelter the space and offer some protection from the elements. This large patio space also serves a number of functions, ranging from entertainment, dining (casual or formal), drinks, or snuggling up to the outdoor fireplace in the cooler months of the year. And, to make it all even better, there's dual zone HVAC (one serves the bedrooms, the other the common areas of the home), owned solar panels, whole house water softener, water filter at the kitchen sink, "smart" Ecobee thermostats, and ceiling speakers with 7 zones and volume control in each room. 2220 N Hermosa is close to shopping, restaurants, hiking, biking, and so much more, including the Uptown Design District along N Palm Canyon Dr. Carpe Diem and seize this opportunity!

text: Tucked behind the gates of Mountain Gate, a resort-style community set against the mountains of Palm Springs, this sought-after single-level Bella floor plan features 4 bedrooms and 3 baths, including a detached CASITA, and pairs easy desert living with a private backyard. OWNED SOLAR is a major plus. Just minutes from Uptown Palm Springs and situated on Fee Land (you own it), the home offers a wonderful combination of a gated setting, mountain surroundings, and your own saltwater pool and spa. The southwest-facing backyard features a saltwater pool and spa with room to soak up the sun or unwind in the shade, all enjoying dramatic Mt. San Jacinto views. The detached casita opens directly to the front walk and features a kitchenette and walk-in closet, offering excellent flexibility for guests, a home office, studio, or extended stays. A 3-car garage and RV parking are rare finds. Low HOA fees and low-maintenance landscaping make ownership easy. Mountain Gate residents enjoy three community pools and spas, tennis courts, a basketball court, and beautifully maintained grounds.
