text: Exceptional views, an oversized premium lot, and a level of customization rarely found in newer construction distinguish this remarkable Palm Springs residence.Inspired by contemporary luxury resort living, the home delivers dramatic architecture, seamless indoor-outdoor flow, and a level of finish more commonly associated with substantially more expensive properties. Positioned on one of the community's most desirable oversized lots, selected for its exceptional views and commanding setting, the home was further enhanced with more than $200,000 in builder and post-completion upgrades, resulting in a residence that feels distinctly custom rather than builder-grade.Walls of glass frame sweeping mountain and desert vistas, while a custom-added 8-foot sliding glass door off the dining room creates a rare 360-degree connection to the surrounding landscape and an extraordinary indoor-outdoor living experience. The newly designed side yard features professional landscaping and a fire pit lounge, creating a private setting for sunset cocktails, outdoor entertaining, and quiet desert evenings beneath the stars.Inside, the architecture is both dramatic and refined. Twelve-foot ceilings elevate the main living spaces, while large-format limestone-look tile flows throughout the home and continues into the outdoor living areas, creating a seamless visual continuity. Virtually every major finish and fixture was upgraded during construction, creating a level of design consistency and quality rarely found in a newly built home. The chef's kitchen is anchored by an oversized white quartz island and appointed with Bertazzoni appliances, integrated cabinetry, designer lighting, and a generous walk-in pantry.Unlike many larger homes that offer only a single primary suite, this thoughtfully designed floor plan features two true primary suites, creating exceptional comfort and privacy for owners, guests, and visiting family. Luxurious ensuite baths and generous walk-in closets enhance both suites, while additional upgrades include integrated Sonos audio, smart-home controls, an infrared sauna, dedicated laundry room, whole-house water purification system, epoxied garage floor, and a fully owned solar system that helps keep operating costs remarkably low.Outside, the home's exceptional setting takes center stage. A heated and jetted private spool with tanning shelf creates a true resort atmosphere, while the expansive lot and unobstructed views provide a sense of openness and privacy rarely found in newer construction.Located within a guard-gated community, residents enjoy approximately seven miles of walking and biking trails, working olive groves, a U-Pick garden, dog parks, bocce courts, and a striking modern clubhouse featuring resort-style pools and spa, fitness center, yoga studio, caf, demonstration kitchen, and full-service bar. The community's 7-day minimum rental policy also provides flexibility for owners who may wish to offset a portion of ownership costs through short-term rentals.Sophisticated, highly upgraded, and visually unforgettable, this is a home that stands apartnot only for what it offers, but for how rarely it can be replicated. For buyers seeking exceptional design, premium views, modern construction, lock-and-leave convenience, and a true resort lifestyle, few opportunities in Palm Springs combine this level of design, views, privacy, and amenities at this price point.

text: Located on a desirable corner lot in the highly sought-after Phase 1 section of Sun City Shadow Hills, this popular San Benito floor plan offers 2,147 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a versatile den, and a dedicated hobby room. Built in 2004 and situated on a 7,405 square foot lot, this home combines spacious living, functional flexibility, and exceptional value within one of the desert's premier active adult communities. Step inside to discover an open-concept layout highlighted by luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout the main living areas, abundant natural light, and comfortable gathering spaces designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The well-appointed kitchen features granite slab countertops, extensive cabinetry, double ovens, a center island, and a breakfast bar that opens seamlessly to the great room and dining area. The generously sized primary suite serves as a private retreat, complete with dual vanities, a soaking tub, separate glass-enclosed shower, and a spacious walk-in closet. A well-positioned guest bedroom and bath provide privacy for visitors, while the den and hobby room offer endless possibilities for a home office, media room, craft space, fitness room, or additional guest accommodations. Enjoy indoor-outdoor desert living with expansive windows and sliding glass doors leading to the backyard. The patio concrete has been extended to create additional outdoor living and entertaining space, while a custom walkway added to the front yard enhances both convenience and curb appeal. The low-maintenance landscaping allows you to spend more time enjoying the Sun City Shadow Hills lifestyle and less time on yard work. Additional highlights include a 2-car garage plus a dedicated golf cart garage, indoor laundry room with storage, and attractive corner-lot positioning. Furniture is available outside of escrow, offering a convenient opportunity for buyers seeking a move-in-ready desert retreat. Residents of Sun City Shadow Hills enjoy access to two championship golf courses, resort-style clubhouses, fitness centers, indoor and outdoor pools, pickleball and tennis courts, bocce ball, walking trails, and countless clubs and social activities.

text: Wake up to San Jacinto. Coffee on the patio. Sun on the pool. This is the one you've been looking for! Tucked inside the desirable Mountain Gate's gated community, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath Alta Mira floor plan delivers that true Palm Springs resort lifestyle. Step through the front door into the dramatic entry hall with decorative tile inlays and gorgeous crown molding throughout set the tone immediately. The open great room unfolds with a gas fireplace into a beautifully updated kitchen. But the real showstopper? 2 sets of french glass doors framing your private backyard, pool, and unobstructed mountain views. The kitchen is built for more than reheating takeout - slab granite counters, a gas range, stainless appliances, pantry storage, and a large island that doubles as the gathering spot every good kitchen needs. The oversized primary suite sits privately on one side of the home with space for a sitting area or home office, a remodeled walk-in shower, double vanity, and a generous walk-in closet. Bedrooms two and three share the second remodeled bath on the opposite side - ideal for guests or family. A few details that matter: dedicated inside laundry room, direct-access two-car garage, and one of the lots with gated RV parking. Out back is your own private oasis with a gorgeous in-ground pool and spa complete with an electric awning on one side for those extra sunny days where a little more shade is needed - it's the reason most people fall in love with desert living in the first place! The gated community adds even more: tennis and basketball courts, a covered BBQ area, playground, three pools and spas, and roaming security- all just minutes from Palm Canyon Drive, the Palm Springs Aerial Tramway, shopping, dining, and everything downtown has to offer. Move-in ready. Mountain views included.

text: Hidden behind walls and gates in Old Las Palmas, The Cloisters, known to many as Casa de Liberace, stands among the most celebrated residential estates in Palm Springs. Built in 1930 by Alvah Hicks, whose work helped shape the city during its formative years, this extraordinary Spanish Colonial Revival residence spans more than 8,000 square feet and unfolds through a series of courtyards, gardens, fountains, and architectural spaces rich with character and history. Extensively renovated and carefully stewarded over the years, the estate preserves the craftsmanship and authenticity that define its legacy while embracing the expectations of modern luxury living. Public rooms are extraordinary in both scale and craftsmanship, with original details carefully preserved throughout the estate, including Hispano-Moresque tilework, vintage mirrors, decorative ironwork, and architectural elements rarely found today. The formal living room features vaulted truss and beamed ceilings, Spanish tile flooring, a fireplace, and steel-framed glass doors that open to expansive brick terraces. The formal dining room continues the home's rich architectural character and provides an elegant setting for entertaining. The family room showcases massive hand-hewn beams, a second fireplace, and direct access to the surrounding grounds. A gracious loggia overlooks the gardens, outdoor fireplace, and gathering spaces beyond. The gourmet kitchen honors the home's architectural heritage with soapstone counters, rich mahogany finishes, and a handsome butler's pantry. A dramatic gallery lined with ensuite guest rooms creates both architectural interest and exceptional privacy throughout the estate. Among the home's most memorable spaces is the billiard room, distinguished by a dramatic barrel-vaulted ceiling, clerestory windows, a fireplace adorned with a cast sandstone frieze, and direct access to the namesake cloister courtyard framed by magnificent mountain views. Nearby, a richly detailed den provides a quiet retreat. Privately situated within its own wing, the primary suite is reached through a dedicated vestibule and features ornate wood ceilings, generous proportions, and baths that continue the home's remarkable collection of period tilework and original details. Additional guest accommodations open directly to the pool courtyard. The resort-style pool and spa enjoy a spectacular orientation and dramatic mountain backdrop. Entertaining is effortless with a poolside kitchen, bar seating, pass-through service window, and a substantial outdoor fireplace anchoring the gathering spaces. Adding to the home's lore is a hidden bar reminiscent of a 1920s speakeasy. An exterior stairway leads to a second-story viewing deck offering sweeping 360-degree views of the surrounding mountains and desert landscape. The estate also enjoys a remarkable setting adjacent to O'Donnell Golf Club and just one block west of Palm Canyon Drive. Rich in history and impossible to replicate, The Cloisters represents a rare opportunity to become the next steward of one of Palm Springs' most significant residential estates.

Located within the award-winning community of Sun City Shadow Hills, residents enjoy two championship golf courses, resort-style clubhouses, fitness centers, indoor and outdoor pools, tennis, pickleball, restaurants, and an endless variety of clubs and activities. With spectacular golf course and mountain views, a highly sought-after floor plan, formal and casual dining spaces, this exceptional home is the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and the active desert lifestyle.

text: Experience elevated desert living in the exclusive gated Stone Gate community. This beautifully remodeled 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home sits on a sprawling 27,443 sq. ft. presidential estate lot and offers 3,240 sq. ft. of sophisticated open-concept living in one of Bermuda Dunes' most desirable neighborhoods. Inside, soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and wood-like tile flooring create a bright, airy feel. Highlights include a new front door, recessed lighting, new ceiling fans, custom wood shutters, and elegant 7-inch baseboards. Formal living and dining areas are perfect for entertaining, while the expansive family room features a custom entertainment center with quartz counters and one of two Italian tile gas fireplaces. The gourmet kitchen shines with quartz countertops, a waterfall breakfast bar, stainless steel appliances, gas cooktop, chef's range hood, and custom cabinetry. Outside, enjoy a resort-style backyard with a large pool and spa (acid-washed/sand-blasted summer 2025), Alumawood patio cover, gazebo, koi pond, and fruit trees (pomegranate, olive, grapefruit, lime, lemon). The expansive driveway fits large vehicles, boats, and toys with gated RV access. The 3-car garage includes a mini-split system, Tesla charger, cabinetry, and storage. Includes high-end LG stainless steel refrigerator and 85" Samsung TV. Modern luxury meets desert resort living in this exceptional Stone Gate home.

text: Welcome to this beautifully redesigned Montoya floor plan, offering 1,432 square feet with 2 bedrooms plus a den. text: For all serious Mid-Century Modern enthusiasts! Don't miss this rare opportunity to collect this 1964 Alexander Bros. Mid-Century jewel designed by Palmer & Krisel and completely remodeled by the 2nd owners. From front to back, everything as been fully renovated while keeping the original vision in place and bringing it forward to perfect indoor-outdoor desert living. This home was the original model for this Alexander enclave of homes originally known as Riviera Gardens. In tact with the original front in ground gas line for the 1960's Tiki torch! The home still maintains its desert friendly front and rear landscape with an updated breezeway connecting the 2 car garage to the home. Gated and secure. With its distinctive roof line, clean lines and light/bright interior, this special home still has its original twin palms out front. The expansive back yard has been updated with the addition of full width patio coverings, very large pool and spa, a putting green and its original olive tree lovingly cared for over the decades. In addition to all new Low-E windows and sliding doors. The complete feeling is one of sleek Mid-Century living with all of today's sought after materials and conveniences. Off of the guest bathroom is a laundry room with stacked washer & dryer and a convenient door to the exterior patio, pool/spa, dining and grill. Plus the new putting green. Enjoy the outstanding west mountain views from every angle of the rear yard and watch the amazing sunsets while then watching the tram cars glide silently up and down Mount San Jacinto. This desirable and much sought after Mid-Century Alexander Co. home is offered Turnkey Furnished for immediate move-in and perfect Palm Springs living. Only a few blocks from the historic Riviera Hotel

text: A refined expression of contemporary desert living, this newly constructed four-bedroom, four-bathroom residence offers effortless luxury within the prestigious Miralon community. Designed around an expansive great room with soaring ceilings, the home seamlessly blends sophisticated architecture with relaxed indoor-outdoor living, creating a residence that is as inviting as it is refined. At the heart of the home, the expansive chef's kitchen is designed for both everyday living and elevated entertaining. Outfitted with brand-new premium appliances, an oversized double waterfall-edge island with seating for five, and an abundance of custom cabinetry, the space effortlessly balances beauty and function. A generous walk-in pantry provides exceptional storage while offering the perfect spot for a dedicated coffee bar or additional prep space, making the kitchen a true gathering place for family and guests. The first-floor primary suite is a private sanctuary, featuring direct walk-out access to the pool, an impressive wraparound walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, custom tile detailing, and a separate water closet. Two additional bedrooms on the main level are thoughtfully connected by a Jack-and-Jill bath, while the fourth bedroom occupies the upper level, where oversized corner windows frame abundant natural light and mountain vistas. An elegant staircase leads to a private second-story den, where breathtaking 360-degree mountain views create an inspiring setting for a home office, media lounge, or tranquil retreat above it all. Thoughtfully appointed throughout with two Modern Ember fireplaces, custom floor-to-ceiling media walls in both the great room and primary suite, a high-efficiency smart climate control system with app-connected thermostats, and fully owned Tesla rooftop solar with Powerwall backup, the residence delivers exceptional comfort, efficiency, and modern convenience without compromise. Outside, the southern sun facing wraparound back and side yards are professionally landscaped with a fig and citrus tree and designed for effortless desert living, with smart irrigation and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The home overlooks Miralon's iconic grove of more than 700 fruiting olive trees, providing a picturesque backdrop to one of Palm Springs most thoughtfully envisioned 24/7 guard-gated communities. Residents enjoy miles of scenic walking trails, resort-style pools, a state-of-the-art fitness center, cafe, dog parks, game lawns, and beautifully curated indoor-outdoor co-working spaces, all contributing to an unparalleled lock-and-leave lifestyle defined by luxury, privacy, wellness, and connection.

From holiday dinners & birthday celebrations to movie nights by the fire, this home was built for making memories that last a lifetime. The moment you step inside, you're welcomed by the abundance of natural light, an open floor plan that instantly feels warm/ inviting. Every space flows effortlessly, making it easy to stay connected whether you're helping with homework at the kitchen island, entertaining guests, or simply enjoying a quiet evening at home. The beautifully remodeled kitchen is truly the heart of the home, featuring a massive island with seating for 5, decorative tile backsplash, stunning designer hood over the gas cooktop, abundant cabinetry, & all the space you'll need to cook, gather, & laugh together. Just beyond, the dining area and spacious family room are anchored by a gorgeous stacked-stone fireplace and framed by a wall of windows overlooking the newly remodeled backyard--bringing the beauty of the outdoors inside. Thoughtfully designed for flexibility, the front of the home offers a private bedroom, full bathroom, & walk-in closet--perfect for visiting grandparents, guests, or a quiet home office. Down the hall, you'll find generously sized guest bedrooms with walk-in closets, while the primary suite is truly something special. Known as the largest primary suite in Talaveras, it's more than just a bedroom--it's your own private retreat. Wake up to peaceful backyard views, enjoy the convenience of 2 oversized walk-in closets, then unwind in your spa-inspired ensuite featuring a large Roman soaking tub, separate granite vanities, walk-in tile shower w/ bench, & a private water closet. The upgrades continue with professionally painted exterior, custom motorized sheer/ blackout shades by Desert Window Treatments, two brand-new A/C units, a brand-new mini-split in the garage, & a beautifully reimagined backyard featuring premium turf & pavers--creating the perfect place for kids to play, pets to roam, and family/ friends to gather long after the sun sets. This isn't just where you'll live... it's where birthdays will be celebrated, holiday traditions will begin, kids will race through the backyard & quiet mornings with a cup of coffee will become some of your favorite moments. Welcome home!

text: Perched on an elevated lot with panoramic golf course and mountain views, this 2,168 sq ft 3-bedroom home has been remodeled from top to bottom at a level of detail that is hard to find! Starting with the kitchen, the heart of it all: gorgeous custom Alder cabinets, quartz counters, and marble backsplash surround a suite of GE Profile stainless appliances. A built-in wine fridge tucks under the peninsula, while a reverse osmosis system and instant water heater under the sink deliver purified hot and cold water directly to the faucet. Designer lighting throughout, including a motion-sensor lighting in the walk-in pantry, makes this space as functional as it is beautiful. The primary suite delivers a spa-caliber bathroom with an enormous new glass shower enclosure, triple shower heads, and porcelain tile floor to ceiling, alongside all-new vanities, fixtures, and lighting. LVP flooring flows through the bedroom and closet, complete with optional smart-voice fan and lighting controls. The secondary bathroom received the same top-to-bottom remodel, right down to the tile baseboards. Living spaces impress with surround sound, a dedicated AV/media closet, and a striking fireplace update featuring a quartz hearth, marble surround, and wood mantle. The second and third bedrooms both offer LVP flooring and optional smart-voice fan controls, while the front entry welcomes you with a fiberglass 4-lite panel door and touchpad deadbolt. Behind the scenes, the systems are just as impressive: both HVAC zones replaced with high-efficiency American Standard Platinum Series units, water heater recirculation pump, and a whole-house EcoWater softener system. The garage features built-in storage, ample lighting, and dual garage door openers. Outside is where the magic happens! Professional desert-friendly landscaping, drip irrigation, and a smart irrigation controller keep the yard efficient and beautiful, while a Koolfog misting system, outdoor speakers, and smart patio lighting extend the living space outdoors. Relax around the fire feature or in the custom pool and spa with its dramatic waterfall and updated color lighting for year-round enjoyment. This is a home where every detail has been considered -- smart, stylish, and ready for its next chapter in your life! All the hard work is done; paradise is here, awaiting you. View the videos and VR tour, then schedule a showing -- you'll be more impressed in person!

text: Move-in ready & loaded with upgrades, this 3 bedroom, 3 bath Boschetto home offers 2,549 square feet on an 8,276 SF lot in a prime location in the all-ages section of Trilogy at The Polo Club. The lot backs to the greenbelt & sits directly across from the clubhouse, pickleball courts & tennis courts. The home includes over $135,000 in original builder upgrades & a lot premium. Walk over for a morning game of pickleball, an evening at June Hill's Table, or a laid-back afternoon by the pool. Trilogy at The Polo Club is a guard-gated, socially active resort-style community centered around the 25,000+ square foot Polo Club clubhouse, with dining, a fitness center, pools, tennis courts & dozens of homeowner-led clubs, from golf and bocce to art, book club & beyond. Polo Club membership is available for transfer with this home. A stacked-stone & stucco exterior with a paver driveway and walkways sets the tone from the street. Inside, the open-concept great room features tray ceilings, ceiling fans, and a wall of windows with plantation shutters throughout. Disappearing pocket sliding doors at the great room and kitchen open completely to a covered, recessed-lit back patio. Perfect for morning coffee or evening dinners outdoors, framing the east-facing backyard, landscaped with low-maintenance artificial turf and mature trees, plus a gated rear yard entry. The chef-caliber kitchen invites you to cook and gather with Cafe by GE stainless steel appliances, gas cooktop with stainless hood, quartz countertops with a waterfall-edge island, gray subway tile backsplash & white shaker-style cabinetry with a full wall of pantry storage. Upgraded wood-look tile flooring runs throughout the home. Retreat to the primary suite, where a walk-in closet, a French door out to the patio, & a bath with a soaking tub & curbless walk-in shower with bench seating create a private escape. A second bedroom offers an ensuite bath with quartz countertops & powder room with a pedestal sink. The large laundry room impresses with granite countertops, a laundry sink, two built-in desk areas, and abundant storage. Additional highlights include solar (financed, to be assumed or paid off at close of escrow), a 48-amp EV charger, & a tankless water heater combining comfort & efficiency. This is more than a home. It's a lifestyle across the street from it all. Come see why Trilogy at The Polo Club living means never running out of ways to spend your day.

text: Where Palm Springs history meets timeless desert living. Nestled in the prestigious Ruth Hardy Park/Movie Colony East neighborhood, this private desert retreat offers the perfect blend of historic charm, mountain views, and exceptional privacy, just minutes from vibrant downtown Palm Springs. Enjoy convenient access to Desert Regional Medical Center, world-class golf, tennis, pickleball, shopping, dining, entertainment, and everything the Coachella Valley has to offer. This inviting residence features 2 bedrooms, 1 remodeled bath, a versatile bonus room ideal as a home office or optional guest room, plus a detached historic casita. Rich in character, the home showcases Spanish paver flooring throughout the main living areas, new carpet in the bedrooms, soaring wood-beamed ceilings, and an open-concept floor plan filled with warmth and natural light. The remodeled bathroom offers both a soaking tub and walk-in shower, while the galley kitchen opens to the dining nook and is equipped with a gas range, oven, and dishwasher. Step outside to your own private desert oasis where breathtaking mountain views create the perfect backdrop for relaxing in the spa, entertaining guests, or enjoying peaceful evenings under the stars. The beautifully secluded backyard offers exceptional privacy and embodies the indoor-outdoor lifestyle Palm Springs is famous for. A truly extraordinary feature of this property is the detached historic bungalow, originally one of the famed tent cottages from the iconic Desert Inn dating back to the 1920s. Rich with Palm Springs history, this rare structure serves as a charming guest casita, artist's studio, private office, or creative retreat-offering an opportunity to own a genuine piece of the city's storied past. Whether you're searching for a full-time residence, weekend getaway, or investment opportunity, this home delivers the quintessential Palm Springs lifestyle. Ideally located near the Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival, Stagecoach Festival, Indian Wells Tennis Garden, Joshua Tree National Park, and countless renowned restaurants, galleries, boutiques, and resorts. Homes offering this combination of location, privacy, authentic character, and historical significance rarely come to market. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity to own a unique Palm Springs retreat in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods.

text: Tucked into the end of a cul-de-sac in Racquet Club Estates, this 1959 Alexander Construction home is a genuine William Krisel design - not a renovation-era approximation, not a "mid-century inspired" reinterpretation, but the real architecture; post-and-beam construction, a butterfly-adjacent low-slung roofline, walls of glass, and the clerestory windows Krisel used to pull desert light deep into the plan without sacrificing privacy. Step inside and the bones speak first. Exposed wood ceilings run uninterrupted from the interior to the covered patio, blurring the line Krisel built his reputation on erasing. The open floor plan holds its scale - this is a home designed for entertaining without ever feeling cavernous, a hallmark of the Alexander/Krisel partnership that built Palm Springs' modernist identity. Kitchen and bathrooms were thoughtfully updated in 2005, respecting the original material palette rather than fighting it. Outside, the private pool and spa sit in a private setting framed by desert landscaping and tall ficus hedges - the payoff of Krisel's signature siting, where every home in a tract was angled to protect sight lines and privacy instead of repeating a single orientation. This is a rare offering for the collector or enthusiast who understands the difference between a home that looks mid-century and one that is mid-century; 1225 square feet, 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and an architectural pedigree that doesn't need embellishing. Racquet Club Estates - one of the most historically intact Alexander neighborhoods in Palm Springs.

text: Located in Farrell Canyon Estates, the historic 1964 development created by renowned Alexander Construction Company, this pristine South Palm Springs mid-century modern residence offers an exceptional blend of architectural heritage, thoughtful updates, privacy, and quintessential indoor-outdoor living. From the moment you arrive, the home's expansive circular driveway and cheerful curb appeal set the tone. Double French doors open to welcoming natural light where the kitchen, dining, & living areas flow seamlessly together. The spacious living & dining area is anchored by a stacked-stone gas fireplace, adding warmth & character. The open kitchen features black granite countertops, generous cabinetry, quality appliances, & a convenient casual dining area, equally suited to everyday living & entertaining. The primary bedroom, privately positioned at the rear of the home, features a show-stopping 12' x 12' walk-in closet with abundant storage, extensive shelving, & generous hanging space. The beautifully remodeled ensuite bathroom features a double vanity & new shower, while direct access to the backyard creates a seamless connection to the outdoor living spaces. 2 additional bright & flexible rooms are configured as a guest bedroom & office. With access from both the kitchen & the backyard, this thoughtful layout allows guests to enjoy the pool & outdoor entertaining areas without passing through the main living spaces. Ideally located near celebrated restaurants, shopping, cultural attractions, & vibrant downtown, this exceptional residence captures the best of the Palm Springs lifestyle: iconic mid-century architecture, mountain views, privacy, indoor-outdoor living, and modern comfort--all in one remarkable setting.

This home is a perfect example of why his work was so important and continues to enthrall us to this day. text: Located behind the gates of Foxstone, this expansive residence presents a compelling opportunity and exceptional value in today's desert market. Built as the community's largest floor plan, the home offers nearly 3,000 square feet with 4 bedrooms, 2 baths in the main house plus a thoughtfully enhanced private guest suite complete with its own bath and kitchenette. This converted loft and bedroom area provide excellent separation and versatility for guests, extended family, or a variety of lifestyle needs. Designed for those who appreciate both comfort and functionality, the property features RV and boat access with an expansive concrete driveway, gated parking, a 30-amp hookup, dedicated dump station, and exterior half bath with utility sink. Inside, updated finishes include solid bamboo flooring throughout the main living areas, vinyl plank flooring in the primary suite, tile in the guest baths and laundry room, and upgraded solid wood trim and molding throughout. Modern conveniences are seamlessly incorporated with an Ecobee Wi-Fi thermostat, B-hyve Wi-Fi irrigation controller, Chamberlain Wi-Fi garage opener, LED lighting, security system with exterior cameras, and hardwired surround sound preparation in the living room. Dual A/C units and the water heater were replaced in 2019, while two window-mounted evaporative coolers offer an additional option for managing energy costs. Outdoor living is equally inviting, beginning with a low-maintenance front yard featuring artificial turf. The private rear yard includes a fenced pool and spa with tanning ledge, umbrella inserts, and automatic vacuum, complemented by a spacious Alumawood-covered patio, lawn, mature citrus trees, and a storage shed with enclosed pool equipment. The garage is well equipped with a built-in workbench, shelving, and accessible attic storage. All of this is conveniently located near shopping, dining, and schools.

This converted loft and bedroom area provide excellent separation and versatility for guests, extended family, or a variety of lifestyle needs. Designed for those who appreciate both comfort and functionality, the property features RV and boat access with an expansive concrete driveway, gated parking, a 30-amp hookup, dedicated dump station, and exterior half bath with utility sink. Inside, updated finishes include solid bamboo flooring throughout the main living areas, vinyl plank flooring in the primary suite, tile in the guest baths and laundry room, and upgraded solid wood trim and molding throughout. Modern conveniences are seamlessly incorporated with an Ecobee Wi-Fi thermostat, B-hyve Wi-Fi irrigation controller, Chamberlain Wi-Fi garage opener, LED lighting, security system with exterior cameras, and hardwired surround sound preparation in the living room. Dual A/C units and the water heater were replaced in 2019, while two window-mounted evaporative coolers offer an additional option for managing energy costs. Outdoor living is equally inviting, beginning with a low-maintenance front yard featuring artificial turf. The private rear yard includes a fenced pool and spa with tanning ledge, umbrella inserts, and automatic vacuum, complemented by a spacious Alumawood-covered patio, lawn, mature citrus trees, and a storage shed with enclosed pool equipment. The garage is well equipped with a built-in workbench, shelving, and accessible attic storage. All of this is conveniently located near shopping, dining, and schools.

text: Welcome to Sun City Shadow Hills, one of the desert's premier 55+ active-adult communities, offering resort-style amenities and carefree desert living. This popular Castellano floor plan features 2 bedrooms plus an office, 2.5 baths, beautiful wood flooring, and a spacious, thoughtfully designed layout with sweeping panoramic views of the 8th fairway and majestic surrounding mountains. The expansive great room showcases the spectacular golf course and mountain views, creating an inviting setting for relaxing or entertaining. A large formal dining room is ideal for gatherings, while the adjoining eat-in kitchen features quartz countertops, abundant cabinetry, and upgraded KitchenAid stainless steel appliances. Just off the kitchen is a laundry room with utility sink and additional storage, along with an oversized two-car garage plus separate golf cart garage. The dedicated office/den provides a versatile space for working from home, a library, music room, or hobby space. The guest bedroom and bath are nicely separated from the primary suite for added privacy, and both bedrooms enjoy panoramic fairway and mountain views. The spacious primary suite includes a bath with large walk-in shower, soaking tub, dual sinks, and generous walk-in closet. Step outside to the beautifully landscaped backyard, designed to take full advantage of desert living. A built-in BBQ makes outdoor entertaining easy, while the spa and fire pit provide the perfect setting to relax and unwind while enjoying the expansive fairway and mountain views. Sun City Shadow Hills offers 24-hour guard-gated entry and security and an exceptional array of recreational and social amenities, anchored by two impressive clubhouses--the Santa Rosa and Montecito Clubhouses. Residents enjoy tennis, pickleball, bocce ball, pools and spas, billiards, card rooms, a library, fitness facilities, social activities, and much more. Golf is an integral part of the Sun City Shadow Hills lifestyle, with two golf courses, including an executive course, plus a separate driving range and two practice putting greens. Residents also enjoy reduced golf fees, making it easy to take advantage of everything the community has to offer. Best of all, HOA dues are just $398 per month and include internet service--an exceptional value for the extensive amenities and lifestyle offered. Come experience this wonderful home and discover why so many are drawn to the active, social, resort-style lifestyle of Sun City Shadow Hills.

text: Welcome to 50635 Havasu Falls Drive, an extensively upgraded Proclaim plan situated on one of the more unique homesites within Trilogy Polo Club. Built by Shea Homes in 2021, this 2,141 sq. ft. residence was designed by its original owner as a forever home, with thoughtful builder selections followed by more than $100,000 in additional improvements. The homesite itself is a standout. Positioned on a coveted west-facing lot, the home backs to a wide greenbelt, enjoys another greenbelt directly across the street and is bordered by a community walking path on one side - creating an uncommon sense of openness, privacy and separation from neighboring homes. Inside, the Proclaim's open-concept design is elevated with luxury vinyl plank flooring, 5.5-inch baseboards, custom wall treatments, built-out closets, interior/exterior audio and a dramatic upgraded fireplace anchoring the great room. The chef's kitchen features premium GE Cafe appliances with built-in refrigerator, quartz countertops extending down the island, hexagon backsplash, soft-close cabinetry with pull-out storage and a Kohler farmhouse sink. The primary retreat features a bay window, custom closet build-out and upgraded Shea Homes shower, while the guest spaces have also been thoughtfully enhanced with custom closet systems and upgraded bath finishes. A built-in library space and beautifully finished separate laundry room add even more function to the home. Outside is where this property truly embraces the desert lifestyle. The backyard has been transformed into a private entertaining retreat with a party spool, putting green, built-in BBQ and bar, gas fire pit, extended pavers, commercial-grade misters, drop-down shade and two retractable awnings with wind sensors. Grapefruit, lime and lemon trees create a charming ''cocktail orchard,'' all set against the open greenbelt and mountain backdrop. Even the garages received the same level of attention, with epoxy flooring, extensive built-in cabinetry and individual mini-split A/C systems, while the roof solar keeps electric costs at a minimum. Located within guard-gated 55+ community of Trilogy Polo Club, this is much more than a beautifully upgraded home - it's a rare combination of the popular Proclaim floorplan, an exceptional homesite and a level of investment and customization that would be difficult to recreate.

text: Welcome to 49790 Newman Circle, an exceptional home located behind the gates of the desirable Indian Palms Country Club in Indio. Situated on a premium corner lot, this beautifully maintained residence offers approximately 1,853 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with two spacious bedrooms, two and one-half bathrooms, and an ideal blend of comfort, functionality, and resort-style living. A private gated courtyard creates a warm welcome and provides the perfect space to relax outdoors. Inside, soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and an open-concept floor plan create an inviting atmosphere. The spacious great room features a cozy gas fireplace and flows seamlessly into the dining area and well-appointed kitchen, complete with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a breakfast bar, and generous cabinet space. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a walk-in closet and a private en-suite bathroom, while the guest suite includes its own full bath, providing comfort and privacy for family and friends. An additional powder room adds convenience for guests. A standout feature of this property is its incredible garage space. In addition to the attached two-car garage and dedicated golf cart garage, the home includes a rare climate-controlled RV garage measuring approximately 50 feet deep with water and sewer hookups. Whether you're storing an RV, boat, classic cars, or creating the ultimate workshop, home gym, or hobby space, this versatile area offers endless possibilities. The backyard patio overlooks a tranquil pond, lush greenbelt, and picturesque mountain views, providing a peaceful setting for entertaining or enjoying the beautiful desert evenings. Residents of Indian Palms Country Club enjoy an outstanding selection of amenities, including 27 holes of championship golf, multiple community pools and spas, tennis and pickleball courts, a fitness center, clubhouse, and 24-hour gated security. Conveniently located near world-class golf, shopping, dining, entertainment, and the Empire Polo Club, home to the Coachella and Stagecoach music festivals, this property is ideal as a full-time residence, vacation home, or investment opportunity. Experience the best of desert living at 49790 Newman Circle.

text: Some homes are simply lived in. Casa de Rosa is remembered. Built in 1940 as the very first residence in the Mesa neighborhood, this landmark property is believed to have been designed by celebrated architect Cliff May, a provenance that lends the home a quiet, storied gravitas rarely found today. Step inside and the original character is immediate: vaulted beam ceilings, a substantial wood-burning fireplace and wide-plank wood floors that carry the eye from room to room. Designers Donal Brophy and Emrhys Cooper reimagined the interiors in a Regency style, tailored, warm and unmistakably considered striking a balance between historic integrity and livable elegance. The glass-enclosed dining room frames sweeping mountain views, while the chef's kitchen, outfitted with Viking appliances, anchors the home for both everyday living and serious entertaining. Both bedrooms offer full en-suite baths; the primary suite in particular opens to pool views and a spa-like sense of calm. A cozy den and powder room round out the floor plan with easy functionality. Outside, the walled and gated grounds open onto a private oasis: a pool with tanning shelf and water feature, generous space for entertaining and mature roses and fruit trees that soften the setting with real, established greenery. Part of Mesa's history and entirely of the present moment, Casa de Rosa is a RARE offering where architectural pedigree, thoughtful design, and everyday comfort meet.

text: Rarely available and exceptionally positioned, this former Murano model home presents a distinctive blend of architectural design, resort-style living, and exceptional privacy. Offering four bedrooms and four baths, the residence includes a highly desirable detached casita, a rare feature in Palm Springs. Designed by renowned architect James Cioffi, AIA, this sleek modern home is set on an enclosed, private lot of more than 14,000 square feet, with breathtaking south- and west-facing mountain views. Designed for streamlined indoor-outdoor living and easy desert entertaining, the grounds feature a sparkling pool and an elevated spa with a waterfall spillway, an exterior shower, multiple dining and lounge areas, a motorized outdoor awning, dog-roaming areas, and plenty of space to relax and take in the spectacular surroundings. Inside, the open-concept design is defined by scored and polished concrete floors, vaulted ceilings, clerestory windows, and expansive walls of glass that open to the outdoors while filling the home with natural light. The designer kitchen is appointed with premium Thermador appliances, an island with seating for four, and an adjacent dining area. The inviting living spaces feature a fireplace, wet bar, and surround sound system, creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary suite enjoys direct pool access and beautiful mountain views, along with an inviting bath featuring dual vanities, a walk-in shower, soaking tub, and walk-in closet. A separate junior primary suite provides an additional private bedroom with its own bath, while a third bedroom and bath offer comfortable accommodations for family or guests. And then there's the detached casita, a true game changer. Complete with its own mini-kitchen and bath, the casita offers a level of flexibility hard to find in Palm Springs. Use it as a guest retreat, home office, recording studio, or private escape; its possibilities are as versatile as they are valuable. Owned solar enhances the home's energy efficiency, while the attached two-car garage offers ample storage, upgraded epoxy flooring, and direct access into the home. Adding to the convenience, a dedicated laundry room includes a sink. Whether envisioned as a full-time residence, private Palm Springs getaway, or vacation rental investment, this exceptional property offers an uncommon combination of architectural pedigree, an oversized private lot, panoramic mountain views, resort-style outdoor living, and the rare luxury of a detached casita, all without a pesky HOA and its fees. A truly special Palm Springs property where architecture, privacy, and California desert living come together beautifully.

text: Welcome home to Heritage Palms, one of the desert's hidden gems, featuring a private corner lot, saltwater pool, thoughtful upgrades, and a prime Coachella Valley location. This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath home, with the third bedroom currently being used as a spacious den, offers an open floor plan designed for comfortable everyday living and entertaining. Located within the Heritage Palms golf community, residents enjoy access to an 18-hole Arthur Hills-designed championship golf course, along with the relaxed lifestyle and amenities that make this community so desirable. The private backyard is ideal for desert living, featuring updated tile, a built-in BBQ, and a commercial-grade outdoor misting system. The saltwater pool also functions as a spool, offering the added relaxation of a spa with four powerful jets in the shallow end that activate at the push of a button. The front courtyard also features flagstone decking and beautiful views of the Santa Rosa Mountains. Inside, the kitchen has been enhanced with quartz countertops and backsplash, along with newer Samsung appliances including a double oven, stove, microwave, and dishwasher. The primary bathroom has been updated with a refreshed shower, countertop, sinks, and toilet. Additional improvements include a 15 SEER, 5-ton A/C unit, golf cart garage, and built-in garage cabinetry for added storage. The garage is equipped with a separate mini-split system, providing both heating and cooling for year-round comfort. Ideally located near Fred Waring Drive and Jefferson Street in Indio, Heritage Palms offers convenient access to Interstate 10, Highway 111, nearby shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences. The home is also minutes from the Indian Wells Tennis Garden, Old Town La Quinta, Empire Polo Club, home to the Coachella and Stagecoach music festivals, and numerous world-class golf courses throughout La Quinta, Indian Wells, and the greater Coachella Valley. Whether enjoyed as a full-time residence or seasonal retreat, this home offers an inviting combination of privacy, comfort, convenience, and the quintessential desert lifestyle.

The 3-bedroom, plus den/office, 2-bath residence features a comfortable great-room design with an entertainer's kitchen showcasing a large center island and stainless-steel appliances, opening seamlessly to the dining and living areas with fireplace. A desirable split-bedroom floor plan provides a spacious primary suite privately positioned at one end of the home, with the guest bedrooms located in a separate wing. Step outside to a contemporary, low-maintenance backyard designed for effortless desert entertaining. The outdoor setting features a newer Pebble-Tec pool and spa, firepit area, and built-in BBQ--creating an inviting space for relaxing, dining, and enjoying the Southern California sunshine. Ideally located near many of the Coachella Valley's premier tourism and entertainment destinations, including the Coachella and Stagecoach festivals, BNP Paribas Open tennis tournament, golf, and Acrisure Arena. Shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences are also just minutes away. Per the owner, the property generated approximately $64,000 in gross rental revenue in 2025 and $58,000 in 2026, with approximately $26,000 in future 2027 bookings already secured. The property offers an opportunity for a buyer to step into an established vacation-rental operation with future reservations in place. Potential 1031 exchange opportunity. No HOA rental restrictions. Beautifully appointed and thoughtfully upgraded, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home with library offers an inviting blend of comfort, style, and functionality. Interior highlights include 20-inch diagonal tile flooring, new bedroom carpeting, crown molding, recessed lighting, ceiling fans, motorized Hunter Douglas blinds, plantation shutters, surround-sound speakers and Cat 5 wiring. A beautiful custom wood library with double glass doors opens to the side patio with fountain and motorized drop shade. text: Fully renovated **Hugh Kaptur designed** Palm Springs desert oasis situated on an oversized pie shaped lot at the end of a quiet cul de sac, approximately one mile from downtown Palm Springs. Designed by renowned Palm Springs modernist architect Hugh Kaptur and located within a Kaptur designed subdivision, this distinctive residence offers architectural pedigree, privacy, and quintessential desert indoor outdoor living.The property includes a fully permitted detached 400 sq. ft. studio or casita with 9 foot ceilings and dramatic double French doors, plus an additional 100 sq. ft. of space between the studio and two car garage, offering potential for future expansion with a bath and kitchenette.The light filled main residence features an open layout, modern kitchen with updated stainless steel appliances, and seamless indoor outdoor living. Double French doors from two bedrooms, the dining room, and kitchen open to a lush private garden with 14 fruit bearing trees, mature olive trees, a grape arbor, lavender, rosemary, and extensive landscaping. The third bedroom features sliding barn style doors and a large bay window overlooking the studio and outdoor sink area.The resort style backyard is surrounded by mature ficus and lantana hedges for exceptional privacy while still capturing views of the San Jacinto Mountains and Palm Springs Aerial Tramway. Outdoor amenities include an expansive concrete pool deck, covered patio, double kidney shaped pool with a distinctive Jackson Pollock inspired finish, resurfaced spa, and updated pool and spa equipment.Originally renovated in 2015 and tastefully updated again in 2022, improvements include alabaster style flooring, remodeled bathrooms, designer walnut doors, contemporary lighting, Murano mirrors, updated HVAC and water heater, and washer and dryer. The exterior was refreshed in 2024 with new lace stucco and roof tile improvements.Additional features include RV parking alongside the two car garage, a two car driveway, and the rare detached studio offering flexible space for an office, gym, creative studio, guest retreat, or potential ADU conversion. Located in desirable Vista Norte with convenient access to downtown Palm Springs, Highway 111, and the greater Coachella Valley.

text: First time on the market! Located in the renowned, gated community of ALTA in beautiful Andreas Hills, South Palm Springs. This dramatic semi-custom modern estate, designed by visionary architect Narendra Patel was built by Toll Bros. This home occupies a premier half-acre-plus lot with sweeping, south and west-facing views of the San Jacinto and Santa Rosa Mountains, and you OWN the land! The impressive 3-bedroom, 4-bath residence offers three expansive king suites, each with a private ensuite bath, bidet, TV and private patio, thoughtfully separated for exceptional privacy. Custom finishes include granite flooring throughout, inlaid with rare Pakistani nephrite jade. All baths are custom outfitted with travertine. Dramatic Fleetwood-style doors seamlessly connect sophisticated interiors with the spectacular outdoor living spaces. The resort-inspired backyard showcases a shimmering saline pool accented with mother-of-pearl and a raised infinity spa accommodating up to ten. Beautifully designed landscaping with citrus, plumeria, pomegranate, and other exotic species. Multiple patios create an exceptional setting for entertaining or simply enjoying the desert lifestyle. A huge private office, three-car garage, 22 panel solar and a large private laundry room offer the functionality you need. Inside, discover casual and formal dining with an adjacent butler's pantry/flex room. A chef-inspired kitchen, a wet bar with a wine refrigerator, and a dedicated media room with an 85-inch screen TV. Modern comforts include a Nuvo whole-home sound system, three-zone HVAC, whole-home water treatment, tankless water heating, and electronic window shades. Offered furnished per inventory, the sale includes four striking mixed-media works by acclaimed Los Angeles artist Tae Ho Kang, along with home and patio furnishings, plus a Traeger smoker grill. An exceptional private desert retreat, complete with sweeping panoramic mountain views and HOA dues of less than $250 per month in a unique community of only 67 very special homes.

text: Top of The Mesa! THE ONE you've been waiting for. Mountains and palms frame the pool, valley views stretch beyond, and a series of conversation areas make outdoor living the main event. Covered lounging and dining areas extend the interiors outside, lush landscaping creates privacy, and gorgeous landscape lighting changes the mood after dark. Ready for the pages of Elle Decor, even the outdoor shower is something special, tucked into the landscape and framed by nature. Antique wooden gates from Mexico open to the front courtyard, where a hand-carved wood front door sets the tone for what's inside. Heavy rough-hewn wood beams, graceful archways and a fireplace bring warmth and character to the step-down living room, while the living and dining areas open directly to the covered patio, pool area and views beyond. The designer kitchen pairs custom cabinetry with limestone countertops and premium appliances. Nearby, a custom bar features a wine refrigerator and two refrigerated drawers, with doors opening directly to the courtyard. The primary suite enjoys direct pool access, a walk-in closet, extensive built-in shelving and cabinetry, and a separate sitting area currently used as an office. In the primary bath, a natural stone-walled shower takes in the surrounding views. The guest bedroom has its own bath and opens directly outdoors. Thoughtful improvements include OWNED SOLAR, tankless water heater, and Halo Zero water conditioning. The saltwater pool features a Pebble Tec finish. An air-conditioned garage with new flooring and extensive cabinetry adds another level of function. Currently eligible for the City of Palm Springs short-term rental permit program. Downtown Palm Springs and the canyon's celebrated hiking trails are just minutes away, yet here at the top of The Mesa, the feeling is wonderfully removed.

text: A Palm Springs modernist pedigree, reimagined for today. Built in 1960 by noted midcentury builder Jack Meiselman and located in the historic Sunmor neighborhood, this exceptional 4-bedroom, 3-bath residence pairs classic desert architecture with sophisticated, highly curated interiors and resort-style outdoor living. Previously featured on the 2017 and 2018 Modernism Week Home Tours as "Desert Day Modern" and on the cover of Home PS Magazine, the home has been thoughtfully evolved while honoring the architectural character that makes Meiselman homes so coveted. An open living and dining environment is anchored by a distinctive wood feature wall and connects effortlessly to the kitchen and outdoor spaces. A private "skyscape" courtyard off the primary suite creates an unexpected architectural moment, while walls of glass and multiple outdoor connections embrace the Palm Springs indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The expansive, private backyard is designed for entertaining, with panoramic mountain views, a resurfaced and retiled pool with tanning shelf, integrated spa, outdoor kitchen, covered lounge and dining areas, fire pit, manicured lawn and mature citrus trees. A spectacular detached casita, completed in 2021 at an approximate cost of $300,000, was intentionally designed to complement the original residence, echoing its roofline, exposed beam and tongue-and-groove ceiling details while framing southern mountain views from the bedroom. Additional improvements include updated Pentair pool equipment and heater, newer water heater, replaced sewer line, EV charging and solar. Offered turnkey furnished with select exclusions, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a celebrated Meiselman where architectural provenance, contemporary design and the quintessential Palm Springs lifestyle come together.

text: Quintessential Desert Modern Living | Private Pool & Spa | Mountain Views | OWNED SOLAR! Discover the essence of Palm Springs living in this distinctive desert-modern retreat, where timeless architectural character, contemporary updates, and spectacular mountain views come together to create a private desert oasis. Offering 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, OWNED SOLAR, and a sparkling turquoise pool and spa, this inviting residence is ideally located just minutes from the dining, shopping, and entertainment of downtown Palm Springs. A crisp, modern white aesthetic, complemented by tile flooring and contemporary ceiling fans, creates a bright and welcoming atmosphere throughout. The beautifully updated kitchen showcases rich wood cabinetry with dovetail joinery, elegant quartz countertops with double height edge, convection oven, bar seating, and stainless steel appliances. Perfectly positioned to capture breathtaking mountain views, the kitchen opens seamlessly to the main living spaces, making it equally suited for everyday living and entertaining. The impressive great room is highlighted by soaring vaulted ceilings, a dramatic stacked-stone gas fireplace, and expansive dual sliding glass doors that invite natural light indoors while creating a seamless connection to the outdoor living spaces. Step outside to discover multiple covered patios overlooking the expansive, private backyard, where a beautiful turquoise pool and spa provide the perfect setting for relaxation and entertaining against a backdrop of magnificent mountain vistas. The generous backyard offers an exceptional blend of hardscape and lush landscaping, with ample room for outdoor dining, lounging, and entertaining. Additional features include convenient storage and an outdoor shower, enhancing the home's quintessential resort-style appeal. Just off the great room, a versatile den currently serves as a dedicated media room, offering a wonderful space for movie nights, a home office, or an additional retreat. This flexible area can easily be converted back into a third bedroom to accommodate your needs. The spacious primary suite is a peaceful sanctuary, featuring dual mirrored closets and direct access through a sliding glass door to a covered patio overlooking the pool and beautifully landscaped backyard. The updated ensuite bath offers a stylish shower-over-tub combination with an elegant stone tile surround and glass enclosure. Privately situated on the opposite end of the home, the guest bedroom captures beautiful mountain views through an oversized picture window with a generous ledge, while the updated guest bath features a contemporary vanity and a beautifully tiled walk-in shower with frameless glass enclosure. Additional highlights include a one-and-a-half-car garage with a 50-amp EV outlet and smart garage door opener with integrated camera, along with the significant benefit of OWNED SOLAR. The land lease has been extended through 2077, providing additional long-term appeal. Ideally situated in Palm Springs, this home offers convenient access to downtown dining, boutique shopping, entertainment, the recently renovated Plaza Theatre, and Palm Springs International Airport, making it an appealing choice for both full-time residents and seasonal homeowners. Whether you're seeking a full-time residence, a weekend escape, or a private desert retreat, this distinctive Palm Springs bungalow delivers the quintessential desert lifestyle - with OWNED SOLAR, spectacular mountain views, and your own resort-inspired backyard.

text: Contemporary design, exceptional privacy, and thoughtful upgrades define this sophisticated home in one of Palm Springs' most desirable gated communities. At the heart of the home is a gourmet kitchen with an oversized island, Bosch appliances, Moen fixtures, and a large walk-in pantry. text: Classic mid-century ranch architecture meets thoughtful updates in this 1965 home overlooking the 8th hole of Tahquitz Creek Golf Resort's Legend Course. Set on a generous 10,000-square-foot lot in South Palm Springs' Tahquitz Creek Golf neighborhood, this three-bedroom, two-bath property offers expansive gathering spaces and an inviting outdoor setting. The neighborhood is an enclave of mid-century homes with very little street traffic, resulting in consistent peace and quiet. The nearly 40-foot living and dining room features an original double-sided, stacked-stone gas fireplace and two oversized sliding glass doors that frame the view and connect the interior to the spacious poolside patio and garden. The completely redesigned kitchen, renovated approximately four years ago, showcases quartz countertops, grain-matched custom cabinetry, updated appliances, and flawless storage and function. Neutral ceramic tile flooring throughout complements the home's mid-century character, while three generously sized bedrooms (the primary opening onto the pool area and garden) and two bathrooms provide comfortable accommodations. Outside, the distinctive "Lazy L" pool, spa, and fire pit create a welcoming setting for relaxing and entertaining. The outdoor space is extremely private and can accommodate entertaining at any scale; large gatherings work beautifully, as do small gatherings for family, friends, or fewer. Recent improvements include the spa, replacement pool equipment, landscaping, and drip and conventional irrigation systems. Additional improvements include new attic insulation, an insulated garage door, and water-saving toilets. The oversized two-car garage includes a ventilation fan and storage space, while double-pane west-facing windows add practical appeal. A classic Palm Springs golf course home with enduring architectural details and meaningful updates, all on fee land you own with no HOA.

text: Located in Vista Las Palmas, Palm Springs' iconic midcentury modern neighborhood, this home is a rare combination of architectural pedigree, privacy, expansive views, and thoughtful modernization. This is a quintessential Krisel residence with the character of 1959 and the comfort of today. Distinctive for its 9 ft ceilings, full height glass, exposed wood beams and pure post-and-beam construction, the home captures the effortless indoor-outdoor living that defines Palm Springs modernism while offering an unusually private setting with panoramic mountain and desert views. Thoughtfully upgraded and refitted for contemporary living, the home combines architectural integrity with energy-efficient systems and updated finishes. Porcelain flooring extends throughout, while abundant natural light filters through both skylights and walls of glass. The kitchen features glass mosaic tile, Caesarstone countertops, gas range, and wine refrigerator. Bathrooms are equally well arranged with glass mosaic tile and contemporary fixtures. Unlike many Alexander's, this home offers an expanded primary bathroom and sitting area, along with a formal dining room that adds a sense of scale and flexibility rarely found in these iconic floor plans. The dining area is highlighted by a Marc Pascall chandelier with windows and sliding doors that open the living space to the outdoors. The private grounds are designed for effortless desert living, with tall, manicured hedges, artificial turf, mature lemon and grapefruit trees, built-in BBQ, gas fire pit, and a recently refreshed pool with new tile. The home's sustainability features include a foam roof recoated in 2024, tankless water heater, water filtration system, and a drip irrigation system. Additional improvements include two HVAC systems, with the main system installed in 2023 and the primary bedroom system in 2018; upgraded piping in 2026; recessed and track lighting; garage built-ins; California Closets in all bedrooms; carpeting in the bedrooms; and a gas decorative fireplace.

text: A RARE FIND AT TRILOGY AT THE POLO CLUB! Located on one of the community's coveted all-ages streets, this exceptional Immaginare model is part of Trilogy's original collection and among its rare two-story floor plans. Built in 2017 and meticulously maintained by its original owner, this upgraded home feels practically new! Bright, spacious and inviting, the open-concept interior features soaring ceilings, tile flooring, crisp white cabinetry and thoughtful finishes throughout. Two expansive sliding glass walls bring in natural light and create a seamless connection to the outdoors. The open kitchen features granite countertops, GE appliances including a gas range and oven and a microwave/convection oven, a new refrigerator, abundant cabinetry and a generous island with open shelving and seating for four. The flexible layout includes a primary suite, den and attached casita with its own kitchenette, living room and bathroom, accessible from inside the home. Upstairs, an expansive bonus room with its own full bath and mirrored wall was previously used as a gym, but also offers space for guests, a home office or media room. An oversized closet sits just outside its door. Storage is plentiful throughout, including a laundry room with built-in desk and extensive cabinetry, plus a three-car garage. Outside, a private pool and spa and wraparound covered patio invite year-round relaxation and entertaining. Open fencing looks onto the adjoining greenbelt, with views of the greenery and nearby mountains. And then there's the Trilogy lifestyle! Just three blocks from the clubhouse, enjoy resort-style and lap pools, a spa, poolside food and beverage service, dining at June Hill's Table, fitness classes and an active calendar of clubs and social events. A ballroom, card room, billiards, shuffleboard, art studio, demonstration kitchen and golf simulator round out the amenities. With its rare layout, versatile spaces and prime setting, this home is a special opportunity to enjoy resort living at Trilogy at the Polo Club!

text: One of the finest residences in Linea. And arguably its best location. 3068 Linea Terrace occupies an exceptional west-facing site at the end of the cul-de-sac, with full, unobstructed views of the San Jacinto Mountains. The mountains fill the view from nearly every major room and provide a spectacular backdrop to the lush, curated gardens. Designed by Anthony Poon AIA, Linea is an award-winning gated enclave of just 14 modern residences in South Palm Springs. The clean, minimalist architecture is defined by dramatic scale, walls of glass and a strong connection between indoors and out. Over the past year, this residence has undergone a major renovation that builds on the original architecture while transforming the way the house looks and lives. The result is remarkably fresh, with warm organic tones layered onto the clean modern design. It has the finish, detail and the highly curated quality of new construction. The floor plan has been substantially improved to include a dedicated media room and home office, in addition to four en suite bedrooms. The media room is warm and inviting, designed for movie nights and gathering with friends. The new home office features a picture window overlooking a specimen cactus garden with the mountains beyond. The transformation goes well beyond the floor plan. A new wet bar has been added to the living room. Architectural paneling and wall treatments bring warmth and dimension. Statement lighting appears throughout. The full laundry room is now concealed behind cabinetry extending from the kitchen, maintaining the clean lines of the space. Oversized walls of glass open the interiors directly to the grounds. Outside, the landscaping is lush, mature and beautifully curated. A 65-foot pool stretches across the property, equally suited to laps or entertaining. The pergola has been upgraded with additional shade coverage, creating an intimate gathering space. A fire pit with new built-in U-shaped seating creates another inviting destination within the gardens. The setting feels private, established and resort-like. A new detached storage building provides valuable additional space beyond the three-car garage, which has been finished with epoxy flooring. This is a house designed for entertaining large groups, but it does not require a crowd. A collection of intimate spaces and garden vignettes makes it equally compelling for two. With its premier position, extraordinary western mountain views and newly completed transformation, 3068 Linea Terrace is a standout even within one of Palm Springs' most architecturally significant modern communities. It offers the finish and immediacy of new construction with something new construction cannot replicate: mature gardens, established privacy and an extraordinary sense of place.
